text: You were always special. The special , one could say - no matter how much you may dream of normalcy. You have something special about you - and that’s always been clear. This Unique may be traded for a unique, special power that only your character has! Discuss with the Storyteller team with what exactly you’re hoping for, and ensure you have open and clear communication with them regarding your expectations. The scope of this Unique should remain in the Talent power level, without becoming some

title: Competitive
text: Winning matters to you more than it probably should. Gain +2 on d20 rolls and +5% Final Damage with Attacks. Whenever you miss with an Attack, gain +1 Accuracy and suffer -1 on other d20 rolls, stacking to +5 Accuracy and -5 on other d20 rolls. Both reset when you hit with an Attack. Whenever your Fatigue level increases, gain 5 AP and +5 on your next Stamina or Chakra Exhaustion roll before the end of your next Action.

title: Defender
text: You have trained to make hitting you a poor decision. Gain DR equal to RES/3 and Block becomes a Speed 4 Interrupt. Whenever a damage-dealing adjacent unarmed Attack hits you, the attacker takes RES/2 damage after its Attack resolves; this damage cannot Wound. When you block an attack, if your last action was also a block against an attack of the same broad discipline, increase the block effectiveness by 10%, this stacks up to 5 times. If this would, for whatever reason, take you above 100% bloc

title: Energetic
text: You run longer, fight longer, and recover faster than most people can tolerate being around. You have 6 Fatigue levels instead of 5 and suffer ordinary Fatigue penalties as though you were one category lower while keeping the normal benefits of your actual Fatigue. Whenever you Rest, reduce Stamina Penalty by 1 additional point. Your inability to sit still makes careful study harder. Reduce the maximum rank of every Skill by 2.

title: Genius
text: Ninja techniques make sense to you in a way they simply do not to most people. Reduce the XP cost of Jutsu you learn by 25%, rounded up. You may learn Jutsu one Rank higher than your normal Rank limit, but this never bypasses a Talent, Ability, Aptitude, Heritage, or technique-specific requirement. Additionally, you gain advantage (2d20kh1) when rolling to make any roll relating to learning new things. A Jutsu you could not use without Genius costs +3 Chakra or Stamina each time you use it.

title: Juggernaut
text: You are built to absorb punishment and keep advancing. Use STR/14 instead of STR/18 for Physical Damage Bonus. Gain DR equal to STR/5 and reduce Stun applied to you by STR/20, after other reductions. All movement you receive is reduced by 10%, including ordinary movement, movement from Jutsu, and forced movement.

title: Large
text: You are bigger, heavier, or simply built on a scale most shinobi are not. Use STR/10 instead of STR/18 for Physical Damage Bonus. Physical Attacks gain +1 yard Reach, add RES to maximum Vitality and maximum HP, and gain +3 on Stamina rolls. Attacks benefiting from this Unique have +1 Base Speed, and gain 1 Delay. Incompatible With: Small

title: Lucky
text: Things have an irritating habit of working out for you. Outside combat, roll 2d20 and keep the higher result on ordinary d20 rolls. You have 2 + total XP/750 Luck rerolls each in-character day, rounded down. Spend 1 after a roll to reroll your own eligible roll or a willing ally's; spend 2 to force a hostile creature to reroll an eligible roll. When you have no Luck rerolls remaining, suffer -2 Accuracy and -2 on d20 rolls until they refresh.

title: Naturalist
text: You understand the living world better than books ever taught you. Increase maximum Survival ranks by 3 and gain +3 to detect, disarm, or avoid traps. Use CHA/13 instead of CHA/18 for Ninjutsu Damage Bonus. Gain +1 on Chakra Exhaustion rolls per Rank of the Jutsu being used. You also gain the ability to communicate simple ideas with beasts, creatures and natural animals such as birds and bears. When rolling checks related to studying non-human creatures, you gain advantage. Survival may replace

title: Nimble
text: Your body is built around never being where the hit lands. Gain +1 Accuracy and +1 on Defensive rolls. Reduce Base Speed of your non-Variable, non-Interrupt Actions by 1, minimum 3. When you are hit cleanly, however, it hurts. Damage against you counts as 10% higher when determining Wounds.

title: Small
text: You are short, light, and very difficult to pin down. Gain +2 Dodge and your Dodge Interrupt is Speed 1. If an effect raises Dodge Speed, you may still use Dodge even when that increase would normally make it too slow to be a valid Defense. Halve the Dodge penalty caused by being unable to reach the edge of an Area Attack, maximum penalty -10. Reduce maximum Vitality by RES. Incompatible With: Large

title: Skilled Shinobi
text: You are not necessarily the most dangerous person in the room, but there are very few situations where you have nothing useful to contribute. Gain additional Skill Points equal to total XP/75, rounded down, and increase the maximum rank of every Skill by XP/500 , minimum 0. Suffer -1 Accuracy.

title: Specialist
text: You have chosen one part of shinobi combat and pushed it further than most people ever will. Choose Taijutsu, Ninjutsu, or Genjutsu as your Specialty. Choose one of the remaining two as your Incompetence. Taijutsu Specialty: +2 Taijutsu Accuracy, -2 Stamina cost with Taijutsu and Kenjutsu, minimum 1, and +10% Final Damage with them. Ninjutsu Specialty: +2 Ninjutsu Accuracy, -2 Chakra cost with Ninjutsu, minimum 1, and +10% Final Damage with them. Genjutsu Specialty: +3 on Genjutsu offense rolls

title: Strong-Willed
text: When things go wrong, you have a habit of continuing anyway. Reduce the total temporary penalty to any Accuracy, Stamina, Chakra Exhaustion, or other d20 roll by 1. This does not reduce penalties printed as part of the Action or Jutsu itself, nor penalties from another Unique. You may ignore the mechanical penalties of one Wound you currently possess. When you suffer a new Wound, choose whether to continue ignoring the old one or ignore the new one instead. Gain +2 Genjutsu Defense. After failin

title: Surgeon
text: You know exactly where a body fails. Damaging Attacks count as +20% higher for determining Wounds. Non-AoE Called Shots suffer no additional Accuracy penalty. When making a Called Shot, you may declare a maximum Wound severity, including none; a Wound above that maximum is reduced by one severity. Begin with 5 Medicine ranks, or raise Medicine to 5 if it was lower, without spending Skill Points. Gain another Medicine rank for every full 200 total XP, up to your normal maximum. Suffer -1 on Defen

title: Warder
text: You have trained to meet attacks head-on and brush them aside. Parry becomes a Speed 2 Interrupt and gains +2. Jutsu-based defenses that use an Accuracy roll gain +2 Accuracy and reduce Base Speed by 2, minimum 1. You may Parry weapons with your bare hands and Parry unarmed Attacks with a weapon. Whenever you parry an attack with your hands or a weapon, you may immediately make an attack of a speed equal to your Parry’s Final Speed, with an Accuracy of your Parry Roll. This attack deals damage e

title: Clan Creation Uniques
text: These Uniques require the listed Primary Heritage. They cost 1 UP, may only be taken during character creation, and count toward the normal maximum of two Creation Uniques.

title: Sarutobi — A Thousand Lessons
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Sarutobi Choose two different broad disciplines from Weapon, Taijutsu, Ninjutsu, and Genjutsu. For every 200 XP that you earn, you may learn 1 technique from your chosen discipline with a Rank equal to your Maxumum Known Rank - 1, at no cost.. Whenever your previous hostile Action used a different broad discipline from the hostile Action you are declaring, gain +2 Accuracy and +2 on its Stamina or Chakra Exhaustion roll.

title: Fūma — Demon-Wind Savant
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Fūma Thrown Weapon Attacks gain +2 Accuracy and +20 yards maximum Range. After a thrown weapon misses or is Dodged, redirect one projectile to a second legal target within 10 yards at -1 Accuracy; it deals 75% Final Damage. If there is no second target, curve it back toward the original target for a second Defense at -3 Accuracy and 50% Final Damage.

title: Yotsuki — Thunder Bodyguard
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Yotsuki Take the Hit may include up to 4+(XP/100) yards of movement toward the protected creature. After a successful interception, gain +3 on the roll for your first valid Defensive Interrupt against the intercepted Attack and reduce Final Damage that reaches you by 15%. If you fully defend, the protected ally may immediately move up to 3 yards without increasing IC.

title: Ouyoku — Star-Sight Prodigy
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Ouyoku Junsugan activation is Speed 0 and its Upkeep is reduced by 2, minimum 0. Ignore the Visibility penalty from distance, darkness, smoke, or weather in addition to Junsugan's normal benefits. Search through Junsugan at Speed 0; on success, that creature cannot become Hidden from you by mundane means until the end of your next Action.

title: Karatachi Family — Mist Commander
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Karatachi Family Reduce Visibility penalties from mist, smoke, darkness, and weather by 4 for Awareness, Attack, and defensive rolls. Allies within 10 yards who can hear you reduce those same penalties by 2. Once per battle while inside mist or smoke, issue a Speed 3 command; up to two willing allies may immediately Search or move up to 3 yards without increasing IC.

title: Funato — Child of Open Water
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Funato While in a natural body of water, gain +2 Accuracy, +2 Dodge, +30% Movement, and +3 on Chakra Exhaustion rolls for Suiton. You may fight, make seals, and use ordinary equipment underwater without penalties caused solely by being submerged. A Suiton using at least 20 gallons of natural water reduces final Speed by 3 and Chakra cost by 5, minimum 1.

title: Iburi — Cohesive Smoke
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Iburi Smoke Body's Upkeep is reduced by 3, minimum 0. While active, ordinary forced movement against you is quartered, and you may pass through bars, mundane restraints, narrow openings, and gaps that smoke could reasonably traverse as ordinary movement. A Fūton Attack must fully hit to forcibly end Smoke Body.

title: Shiin — Memory Needle
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Shiin Kioku Sōshitsu gains +3 Accuracy and reduces final Speed by 2. On a full hit, you may block one memory as normal, two closely linked details from the same event, or the target's memory of one creature's current position and most recent Action for 10 IC. A target gains no cumulative bonus to recovery merely from having attempted recovery before.

title: Kodon — Perfect Metabolizer
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Kodon The first Drug you take each combat has its Crash reduced by 75% instead of 25%, and beneficial Drug durations on you increase by 25%. Ignore the first ordinary interaction penalty each battle from having two different Drugs active at once. Once per combat when a Drug's Crash begins, delay the Crash by 20 IC; the Drug's benefit still ends normally.

title: Nara — Long Shadow
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Nara Increase the Range of Nara shadow techniques by CHA/5 yards and reduce their final Speed by 2. A shadow technique may bend around up to two obstacles or corners you can see, provided a continuous path of connected shadow plausibly reaches the target.

title: Yamanaka — Open Channel
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Yamanaka Mind Network has no Upkeep for up to CHA/5 willing creatures, and linked creatures may communicate silently with you at conversational speed. When a linked ally declares a Defense, Search, or opposed Skill roll, spend 5 AP to grant +3 to that roll. Originate one non-damaging Yamanaka Clan Jutsu from the position of a willing linked ally within Network range; you pay all normal costs and make all rolls.

title: Kamizuru — Royal Hive
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Kamizuru Increase Swarm Pool by CHA\2. Clan Jutsu that spend Swarm Pool cost 8 fewer Pool, minimum 0. After the Hive fully affects a hostile creature, restore 5 Swarm Pool and move the Hive up to CHA/20 yards without increasing IC.

title: Hokori — Steady Triangle
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Hokori Gain +3 Accuracy with Jinton and +5 on checks to maintain it while interrupted. When declaring Jinton, reduce either Seal Speed or Delay by 6; this cannot reduce Seal Speed below the lineage's normal minimum or Delay below 1.

title: Hoshigaki — Blood in the Water
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Hoshigaki While submerged or standing in water, gain +2 Accuracy, +2 Dodge, and +30% Movement against a creature suffering Bleed or a Major+ Wound. You can sense the direction of such a creature within CHA yards through scent or taste in the water even without sight. When Feeding Pressure would grant AP after damaging such a creature in melee, gain 2 additional AP.

title: Silverhand — Headliner
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Silverhand Your Rocker Soul expression is unusually intense. Violence: after you take damage, your next qualifying Attack gains +3 Accuracy, +15% Final Damage, and -2 final Speed. Melody: when your normal trigger occurs, the ally regains 4 AP and you gain 4 AP. Once per battle, switch between Violence and Melody at Speed 0; otherwise follow the normal Rocker Soul rules.

title: Samsara — Balanced Samsara
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Samsara Switch Samsara modes as a Speed 2 Action. For 20 IC after switching, retain half of the numerical bonuses from the previous mode while gaining the new mode's normal benefits. Creation HP and Destruction damage bonuses do not stack with themselves. Use one non-ultimate numerical benefit of the opposite mode for a single Action without switching.

title: Jinrō — Leashed Hunger
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Jinrō Increase maximum Hunger to 8. Spend 1 Hunger to ignore one Bloodlust or urge restriction for the current Action and gain +3 on a Resistance or Genjutsu Defense against rage, appetite, or forced aggression involved in that Action. At Hunger 5+, Beast Form Physical Attacks gain +2 Accuracy and +15% Final Damage. Once per combat when you would be forced into uncontrolled aggression, gain 2 Hunger instead and remain self-directed until the end of your next Action.

title: Jashin Worshipper — Ritual Scar
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Jashin Worshipper Self-inflicted HP damage paid to fuel Jashin techniques is reduced by 50%, minimum 1, but counts at its original value for effects that measure the sacrifice. After willingly paying HP for a Jashin effect, your next Jashin Attack before the end of your next Action gains +2 Accuracy and +10% Final Damage. The first time each combat you willingly reduce yourself below half HP, gain 5 AP.

title: Aburame — Queen-Bred Colony
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Aburame Increase Kikaichū Swarm maximum HP by CHA × 4. When you place a female insect, restore CHA × 2 Swarm HP and move the Swarm up to CHA/15 yards at Speed 0. Once per battle when the Swarm would fall to 0 HP, it remains at CHA HP instead; this does not protect it from an effect that explicitly annihilates the colony.

title: Aburame — Silent Host
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Aburame Kikaichū used for scouting gain +5 Stealth and Awareness and may Search from their own position using your Awareness. Clan Ninjutsu originating from a Swarm in Stealth do not reveal your body unless the technique requires your visible position. Hostile Clan Jutsu originating from a Swarm in Stealth gain +3 Accuracy.

title: Akimichi — Heavyweight Prodigy
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Akimichi While Baika or Cho Baika is active, every full 5 points of X grants +5% Final Damage to melee Taijutsu and +1 yard Reach, maximum +25% and +5 yards. Reduce forced movement against you by X/2 yards. After moving at least 5 yards in one direction, your next Akimichi melee Attack gains +2 Accuracy, -3 final Speed, and Knockback +2.

title: Akimichi — Pill-Hardened
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Akimichi Reduce Fatigue and Poison caused by Three-Coloured Pill drawbacks by 2, minimum 0. The first Pill you consume each mission is Speed 0. Once per Pill colour after its benefit ends, recover CP equal to RES/5, minimum 2. This cannot reduce a drawback or cost explicitly marked as unreducible.

title: Hyūga — Pure Byakugan
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Hyūga While Byakugan is active, double its visual range and gain +3 Dodge against visible single-target Attacks. Ignore 3 points of penalties caused by smoke, darkness, distance, or partial visual obstruction when Byakugan can plausibly see through or around the interference. When a creature within Byakugan range becomes Hidden, make the reactive Search at Speed 0 with +4.

title: Hyūga — Gentle Fist Prodigy
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Hyūga Gentle Fist hits apply +2 additional Sealed Tenketsu. Against Sealed Tenketsu 4+, Gentle Fist gains +2 Accuracy. Against Sealed Tenketsu 6+, it also counts as +15% higher for Wounding and costs 2 less Chakra, minimum 1.

title: Inuzuka — Twin-Born Bond
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Inuzuka Begin combat with a shared 6 AP Bond pool. Only you or your Ninken may spend Bond AP, and only on Ninken command costs or paired Clan Jutsu. Ninken commands cost 2 fewer AP, minimum 0. When you and your Ninken both damage the same creature before your next Action, the second hit gains +2 Accuracy and +15% Final Damage.

title: Inuzuka — Alpha Scent
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Inuzuka You and your Ninken gain +6 Awareness and Survival to track by scent. A creature either of you has smelled during the current scene cannot become Hidden from both of you through mundane Stealth within AGI × 5 yards unless its scent is specifically masked. Mark Scent — Speed 2: mark a creature within 3 yards that either of you can smell. For 20 IC, you and your Ninken gain +2 Accuracy and +20% Movement when moving directly toward it.

title: Senju — Deep Roots
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Senju Your Mokuton terrain and created objects gain +50% HP and +10 DR. When a hostile creature moves at least 3 yards through Mokuton terrain you created, increase its Immobilization by 2 after the movement resolves. Root Surge — Speed 3 Interrupt: when a hostile creature enters or begins an Action inside your Mokuton terrain, move it up to 3 yards within that terrain or apply Immobilization 2. This cannot move it outside the Mokuton area.

title: Senju — Senju Vitality
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Senju Increase maximum Vitality by RES × 2 and maximum HP by RES. Gain +2 on Stamina and Chakra Exhaustion rolls. When you take the Rest action while touching Mokuton you created, recover an additional RES × 2 Vitality and reduce Stun by 3.

title: Uzumaki — Adamantine Soul
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Uzumaki Adamantine Sealing Chains gain +3 on Grapple, Restrain, and sealing rolls and +50% effective durability for barriers and defensive uses. Successful restraints with your Adamantine Sealing Chains increase Immobilization by 2 after resolving. Reduce final Speed of Chain and Fūinjutsu Actions against a creature currently restrained by your Chains by 2.

title: Uzumaki — Red-Haired Vitality
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Uzumaki Increase maximum HP by CHA × 2 and maximum Vitality by RES. Gain +2 on Chakra Exhaustion rolls. Once per combat when a Chakra Exhaustion failure would increase Fatigue, spend HP equal to CHA/2 to reduce that Fatigue increase by 1 and Chakra Exhaustion penalty increase by 1. The first time each battle you fall below half HP without being incapacitated, recover CHA HP.

title: Kazekage Clan / Jiton — Iron Sand Heir
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Kazekage Clan / Jiton Increase Prepared Sand Reserve by 20 + CHA gallons. Drawing up to half your Reserve is Speed 0. When Sand successfully Parries an Attack, retain all material and gain +3 Accuracy on your next Jiton Attack against that attacker. Once per battle, if at least 5 gallons of prepared Sand are within 3 yards when an Attack is declared against you, spend 3 AP to attempt a Sand Parry even if you had not prepared one.

title: Kazekage Clan / Jiton — Polarity Savant
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Kazekage Clan / Jiton Increase the maximum Magnetize severity of effects you apply to 5. Opposite charges at combined severity 4+ grant both Magnetic Pressure benefits instead of one: +3 forced movement and +10% Wounding. At combined severity 6+, improve those benefits to +5 forced movement and +15% Wounding. After charged creatures or objects interact, shift 1 severity of one charge you applied to another legal target within 5 yards.

title: Shakuton — Sun-Blooded
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Shakuton You are immune to environmental heat created by your own Shakuton. Increase maximum Scorch Orbs by 2 and begin combat with two additional Orbs. When spending an Orb, gain +3 on the associated Chakra Exhaustion roll and reduce that Action's final Speed by 1. Once per combat when you would reach 0 Orbs, regain 1 Orb after the current Action resolves.

title: Shakuton — Desert Executioner
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Shakuton Against Dehydration 3+, damaging Shakuton gains +2 Accuracy and counts as +20% higher for determining Wounds instead of the lineage's normal +10%. When you Wound a creature at Dehydration 3+, increase its Dehydration by 1 after the Wound resolves. Against Dehydration 5+, damaging Shakuton ignores 10 DR and treats Armor Absorption as 10% lower.

title: Yōton — Volcanic Body
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Yōton Gain 3 additional ranks of Heat Resistance at no XP cost. While Lava Armour or another self-coating Yōton effect is active, gain +8 DR and reduce forced movement against you by 4 yards. A creature that damages you with an adjacent unarmed or melee Physical Attack takes Yōton damage equal to CHA/5 after its Attack resolves.

title: Yōton — Expression Prodigy
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Yōton Choose the Volcanic Expression selected by your Heritage. Magma: +15% Wounding against targets in your Magma. Quicklime: each application gains +2 Immobilization, and breaking free from your Quicklime costs +2 final Speed. Rubber: defensive barriers gain +20% effectiveness and forced movement gains +3 yards; you may redirect that forced movement by up to 90 degrees.

title: Hōzuki — Living Water
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Hōzuki Suika no Jutsu reduces ordinary non-Energy Physical damage to 10% after defenses instead of 20%. While hydrated, gain +2 Dodge against non-Raiton Physical Attacks and may escape ordinary Grapples, restraints, bars, or gaps that liquid could pass through as Speed 3. Raiton retains all normal hard-counter effects.

title: Hōzuki — Water Gunner
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Hōzuki Hōzuki projectile and Water Gun-style Attacks, ignore 15 DR, and increase maximum Range by 25%. After using internal Water Reserve for an Attack, recover 3 gallons. When a Water Gun-style Attack fully hits, ricochet or split the shot toward a second legal target within 10 yards at -2 Accuracy for 50% Final Damage without paying the technique's Action Speed again.

title: Yuki — Mirror-Born
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Yuki While at least two Demonic Ice Mirrors are active, gain +3 Dodge and +2 Accuracy with Hyōton and Senbon. Moving from one piece of created Ice or Mirror to another within your normal Living Ice movement allowance does not increase IC. After doing so, your next Hyōton Attack gains -3 final Speed and +25% Range.

title: Yuki — Winter Child
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Yuki Hyōton Immobilization you apply to a creature increases by 1, to the normal maximum, and your created Ice gains +25% HP. When a creature reaches Immobilization 5+ from your Ice, your next Hyōton against it gains +3 Accuracy and -2 final Speed. Against Immobilization 7+, damaging Hyōton counts as +10% higher for Wounding.

title: Futton — Pressure Prodigy
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Futton Begin combat with 3 additional Steam and increase maximum Steam by 3. When you spend 3+ Steam on one declaration, regain 1 Steam after it resolves and gain +2 Accuracy or +2 on the Chakra Exhaustion roll for that declaration. Spend up to 2 Steam as though each point were 1 AP on an Futton Action or Defensive Interrupt.

title: Futton — Acid Breath
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Futton While in Corrosion Mode, damaging Futton ignores an additional 20% Armor Absorption and deals +50% damage to created barriers and equipment. After Futton damages Armor, reduce its Absorption by another 10% for 20 IC; repeated applications refresh the duration instead of stacking. When Corrosion destroys a barrier, Armor piece, or significant equipment, gain 1 Steam.

title: Jūgo's Bloodline — Mutation Savant
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Jūgo's Bloodline Gain two additional Shape Change ranks at no XP cost. You may change two different body regions with one Shape Change Action, and changing one region is Speed 2. The first Action after changing form that materially uses the new anatomy gains +3 Accuracy or +3 on its relevant Defensive roll, and -2 final Speed.

title: Jūgo's Bloodline — Calm Sage Blood
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Jūgo's Bloodline Increase maximum Sage Charges by 3. When Senninka would force Bloodlust because you reached 0 WP, spend 2 SC instead to remain fully self-directed for 20 IC. When you gain SC, restore RES Vitality and reduce Stun by 1. Once per battle when you would lose control while you still have SC, spend all remaining SC to remain self-directed until the end of your next Action.

title: Karashi (Puppets) — Master Strings
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Karashi (Puppets) Once per IC, after your Primary fully hits or successfully defends, you may exchange it with an Active Support within legal Frame Range without increasing your IC. Your new Primary's next Puppet Action gains -2 Final Speed, to its normal minimum, provided it is a different action from the one that triggered the exchange. While using Concentrated Control instead, you may Strain one Heavy Thread to activate one compatible Routine your Primary knows for

title: Karashi (Puppets) — Hidden Arsenal
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Karashi (Puppets) During construction, designate two installed Weapon Mounts, Mechanisms or compatible Attachments as concealed systems. The first Attack made by each concealed weapon or Mechanism after its reveal gains +3 Accuracy and -2 Final Speed. Once per battle, when your Primary fully defends an Attack, you may immediately reveal and activate one unspent concealed defensive Attachment as a Speed 0 Interrupt, paying all its normal resource costs. This attack use

title: Uchiha — Mirror-Eyed Prodigy
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Uchiha While Sharingan is active, increase maximum Reads on a creature by 2. After gaining a Read, choose +2 Accuracy on your next Attack against that creature, +2 on your next Defensive roll against it, or -2 final Speed on your next Observe or copied technique involving it. At 3+ Reads, a successful Defense against that creature restores 1 Read if you spent any during that exchange.

title: Uchiha — Flameheart
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Uchiha Improve the Chakra cost reduction from Uchiha Fire Doctrine by 1 per Sharingan Stage. At Stage 3, damaging Katon gains +10% Final Damage. When Katon fully hits a creature with at least 2 Reads, increase Ignite or Burn by 2. When a creature with 3+ Reads Dodges one of your Katon projectiles or lines, bend or redirect the effect by up to 45 degrees if its geometry allows it; this cannot hit the same creature twice.

title: Bakuton — Blast-Rider
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Bakuton Blast Step may move up to 10 yards and its Recoil may be redirected once by up to 180 degrees. Reduce Stun or self-inflicted forced movement caused by your own Bakuton by 2. After Recoil or Blast Step moves you at least 5 yards, your next Bakuton melee Attack gains +3 Accuracy, +15% Final Damage, and -2 final Speed. On a full hit, Recoil up to 3 yards without increasing IC.

title: Bakuton — Shaped-Charge Savant
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Bakuton Controlled Demolition: Shaped Charge deals another +50% Final Damage to structures, terrain, created barriers, and unattended objects. Increase total Detonation Mark limit by 2. Detonation Marks on one target may be detonated as part of declaring a Bakuton Attack against it, adding their damage after that Attack resolves. When two or more Marks detonate together, choose +2 Accuracy for the triggering Attack, +2 Knockback per Mark, or +15% Wounding for the comb

title: Kaguya — War Skeleton
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Kaguya Begin each combat with 3 additional Skeletal Modifications beyond Battle-Born Skeleton's normal amount. When you suffer a Wound, gain one additional Modification beyond the lineage's normal Wound trigger and +3 on your next Resistance or Defensive roll. While you have at least 3 Ossification ranks, gain another RES/10 DR. Once per battle when a Wound reduces you below half HP, immediately perform Skeletal Realignment after that Wound resolves, paying its normal

title: Kaguya — Dance-Born
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Kaguya Kaguya Clan Jutsu with “Dance” in the technique's name cost 4 less Chakra or Stamina, minimum 1, and gain +2 Accuracy. When a Dance expends 3+ Skeletal Modifications, regain one Modification of a different type and reduce final Speed of your next Dance by 3. After a Dance fully hits or fully defends, immediately transition into a different known Kaguya Dance of final Speed 6 or less by paying its normal Chakra or Stamina. Instead of taking that Action's Speed n

title: Alert
text: You notice the things other shinobi miss. Increase your maximum Awareness ranks by 2, gain +3 Espionage when noticing concealment or deception, and treat your Blind Fighting and Keen Senses abilities as one rank higher than you actually possess, even above their normal limits. Search is Speed 3 for you.

title: Blur
text: You are difficult to follow once you start moving. Increase Movement by 10%. Shunshin does not require a Chakra Exhaustion roll from you, though its Speed is unchanged. Whenever you fully succeed on a Dodge, you may immediately move the distance you would normally cover with a Speed 4 Move. Upgrades Into: Exceptionally Fast

title: Close Ties
text: You draw strength from the people beside you. Allies fighting alongside you gain +3 on Stamina and Chakra Exhaustion rolls; a creature can benefit from only one Close Ties at a time. You gain +1 to those rolls for each ally present, maximum +3. When an ally you can perceive spends Willpower, you may spend one of your Willpower in their place. Upgrades Into: Leader, Protector

title: Chemist
text: You know exactly how much trouble can fit in a bottle. Increase your maximum Toxicology and Artisan (Craftsman) ranks by 3. When a Downtime Action creates Exploding Tags, smoke bombs, flash bombs, antidotes, poisons, or ordinary pharmaceuticals, produce twice the normal number of doses. Soldier Pills you personally craft grant +15 to their Stamina and Chakra Exhaustion benefit instead of +10. Whenever you successfully craft poison, you also produce one matching antidote.

title: Elementally Gifted
text: Elemental chakra came naturally to you long before it did to most shinobi. Choose one basic element. You may use it as though you possessed one rank of Elemental Aptitude without spending a rank, and Elemental Affinity may apply to that element in addition to its normal choice. Upgrades Into: Elementalist

title: Expansive Chakra
text: Chakra comes easily and in large quantities. When you use a Jutsu, gain +1 on its Chakra Exhaustion roll per Rank of the technique, from +1 for E-rank to +5 for A-rank. Your Ninjutsu Damage Bonus is increased by half that amount. An Action Chain receives this benefit only once, using the Rank of its base Action. Upgrades Into: Boundless Chakra

title: Full Pockets
text: You are rarely without something useful. Gain twice the normal value when an effect, occupation, or Downtime Action awards ordinary Ryo, and gain +5 on Espionage or Diplomacy rolls made to bribe someone. Once per mission, you may reveal that you packed an ordinary piece of equipment you could legally have purchased before leaving; pay its normal Ryo cost when you do so. In combat this is a Speed 5 Action.

title: Hidden Potential
text: Whatever your ceiling is, you have not reached it yet. Increase maximum Willpower by 3. Upgrades Into: Any 2 Point or 3 Point Unique

title: Indefatigable
text: You can keep working long after most people have started dragging their feet. Gain +1 on Stamina rolls, plus another +1 per Rank of the Jutsu involved; basic attacks receive +2. Whenever you Rest, reduce Stamina Penalty by 1 additional point. Upgrades Into: Endless Energy

title: Killing Intent
text: Something about you makes it obvious that you know how to hurt people. Whenever you inflict a Wound, you and the victim make opposed rolls of 1d20 + twice current Willpower. You gain +1 for each previous Wound you have inflicted during the battle. If you win, the target suffers Stun equal to the margin, capped at 5 for a Minor Wound, 10 for Major, 20 for Severe, with no cap for Critical.

title: Lightfoot
text: You know how to disappear without making a production of it. Gain +3 Stealth and reduce Hide Speed by 3. You may move while at Stealth 2 without lowering your Stealth level. Upgrades Into: Skirmisher

title: Martial Prowess
text: You fight best when the pressure never stops. Changing targets no longer ends a Combo; instead reduce your Combo Counter by 1 when you switch targets. Gain +3 on Counter Combo opposed rolls, and damaging Combo Jutsu gain Stun 1, or +1 Stun if they already inflict it. A Stun lower than Combo Counter + 2 does not break your Combo. Upgrades Into: Bruiser

title: Quick Draw
text: Your hands are usually moving before anyone else realizes you need something. You may throw up to DEX/8 weapons with a Multi-Throw, reduce the final Speed of Ranged Weapon Attacks by 2, and reduce Seal Speed by 1. Drawing a weapon is Speed 0 for you. When an Attack is declared against you, you may draw an item that grants a valid Interrupt as part of declaring that Interrupt. Upgrades Into: Fan of Knives, Single-Handed Seals

title: Restrained
text: You are very good at knowing exactly how hard you are hitting. If one of your Attacks would kill a creature, you may leave it at 0 HP instead; any Wound caused by that Attack still occurs normally. Upgrades Into: Protector

title: Scheduled
text: You are almost offensively organized. Gain two additional Downtime Actions each cycle. Upgrades Into: Fixer

title: Seal Master
text: Handseals are second nature to you. Use DEX/8 instead of DEX/10 when reducing Seal Speed. For every 4 points by which your normal Seal Speed reduction exceeds the Seal Speed of a Jutsu, reduce that Jutsu's final Speed by 1, to a maximum reduction equal to its Rank and never below the normal minimum final Speed. Upgrades Into: Jutsu Master, Single-Handed Seals

title: Silver Tongued
text: You can make a calm person furious in under a minute, and in combat you usually need much less time than that. Mock — Speed 6 Interrupt: when a creature that can hear you makes an Attack or Defense roll, make Diplomacy opposed by Resistance. On success, it rolls twice and keeps the lower d20. Each further Mock against the same creature that day is +2 Speed. Jeer — Speed 3 Interrupt: when a creature that can hear you makes a Skill roll, give it -5 to the roll. Further uses against the same creatu

title: Weapon Trained
text: Weapons are tools to you, not identities. At the start of combat, you may reassign any weapon-specific Melee Ability you possess to another weapon shape it could legally apply to. Drawing and sheathing weapons are Speed 0. Weapon Focus need only be purchased once; when you draw a weapon, it may apply to that weapon until you change weapons again. If Weapon Focus increases Stamina cost per rank, reduce that increase by 1. Upgrades Into: Weapon Master

title: Weight Trainer
text: You train under a burden so that fighting without it feels effortless. If you begin a battle wearing your weights, create a Weight AP pool with the same maximum as your normal AP pool. Every 20 IC, when your normal passive AP recovery would give you AP, place half that amount, rounded down, into Weight AP instead and gain the remainder as normal AP. Removing the weights is Speed 6, Delay 6, and may be done once per battle. After removing them, spend Weight AP exactly like normal AP before spendi

title: Wrestling Prowess
text: Once you get your hands on someone, leaving is the difficult part. When you enter a Clinch, immediately use a known Grapple Jutsu with the Trapping tag without increasing IC. While Grappling, gain DR equal to Control × 3 and +3 on Grapple rolls and Reversal TNs. Upgrades Into: Bruiser

title: Applied Knowledge
text: You solve practical problems by knowing more than anyone reasonably should. Add Research ranks/5, max 10, to non-Research Skill rolls as a bonus. When you take this Unique, choose one non-Research skill as your field of profession; that skill can no longer have Ranks added to it and instead uses the same Skill ranks as you've bought in Research. Additionally, all non-Research and non-profession skills gain Research/10, max 10, to their maximum ranks. Finally, as Speed 4, or by adding +4 Speed to

title: Avenger
text: Choose a person or group that has given you a reason not to forgive. Against a Hidden Village-sized group, gain +2 Accuracy and d20 rolls. A single clan or organization raises this to +3. A group of ten or fewer, or one named person, raises it to +5. Against one named person, gain another +1 for each full 1,000 XP they have over you. You also gain Killing Intent while confronting your chosen enemy. Upgrades From: Any 1 Point Unique

title: Boundless Chakra
text: Your reserves are enormous even by shinobi standards. Gain +3 on Chakra Exhaustion rolls. Whenever a Jutsu increases Chakra Exhaustion penalty, reduce that increase by 1, minimum 1 if it would increase at all. Reduce the Upkeep of Jutsu you personally maintain by 1. When you Rest, reduce Chakra Exhaustion penalty by the same amount as Stamina Penalty. Upgrades From: Expansive Chakra Upgrades Into: Regenerative Chakra, Surging Power

title: Bruiser
text: You know how to turn weight, impact, and positioning into violence. Add RES/30 to Physical Damage Bonus. Gain DR equal to STR/5. Damaging Unarmed Attacks gain Stun 2, or increase existing Stun by 2. Grapple Jutsu that successfully establish or improve Control increase the opponent's Stamina Penalty by 1. Upgrades From: Martial Prowess, Wrestling Prowess Upgrades Into: Relentless

title: Chakra Sensor
text: You can feel chakra moving through the world around you. Increase maximum Chakra Control ranks by 3 and gain +3 Genjutsu Defense. Your sensing range is CHA × 5 yards. Within that range you can identify familiar chakra signatures, tell when someone enters HP, sense their current Fatigue category when they make Chakra Exhaustion, and notice active Upkeep. Scan — Speed 6: make Chakra Control opposed by Chakra Control or Espionage against any creatures you choose in range. A target suffers a penalty

title: Combat Medic
text: Requires: Medicine 8 You have learned to work while people are moving, bleeding, and trying not to die. Increase maximum Medicine ranks by 3. Gain +4 Medicine to diagnose, stabilize, or treat Wounds. Non-damaging Medical Jutsu targeting another creature reduce final Speed by 2, and healing you provide to another creature restores 25% more HP or Vitality. Emergency Treatment — Speed 7: make Medicine TN 20 against an adjacent ally. On success suppress the penalties of one Major Wound for 20 IC. A

title: Cunning
text: You understand how people think well enough to make that knowledge dangerous. Ignore combined Diplomacy and Research prerequisites used only to learn ordinary Genjutsu. Gain +2 on Genjutsu rolls and TNs. The normal defense bonus for seeing the same Genjutsu repeatedly does not begin until its third use against a creature. Reduce the Upkeep of one Genjutsu you maintain by CHA/25, minimum 0; change which Genjutsu receives this benefit whenever you establish another. Upgrades Into: False World

title: Elementalist
text: Most shinobi have one or two comfortable elements. You have several. Choose two basic elements; you may use them as if you possessed one rank of Elemental Aptitude, though these are not actual purchased ranks. Your Elemental Affinity may apply to every basic element you can use. Status Effects inflicted by your basic Elemental Ninjutsu increase by 1, or by 2 when applied through a Status roll. Upgrades From: Elementally Gifted Upgrades Into: Elemental Mastery

title: Endless Energy
text: You simply do not tire at the rate other people do. Whenever Stamina Penalty increases, reduce that increase by 1, minimum 1 if it would increase at all. The first time each battle you fail a Stamina roll, advance one fewer Fatigue category. Gain RES/40 on Stamina rolls. Every 15 IC, reduce Stamina Penalty by 1. Upgrades From: Indefatigable Upgrades Into: Surging Power

title: Exceptionally Fast
text: You move before other people have properly decided what they are doing. Reduce the Base Speed of all Actions by 10%, rounded up, without reducing an Action to Speed 0 - This can cause attacks and actions to be reduced below their minimum speed, if they have any - regardless of what the ability itself says. Increase Movement by 20%. On a Partial Success with Dodge, you suffer no secondary effects from the Attack other than damage. Upgrades From: Blur Upgrades Into: Vanishing Point

title: Fan of Knives
text: Thrown weapons stop being ammunition and start becoming terrain. Increase the Range of Ranged Taijutsu by DEX/20 yards. Those Attacks gain +1% Final Damage per yard to the target, maximum 15 + DEX/10%. When you hit with a Ranged Taijutsu Attack, treat it as having hit by 1 point more than it actually did for Partial Success and any effect based on how much the Attack hit by. Multi-Throw may include DEX/40 additional weapons without increasing its normal Speed or cost. You may Parry a non-AoE ran

title: Fixer
text: You know people who know people, and you rarely pay full price for anything. Gain +3 Diplomacy and +3 on Artisan rolls made through Downtime. Ordinary equipment and crafting costs are reduced by 30%. You also gain the benefits of Scheduled. Upgrades From: Scheduled

title: Imposing Presence
text: Your mouth is no longer just irritating; it can control the shape of a fight. Increase maximum Diplomacy ranks by 2 and gain Silver Tongued. Goad — Speed 8: choose any number of creatures that can hear you and roll Diplomacy against each target's Resistance or Espionage, with -2 to your roll per target after the first. For every 2 points you win by, that creature suffers -1 Accuracy when targeting anyone but you, maximum -3, for 5 IC per point of margin, maximum 30 IC. Each repeated Goad against

title: Jutsu Master
text: You learn techniques quickly and keep an absurd number of them straight in your head. Reduce the XP cost of Jutsu by 25%, applied multiplicatively with other reductions and retroactively. Increase maximum Chakra Control ranks by 3. Gain +1 Accuracy with Jutsu, or +1 on the relevant Genjutsu offense roll; double this bonus for a technique with an inherent Accuracy penalty. Jutsu deal +5% Final Damage. You also gain the Seal Speed calculation of Seal Master. Upgrades From: Seal Master Upgrades Int

title: Leader
text: People fight better when you are keeping everyone pointed in the same direction. Whenever an ally gains AP from a source other than Leader, you gain half as much, rounded down. AP gained from Leader cannot trigger another Leader. You may spend your normal AP on an ally's declared Action as though it were theirs, even against a Surprise or Sneak Attack; all normal AP limits still apply. Spend 15 AP before an ally rolls Accuracy to let that ally roll 2d20 and keep the higher result instead of 1d20

title: Protector
text: You will get there in time. Add RES once more to maximum Vitality and maximum HP. If you have enough movement to reach a willing creature, your Take the Hit automatically succeeds. While using Take the Hit, you are considered to be Blocking and may use any valid non-Dodge Defensive Interrupt against the intercepted Attack. You also gain the benefits of Close Ties and may designate any willing creature as an ally for its purposes. Upgrades From: Close Ties, Restrained Upgrades Into: Living Fortre

title: Single-Handed Seals
text: You can form handseals with one free hand. Use DEX/7 instead of DEX/10 when reducing Seal Speed and increase current and maximum Chakra Control ranks by 2. When using both hands, reduce the Seal Speed of Ninjutsu by an additional Chakra Control/10. Seal Speed cannot be reduced below 0, and this never bypasses a technique's special handseal requirements. Upgrades From: Seal Master, Quick Draw Upgrades Into: Perfect Technique

title: Skirmisher
text: Your preferred fight is one where the opponent never gets a clean look at you. Increase maximum Stealth ranks by 3. While Hidden, add DEX/30 to Damage Bonus on ordinary Surprise Attacks and DEX/20 on Sneak Attacks. You may take Hide even while directly observed; normal Visibility and repeated-Hide penalties still apply, but the repeated penalty begins one use later. You also gain Lightfoot. Upgrades From: Lightfoot Upgrades Into: Vanishing Point

title: Tenacious
text: Failure gives you something to push against. Increase maximum Resistance ranks by 3 and gain Hidden Potential. Whenever Fatigue increases because you failed Stamina or Chakra Exhaustion, gain 1 temporary Willpower until Fatigue next increases. If that temporary Willpower is spent to reroll a roll, you may reroll the reroll once more, but must keep the third result. Upgrades From: Hidden Potential Upgrades Into: Super Novice, Surging Power

title: Weapon Master
text: You have stopped thinking of weapons as separate disciplines. Whenever you draw a weapon, reassign any weapon-specific Melee Abilities you possess to that weapon if they could legally apply. Weapon Focus applies to every weapon you wield and needs to be purchased only once. Reduce any Stamina-cost increase caused by Weapon Focus by 2 per rank. You also gain the draw and sheathe benefits of Weapon Trained. Upgrades From: Weapon Trained Upgrades Into: Arsenal Incarnate

title: All-Seer
text: Your chakra sense is closer to another set of eyes. Increase Chakra Sensing range to CHA × 10 yards and remember a number of signatures equal to CHA/10. Any creature in range that spends Chakra, pays Upkeep, or rolls Chakra Exhaustion reveals its exact location to you until the Action ends unless its effect explicitly defeats sensing. Scan is Speed 3 and may target everyone in range without penalty. When a sensed creature declares a Chakra-based hostile Action, you may spend 3 AP to identify its

title: Arsenal Incarnate
text: There is no wrong weapon in your hands. Gain +2 Accuracy and +2 Parry with any weapon you can legally wield, and drawing, sheathing, or switching weapons is Speed 0 which may be performed as an interrupt. After changing weapon shapes, choose two for the next Attack: +2 Accuracy, -2 final Speed, +15% Final Damage, or ignore 10 DR. Perfect Arsenal — Speed 3, lasts 20 IC: at the start of each Action, you may reassign one weapon Ability or Weapon Focus you possess to the weapon currently in hand. On

title: Elemental Mastery
text: Your control of elemental chakra has passed the point where ordinary categories are especially useful. Choose two basic elements; you may use them as if you possessed one rank of Elemental Aptitude, and Elemental Affinity applies to every basic element you can use. Your Elemental Shaping equals 1 for each basic element you can use, plus 1 for each Jutsu Rank (E, D, C, B, A) in which you know at least one Jutsu of that element. Count each Rank separately for each element. When you declare a damag

title: False World
text: Once your Genjutsu gets a foothold, reality becomes negotiable. Whenever a creature fails Genjutsu Defense against you, place 1 Thread on it, maximum 5. Before another Genjutsu roll against that creature, spend up to 3 Threads; each gives +1 to your roll or -1 Seal Speed. When a creature successfully Realizes or releases one of your Genjutsu, keep 1 Thread on it. Once per battle, when a creature with 4+ Threads fails Genjutsu Defense, spend 4 Threads and 1 Willpower to immediately establish a di

title: Living Fortress
text: Hitting you is frequently the least productive choice available. Gain DR equal to RES/4 and increase Block's damage reduction by 10%. Take the Hit reduces its final Speed by 3 and may include up to 3 yards of movement to reach the protected creature. When you successfully Take the Hit, reduce Final Damage to you by 20%; if you suffer a Wound, ignore that Wound's penalties until the battle ends. While you are Prepare Blocking, adjacent allies improve their own Block damage reduction by 10%. Upgra

title: Master Surgeon
text: Requires: Medicine 15 You can keep someone alive through injuries that should have ended the fight. Increase healing you provide to others by 35%, and reduce final Speed of non-damaging Medical Jutsu targeting others by 4. Resuscitate — Speed 0 Interrupt, once per battle: when an adjacent ally would be incapacitated but not killed, spend 1 Willpower and 25 Chakra and make Medicine TN 30. On success the ally remains conscious at 1 HP and one Wound's penalties are suppressed for 20 IC. This cannot

title: Perfect Technique
text: At the start of each in-character day, choose three B-rank or lower Jutsu you know as Signature Techniques. When using one, pay 5 additional Chakra or Stamina and choose one: -3 final Speed, +3 Accuracy, +15% Final Damage, or +4 on its Stamina/Chakra Exhaustion roll. Once per battle, pay 10 additional cost to choose two different options instead. If the Signature Technique requires handseals, you may perform them one-handed. Upgrades From: Jutsu Master, Single-Handed Seals

title: Pinnacle
text: Choose Taijutsu, Ninjutsu, or Genjutsu as your Pinnacle Specialty. If you reached Pinnacle by upgrading Specialist, use the same Specialty. Your Pinnacle Specialty gains +1 Accuracy, or +1 to Genjutsu offense, and +2 on its relevant Stamina or Chakra Exhaustion rolls. At the start of each Specialty Action choose one Form: - Precision, +3 Accuracy - Power, +15% Final Damage and +2 final Speed - Economy, +4 on the Exhaustion roll, -2 to the Final Cost - Guard, +3 on your next Defensive roll before

title: Regenerative Chakra
text: Your chakra recovers almost as quickly as you spend it. Gain +5 on Chakra Exhaustion rolls. Every 10 IC, reduce Chakra Exhaustion penalty by 1. Reduce total Upkeep you personally pay by 1 + CHA/30. Once per battle, after failing Chakra Exhaustion, advance one fewer Fatigue category. Increase Ninjutsu Damage Bonus by current Fatigue level. At the start of battle, gain Chakra Points equal to maximum Willpower. After a Chakra Exhaustion roll, spend any number of Chakra Points; each adds current Fat

title: Relentless
text: Momentum is the only defense you care about. Each time you hit with a damaging Attack, gain +2 Damage Bonus on your next damaging Attack, up to half your normal Damage Bonus. Missing resets this bonus. Whenever you miss with a damaging Attack, determine when you next act as though the missed Attack had half its final Speed, rounded up. This does not change the Attack's damage or any other effect based on its Speed. Each consecutive miss also gives +1 Accuracy to your next damaging Attack, maximu

title: Super Novice
text: You never settled into one specialty, so you learned to make that everyone else's problem. Gain a 10% XP bonus. Whenever you are Wounded, gain 1 temporary Willpower. This temporary Willpower lasts until the next time you are Wounded; if you have not spent it, it is replaced, and if you have spent it, you gain a new point. Upgrades From: Any 1 Point or 2 Point Unique except Elementally Gifted or Elementalist

title: Surging Power
text: The worse your condition becomes, the harder you are to shut down. Whenever you spend Willpower, halve current Stamina and Chakra Exhaustion penalties; instead, you may spend Willpower specifically to remove one of those penalties entirely. Spend 1 Willpower to ignore all penalties from one Wound until the battle ends. Reduce Fatigue penalties to Accuracy and Defensive rolls by half maximum Willpower, rounded down. Upgrades From: Boundless Chakra, Endless Energy, Tenacious

title: Tactician
text: You win by deciding what the fight is going to look like before anyone else notices there was a choice. The first time you use a specific Action in a battle, it gains +2 Accuracy or +2 to its relevant d20 roll. If that Action is an Attack and hits, gain half its final Speed in AP, without exceeding your maximum. Spend 10 AP before one of your Actions rolls Accuracy to roll 2d20 and keep the higher result. As Speed 0, exchange your next scheduled IC with the next scheduled IC of a willing, unstun

title: Vanishing Point
text: You do not so much escape notice as leave the part of the fight where attention can find you. Gain +3 Dodge and +4 Stealth. After a full Dodge or successful Hide, immediately move the distance you normally cover in 5 IC. At the end of that movement you may draw, sheathe, or Hide at Speed 0 if legal. Your first Attack within 10 IC gains +3 Accuracy and -2 final Speed. Upgrades From: Exceptionally Fast, Skirmisher

title: Heritage Rules
text: Every player character belongs to Haven Ember and serves in the Ember Corps. Heritage describes ancestry, inherited physiology, family techniques, or surviving schools of training; it does not grant citizenship or allegiance to an old Hidden Village. Choose one Primary Heritage. Mixed ancestry is valid narratively, but only your Primary Heritage grants its starting features, affinities, exclusive abilities, and clan-jutsu access unless a rule explicitly says otherwise. Heritage Cost is paid from

title: Heritage Cost Index
text: 0 UP: Sarutobi, Fūma, Yotsuki, Ouyoku, Karatachi Family, Funato, Iburi, Shiin, Clanless. 1 UP: Nara, Yamanaka, Kamizuru, Hokori, Hoshigaki, Silverhand, Samsara, Jinrō, Jashin Worshipper, Insect Glaive Corps, Vanguard Corps 2 UP: Aburame, Akimichi, Hyūga, Inuzuka, Senju, Uzumaki, Kazekage Clan / Jiton, Shakuton, Yōton, Hōzuki, Yuki, Futton, Jūgo's Bloodline, Karashi (Puppets), Ballistic Corps 3 UP: Uchiha, Bakuton, Kaguya.

title: Clanless
text: HERITAGE - SELF-MADE No bloodline taught you how to survive. No inherited technique promised that you would be strong enough. Everything you know was learned from the people beside you and the places that tried to kill you. Haven Ember is full of shinobi without famous names. Some come from families whose techniques were lost generations ago. Some are refugees, settlers, or children of people who never carried a shinobi lineage at all. Others simply chose not to define themselves by whatever blo

title: No Inheritance
text: While those around you spent their early days inheriting power from their ancient bloodlines, all you inherited was hard work and debt. You start with 100% additional Ryo (100,000 Total), and instead of the Usual 25 Stat Points, you start with 30. Finally, all abilities with the Willpower type cost 50% XP for you, at all stages. Additionally, you gain an additional Talent point every 1500 XP earned (1500XP, 3000XP, 4500XP…)

title: Self-Taught
text: Clanless shinobi are not locked into an inherited curriculum. During each Week's Rest, you may retrain one or more non-Heritage Jutsu or Abilities with a combined XP cost of up to 10. Remove the chosen options, then immediately spend the same amount of XP on other non-Heritage Jutsu or Abilities you currently meet the requirements for. You cannot retrain Talents, Uniques, Attributes, Skills, Heritage options, or anything granted for free. Retraining never grants XP, and any unused portion of thi

title: Jack of All Trades
text: Clanless shinobi are used to reaching for whichever tool works, rather than waiting for the one technique their family taught them. When you make an Attack, Defensive Roll, Skill Check, Status Resistance Roll, Stamina Exhaustion Roll, or Chakra Exhaustion Roll, you may use Adaptability to add +2 to the roll after rolling but before the result is resolved. After using Adaptability, you cannot use it on the same kind of roll as your previous use for the rest of combat. Attack, Defense, Skill, Stat

title: Dig Deep
text: Once per Battle, when you or an ally within 10 yards would fail an Attack, Defensive Roll, Skill Check, Status Resistance Roll, Stamina Exhaustion Roll, or Chakra Exhaustion Roll, you may advance 1 Fatigue Level to add +5 to the result. This can turn a failure into a success. You cannot use Dig Deep if advancing Fatigue would Incapacitate you.

title: Aburame
text: In Haven Ember, Aburame families preserve the old host-bond as a living inheritance rather than a village institution. Their kikaichū make them natural Ember Corps scouts and controllers: patient, information-hungry, and at their best when the enemy is forced to spend time solving the swarm. Starting Features Aburame start with Kikaichu no Jutsu at no XP cost, ignoring its normal requirements. They may start with Elemental Affinity for Clan/General Ninjutsu.

title: Living Colony
text: Kikaichu training is part of the Aburame lineage rather than a separate purchase. You can use your bugs to make skill checks through your Kikaichu at range. The normal rules for communicating with Kikaichu and how long they can survive apart from the Host apply, except their survival away from the Host is increased to a week. GMs may apply a penalty of up to -10 on checks Kikaichu are ill suited for, or disallow checks they simply could not perform. You still perform any relevant actions and pay

title: Predatory Cycle
text: When you place a female insect on a hostile target, you can immediately choose one: Feeding: the target suffers -1 on its next Chakra Exhaustion roll before the end of its next Action. Frenzy: the target suffers 1d4\(NDB) Energy damage every 5 IC for the next CHA/2 IC. After that duration, the insect is removed. Proliferation: place one additional female insect after the normal Delay. This extra insect cannot trigger Predatory Cycle again. Recall: move the Swarm up to CHA/30 yards without AP or

If the Aburame is in Stealth when they use Kikaichu no Jutsu, the Swarm is created with the same Stealth TN. If the Swarm triggers a Chakra roll, its Stealth ends. text: Type: Ninjutsu, Rank C Chakra: 18 Speed: 8 Tags: Interrupt, Utility, Self Requires: Kikaichu no Jutsu active Effects Pull the Swarm across an incoming attack. Choose yourself or one ally inside the Swarm. The Swarm takes the attack's final damage before the protected character. If the attack is single-target and the Swarm still has HP remaining afterward, the protected character is considered not to have been hit. Area attacks still affect the protected character normally, but the Swarm takes on

title: Mushi Bunshin no Jutsu - Bug Clone Technique
text: Type: Ninjutsu, Rank C Chakra: 12 + 4\X Upkeep: X Speed: 14 + X Seal Speed: 6 + 3\X Tags: Utility, Clone Effects Create X Clones, to a maximum of 3. The Clones occupy anywhere in the Swarm, with swirling bug Swarms shifting their position. You don't need to track the clone's exact position and they are immune to area of effect attacks. While this Jutsu is maintained, using the Hide Among Clones action restores all Mushi Bunshin for free and the Area of your swarm is reduced by 20% per clone. If

title: Parasitic Destruction Insect Technique - Kikaichu no Jutsu
text: Type: Ninjutsu, Rank C Range: CHA/10 Area: Up to CHA/10 Speed: 12 Tags: Utility Effects You create a cloud of Kikaichu which cannot be dispersed by abilities that specifically end environmental effects. The Swarm has CHA\10 HP. It can only take damage from Area effects and only takes half damage if the Area doesn’t encompass the entire Swarm. It’s immune to all conditions except for ignite and knockback. The Swarm's HP persists between uses, and heals at a rate of CHA\3 every hour out of combat.

It counts as your Mokuton for Body of the Forest and provides heavy cover. Hostile creatures entering or beginning an Action within the area make Resistance against your Chakra Control. Failure applies Drowsy 2; a target already Drowsy increases its severity by 1, maximum 6. This effect can occur only once per target per 10 IC.

title: Uchiha
text: CANON CLAN — 3 UP In Haven Ember, the Uchiha are heirs to a dangerous legacy rather than residents of a sovereign clan compound. Their strength is breadth under pressure: the Sharingan turns observation into prediction, prediction into imitation, and imitation into a fighting style that becomes harder to solve the longer the duel continues. Starting Features Uchiha begin with Elemental Aptitude for Katon and Elemental Affinity for Katon or Genjutsu.

title: The Curse of Hatred
text: The Uchiha Clan have always had a strong connection to others. You are no different than the rest. Your emotions often overwhelm you, and you find yourself in places where you feel like the entire world is against you - even when everything around you says otherwise. Whenever an ally within your line of sight suffers a Wound, you may designate the enemy responsible as the object of your hatred. Until that enemy is defeated, you gain +2 Accuracy against them and your attacks against them deal +10

title: Sharingan - Copy Wheel Eye
text: The Sharingan manifests as red irises marked by tomoe. It is a power one must unlock through suffering and pain. Activating Sharingan is Speed 0, may be linked to another Action or Interrupt, and has Upkeep 2. None of its abilities function while the Uchiha suffers a Visibility penalty of -6 or worse or otherwise cannot clearly perceive the relevant creature. The mature Sharingan has three stages and stops at three tomoe in this volume.

title: Sharingan, Stage 1
text: You gain Dousatsugan and Saimingan at no XP cost and ignore their normal rank or skill requirements.

title: Sharingan, Stage 2
text: You gain Yogengan and Shouningan at no XP cost. While Sharingan is active, gain +1 to all Skill rolls.

title: Sharingan, Stage 3
text: You gain Magen: Kyouten Chiten and Senchigan at no XP cost. While Sharingan is active, the Stage 2 Skill bonus increases to +2. At Stage 3, Genjutsu used through Saimingan and attacks made with a technique currently retained through Dousatsugan gain +1 Accuracy.

title: Dousatsugan - Eye of Insight
text: Requires: Stage 1 Sharingan You can see chakra flow and read the physical construction of techniques. Gain +4 to defense rolls against Genjutsu. Whenever you clearly witness a valid Taijutsu technique, or a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu that uses handseals, you can copy it. You must still satisfy elemental Aptitudes, special access, and physical requirements; Clan Jutsu, custom Jutsu, Master Techniques, bloodline-exclusive techniques, and effects that rely on physiology you do not possess cannot be copie

title: Reading the Fight
text: While Sharingan is active, whenever a hostile creature you can clearly see completes an Attack, defensive action, handseal sequence, or movement technique, gain 1 Read on that creature, maximum equal to your Sharingan Stage. A creature can grant only 1 Read per 10 IC. Before rolling against that creature, spend Reads one-for-one for +1 Accuracy or +1 to a defensive roll, maximum +3 on a single roll. After a creature with 2 or more Reads rolls a defense against you, you can spend 2 Reads to impos

title: Saimingan - Eye of Hypnotism
text: Requires: Stage 1 Sharingan You can perform single-target Genjutsu without handseals through direct eye contact. The target may avoid eye contact, but doing so imposes the normal Visibility penalties for deliberately refusing to look at you. At Stage 2, Genjutsu cast this way reduce their final Speed by 4. At Stage 3, reduce it by 8 instead and gain +1 Genjutsu Accuracy. Saimingan cannot convert an Area Genjutsu into an eye-contact attack.

title: Shouningan - Eye of Recognition
text: Requires: Stage 2 Sharingan You can read lips when they are clearly visible, reproduce handwriting after watching a short sample, speed-read, and retain visual detail with near-photographic accuracy. Gain +4 to Awareness rolls that materially rely on sight; this stacks with the Stage 2 or Stage 3 Sharingan Skill bonus. Once per scene after watching a creature perform a mundane physical task, you can use your own relevant Skill in place of an untrained Skill roll to reproduce the procedure, thoug

title: Yogengan - Eye of Prediction
text: Requires: Stage 2 Sharingan Once per Fatigue category, when you make a defensive roll against a visible attack, you can treat the d20 as a 10 rather than rolling. At Stage 3, treat it as a 12. You can also take Observe as a Variable Speed Action similar to Guard/Total Defence/Block. Until Observe ends, when a creature you can see attacks you, you can use Yogengan without consuming its once-per-Fatigue-category use.

title: Senchigan - Eye of Foresight
text: Requires: Stage 3 Sharingan When declaring an Action against a creature you can clearly see, name a technique category and a final Speed. The target declares and resolves any legal defense against that declaration. After seeing the defense result, choose any technique you know or currently retain of that category whose final Speed is no greater than the Speed you declared. Resolve the chosen technique using its normal damage calculation, but the declared Speed determines interruption legality an

title: Three-Tomoe Mastery
text: At 3,000 total XP your mature Sharingan becomes more efficient. Your maximum Reads on a creature increases by 2 Senchigan increases the chosen technique's Chakra or Stamina cost by 2 instead of 4. Once per 10 IC, when a creature reaches 4 Reads, mark it Mapped until you lose all Reads on it. Your first Attack and first defensive roll against a Mapped creature each 10 IC gain +2. Retained copied techniques used against the creature you copied them from cost 3 less Chakra or Stamina, minimum 1. Wh

title: Uchiha Fire Doctrine
text: Katon Jutsu reduce their Seal Speed and Chakra cost by 2 per Sharingan Stage, minimum Chakra 1. Damaging Katon Jutsu gain +1 Accuracy at Stage 2 and +2 Accuracy at Stage 3. At Stage 3, a Katon Jutsu that inflicts a Wound increases any Ignite or Burns it applies by 2. If it does not normally apply Ignite or Burns, it instead applies Ignite 2 on a full hit.

title: Uchiha Shuriken Doctrine
text: While Sharingan is active, reduce penalties applied to a Multi-throw to a maximum reduction of 3. After a visible enemy successfully Dodges one of your Projectile Weapon attacks, gain 1 Read on that enemy and retrieve one thrown weapon that could plausibly be recovered by wire or ricochet as Speed 0.

title: Uzumaki
text: Uzumaki bloodlines are prized in Haven Ember for the same reasons old powers feared and courted them: vitality, reserves, and sealing talent. Within the Ember Corps they are natural binders, ward-makers, jailers, and rescue specialists trusted with problems that become catastrophic if containment fails. Starting Features Uzumaki may start with Elemental Affinity for Sealing Jutsu. As an Uzumaki, you can learn your Clan Jutsu regardless of Keywords.

title: Adamantine Heritage
text: Kongō Fūsa - Adamantine Sealing Chains is part of the Uzumaki lineage rather than a separate purchase. Over the course of an IC month, you can bond with one chain, enhancing it with the power of your soul. Bonding to your first chain does not permanently reduce maximum Willpower. You can end your bond as a Downtime Action, and can bond additional specialised chains only if another rule permits it. While you are in contact with your Bonded Chain, you have complete control over each link. Your Bon

title: Uzumaki Life Force
text: Increase maximum Vitality by RES x 3, maximum HP by CHA x 2, and gain +3 to Chakra Exhaustion rolls. Once per combat, when a Chakra Exhaustion failure would advance your Fatigue, you can take HP damage equal to CHA instead and reduce that Fatigue increase by 1 category.

title: Secondary Reserves
text: Type: Ability Base Cost: 5 Scale: 2 Limit: 1 + (Chakra Control Ranks / 7\) Effects You have a secondary fatigue pool with a bonus equal to your ranks in this ability which cannot be increased by anything. You can use this pool to pay for any chakra or stamina cost as if you were rolling for fatigue normally. title: Yamanaka
text: Yamanaka families fit naturally into the Ember Corps’ intelligence and command structure. Their techniques make information immediate, let squads coordinate without shouting, and cross the dangerous border between one mind and another; their best operators know that trust is as important as reach.

Maintaining a network of more than CHA/20 creatures has Upkeep 2. Once this network is established, you can maintain it across a distance of CHA/10 Miles. A willing linked creature may send a short warning, image, direction, or sentence to every other linked creature as part of declaring an Action or Interrupt. title: Sarutobi
text: The Sarutobi name survived because its inheritance was never one miraculous bloodline. Haven Ember remembers generations of disciplined fundamentals, fire release, weapon work, teaching, and stubborn loyalty - exactly the sort of broad competence the Ember Corps can build a squad around.

title: Fūma
text: CANON CLAN Fūma descendants brought an old weapon tradition into Haven Ember’s armouries: giant shuriken, chained steel, false trajectories, and attacks designed to make distance feel temporary. In the Ember Corps, the lineage is valued less for raw numbers than for making cover, range, and angles stop behaving the way an enemy expects.

title: Fūma Skill
text: The Limit for the Quick Hands ability is DEX/18 instead of DEX/20 for you.

title: Fūma Power
text: Whenever you would throw a Shuriken of any kind or size, or any shuriken-like object, you may use your DEX, AGI, STR or CHA for it’s damage bonus. Additionally, you ignore up to one singular penalty to the Accuracy of your Shuriken or Shuriken-like attacks. This could be a wound, or it could be a single level of Fatigue. title: Fūma Mastery
text: Your thrown weapons have no need for ranges. You can hit anything you can physically see, regardless of range. If used in combat, or to attack, the attack gets a -1 to it’s ACC for every 3 yards outside the weapon’s normal range the target is.

title: Fūma Arsenal
text: Type: Ability Base Cost: 8 Scale: 6 Limit: 4 Effects Increase the maximum Range of thrown weapons by 5 yards per rank. Increase the number of weapons you can throw as part of a Multi-Throw by 1 per rank. Once per attack, reduce penalties from Cover against a thrown weapon by 1 per rank.

title: Yotsuki
text: CANON CLAN The Yotsuki bodyguard tradition has an obvious place in the Ember Corps. Old Cloud training survives as service, physical conditioning, and the instinct to put yourself where the impact is about to happen, turning personal durability into time and room for the rest of the squad.

title: Bodyguard’s Instinct
text: When you declare Take the Hit for an ally, you may move up to 2 yards toward that ally before resolving the action. This movement costs no AP or Speed, cannot pass through occupied spaces or solid barriers, and can only be used to enter or maintain a legal position for Take the Hit. If Take the Hit succeeds, the protected ally gains +2 on their next Defensive Roll before the end of their next Action. This bonus is lost if they use it against the same attack that you intercepted.

title: Shoulder of the Cloud
text: Type: Ability Base Cost: 8 Scale: 6 Limit: 4 Gain +1 per rank to Take the Hit rolls. When you successfully Take the Hit for an ally, regain 2 AP per rank, up to your normal maximum. After a successful Take the Hit, reduce the intercepted attack’s Final Damage against you by 5% per rank, counting after all other reductions and reductions. After that attack resolves, the protected ally may move up to 1 yard per rank without AP or Speed.

text: Whenever opposite polarities interact through your Jiton rules, after resolving the normal movement and modifiers, if their combined Magnetize severity is 4 or higher you can either increase the forced movement by 3 yards or make the Jiton damage count as 10% higher for Wounding.

title: Magnetize
text: Magnetize is, in truth, two different Status Effects, Positive Charge and Negative Charge, both of which represent the target having become Magnetized. There is no difference between the Positive and Negative charges of Magnetize except in how the two charges interact with each other. If a target is hit by a Positive or Negative Jiton jutsu they gain a charge of the appropriate type. title: Prepared Sand Reserve
text: A Jiton inheritor begins every mission with a sealed or carried reserve of metal-infused sand equal to 20 + CHA gallons. This reserve is replenished for free during normal downtime and cannot be sold. Drawing up to half of it into the battlefield is a Speed 2 action; drawing all of it is Speed 4. If the character is already carrying it openly, no action is required.
