title: Karashi (Puppets)
text: PUPPET HERITAGE Karashi is Haven Ember’s name for a workshop lineage raised around puppet balance, chakra strings, hidden mechanisms, and the belief that a shinobi’s reach should be limited by imagination rather than anatomy. Puppetry is not theirs alone, but Karashi characters begin inside the craft instead of approaching it from the outside.

title: Starting Features
text: • Gain 3 ranks of Puppet Mastery at no XP cost. These ranks count as purchased for the cost of later ranks. • Learn Kugutsu no Jutsu — Puppet Technique at no XP cost, ignoring its normal learning requirements. • Construct Puppets up to your starting Collection Limit. • You may begin with Elemental Affinity for Clan/General Taijutsu.

title: User
text: The character controlling the Puppets.

title: Collection
text: The Puppets you currently have constructed. Puppets in your Collection are persistent named pieces of equipment with their own Frame, HP, Mounts, Attachments and installed equipment.

title: Thread Limit (TL)
text: The maximum number of Puppets you can have Active through Kugutsu no Jutsu at one time. Unused Thread Limit can instead become Heavy Threads under Concentrated Control.

title: Heavy Thread
text: An unused point of Thread Limit concentrated into a single Puppet under Concentrated Control.

title: Collection Limit (CL)
text: The maximum number of Puppets you can keep constructed at once. Your Collection Limit is twice your Thread Limit.

title: Active Puppet
text: A Puppet currently connected to Kugutsu no Jutsu. Active Puppets have real positions on the battlefield and can be targeted normally.

title: Primary Puppet
text: One Active Puppet is your Primary. Ordinary Puppet Actions are performed through the Primary unless a rule explicitly uses a Support instead.

title: Support Puppet
text: Every other Active Puppet is a Support. Supports have real positions, can be targeted and affected normally, and contribute through Support Routines and techniques that explicitly use them.

title: Inactive Puppet
text: A Puppet in the field but not currently connected to Kugutsu no Jutsu. It cannot act or defend through your control and contributes no Routines. It remains a physical object at its location.

title: Puppet Action
text: An Action you perform through a Puppet. It is still your Action, advances your IC normally and uses your resources unless a rule says otherwise.

title: Frame Range
text: The maximum distance over which a Frame can remain threaded. Puppet movement uses the normal Ember movement rules.

title: Puppet HP
text: Base Puppet HP: 50 + one-third of the User’s maximum Vitality, rounded down. Its Frame then modifies that Base HP. Damage remains on each individual Puppet when it changes between Primary and Support. At 0 HP, a Puppet becomes Disabled for the remainder of the scene, immediately becomes Inactive, and remains a physical object at its location. Recalculate Kugutsu no Jutsu’s Upkeep immediately. Between scenes, ordinary repair returns Puppets to full HP and restores Disabled Puppets at no Ryo or Do

title: Construct Physiology
text: Puppets are Constructs. They are immune to Genjutsu and effects that require a living body, functioning organs, blood, breathing, nerves or a biological mind. Damage to a Puppet never produces Wounds. Physical effects that can affect objects—including Immobilization, Ignite, Knockback, Prone and Visibility—affect Puppets normally. Ignite deals half its normal damage to a Puppet. Immobilization follows the normal Ember rules, with one exception: a Puppet at Immobilization 6 or greater cannot move

title: Malfunction
text: When a single hostile Attack deals at least 50% of a Puppet’s maximum HP after mitigation, that Puppet Malfunctions after the Attack resolves. A Malfunctioning Puppet suffers -2 Accuracy, -2 to Defensive Rolls and -25% movement. A Puppet can have one Malfunction at a time. Field Refit can clear a Malfunction instead of repairing HP.

title: Puppet Statistics
text: When a Puppet itself needs an Attribute: • Use the User’s DEX as its DEX. • Use the User’s AGI as its AGI. • Use the User’s CHA in place of its STR and RES. Use these substitutions only when the Puppet itself needs an Attribute. User-specific STR and RES effects continue to use the User’s own Attributes. A Puppet uses the User’s Skill ranks when it is physically capable of the task and the User has enough information to direct it. Sensory checks from a Puppet’s position require a Sensor Mast or

title: Puppet Action Costs
text: If a Puppet Action normally has a Stamina cost, treat that number as a Chakra cost instead and do not make the Stamina Exhaustion roll. Chakra costs remain Chakra costs normally. A Puppet body may use Ninjutsu or Genjutsu only when a technique or Attachment explicitly permits it. Puppets cannot form handseals. Puppets may use compatible Taijutsu and Bukijutsu the User knows when the Puppet has the required limbs, weapon, Mounts and equipment.

title: Using Your Build
text: Puppet Actions are still the User’s Actions. Abilities, Uniques, Talents, Jutsu, weapon properties and crafted features that modify the declared Action, the mounted weapon, the relevant Taijutsu/Bukijutsu, or the roll being made apply normally when their requirements are met. User-only bodily, sensory, Size, Wound, transformation, passive DR and personal movement effects remain on the User unless an effect explicitly transfers them. Mounted weapons are real weapons. They keep their normal Speed,

title: One Controller, One Turn
text: All Puppet Actions occur on the User’s IC. On the User’s IC, the User declares one Action as normal. If it is a Puppet Action, the Action originates from the Primary Puppet and uses the Primary’s position, equipment and legal targets. It advances the User’s IC by its Final Speed. Cooldowns, once-per-X-IC effects, Delay, Upkeep and similar timing are tracked from the User unless a rule explicitly says that an individual Puppet tracks something separately.

title: Movement
text: Frame Range is a control tether. Active Puppets move using the normal Ember movement rules and must follow legal physical paths. A Primary can use ordinary movement Actions and the normal Move with an Attack options when legal. Formation Shift — Variable Speed, Movement, Utility Choose a Speed of at least 3. Every Active Puppet may move the distance it could normally move during that many IC, following legal paths. This is one Action and advances the User’s IC by the chosen Speed. The User does

title: Control Range
text: The Primary must remain within its Frame Range of the User. A Support must remain within its own Frame Range of either the User or the Primary. A Support cannot anchor another Support. An Active Puppet that ends outside legal Frame Range becomes Inactive immediately. Reconnect it using Kugutsu no Jutsu or another effect that explicitly restores the connection.

title: Puppet Defenses
text: When an Active Puppet is targeted by an Attack, the User may declare any legal Defensive Interrupt through that Puppet. Resolve the Interrupt from the Puppet’s position using its substituted Attributes, equipment and applicable modifiers. Any Defensive Roll uses those values. Pay the Interrupt’s AP, Chakra and other costs from the User; its Final Speed advances the User’s IC normally. When one Attack targets the User and/or multiple Active Puppets, each target may declare and resolve its own leg

title: Choosing the Primary
text: When Kugutsu no Jutsu is activated, choose one Active Puppet as Primary. At the start of your IC, before declaring an Action, you may exchange Primary and Support when a rule such as Thread Weaving permits it. A Primary/Support exchange leaves both Puppets in their current positions unless the effect moves them.

title: Support Puppets
text: Supports contribute through Routines, Formation Shift, defenses and explicit effects. A Support: • has a real position and can be targeted; • can defend through the User as described above; • does not take ordinary Actions; • can move through Formation Shift and explicit effects; • contributes one active Support Routine it knows; • can be used by techniques such as Perfect Synchronization; • stops contributing immediately if Disabled, Inactive or otherwise unable to meet that Routine’s requireme

title: Range Anchoring
text: Whenever a Routine, Attack, Defensive Interrupt or technique originates from a Support, use that Support’s actual position for Range, Reach, Cover, Line of Sight, AoE, terrain and other positional rules.

title: Formations
text: While Kugutsu no Jutsu is active, use Assault Formation or Guard Formation unless Concentrated Control is active. Choose the Formation when Kugutsu no Jutsu is activated. Changing Formation or entering Concentrated Control is a Speed 3 Utility Action when legal.

title: Assault Formation
text: Your strings are spread for pressure and overlapping attack angles. Once per IC, when a damaging Puppet Attack through your Primary fully hits, add one of that Attack’s base Damage Dice. Assault Support Routines function.

title: Guard Formation
text: Your formation collapses inward and the Primary stays close enough to physically protect you. When entering Guard Formation, the Primary may immediately move up to the distance it could normally cover in 3 IC, ending within 5 yards of you. While Guard Formation is active, the Primary must remain within 5 yards of you, gains +1 to its Defensive Rolls, and may use Take the Hit when you are targeted, following the normal Take the Hit rules. Guard Support Routines function. \Any\ Support Routines fu

title: Concentrated Control
text: A master can draw every unused control string inward, driving the attention of an entire formation into a single masterpiece.

title: Entering Concentrated Control
text: Requires: Puppet Mastery 3 While Kugutsu no Jutsu is active and you control exactly one Active Puppet, you may enter Concentrated Control when Kugutsu no Jutsu is activated or as a Speed 3 Utility Action. Your only Active Puppet is your Primary. Concentrated Control replaces Assault and Guard Formation while active. Support Routines apply only through effects that explicitly enable them, such as Lead Support. If another Puppet becomes Active, Concentrated Control ends immediately and you choose

title: Heavy Threads
text: Your Heavy Threads equal your Thread Limit minus 1. They represent every unused control string being tightened into the Primary instead of spread across additional bodies. Concentrated Upkeep — Increase Kugutsu no Jutsu’s Upkeep by Heavy Threads/2, rounded up. This is added after determining its normal Upkeep from Active Puppets. For each Heavy Thread: • Increase the Primary’s maximum HP by 15% of its Frame-adjusted maximum HP, calculated additively and rounded down after all Heavy Threads are c

title: Heavy Thread Maneuvers
text: A Heavy Thread can be Strained to force the Puppet beyond ordinary control. A Strained Heavy Thread still counts for maximum HP and Concentrated Slots, but its +1 Damage Reduction is suppressed and it cannot be Strained again. At the start of your IC, all Strained Heavy Threads refocus. Overdrive — When declaring a Puppet Attack, Strain 1 Heavy Thread. Reduce that Action’s Final Speed by 2, minimum its Base Speed. This changes its actual Final Speed, including IC advancement and Damage Bonus mul

title: Support Routines
text: Each Puppet knows Support Routines according to Puppet Mastery. A Support contributes one Routine at a time. At the start of your IC, choose which known Routine each Support contributes. A Routine with \Assault\ functions only in Assault Formation. \Guard\ functions only in Guard Formation. \Any\ functions in either. If a Routine requires a Mount or Attachment, the contributing Support must possess it and remain able to use it. The same Routine can be contributed by several Supports, but its lis

title: Crossfire — [Assault]
text: Requires: a Weapon Mount or Puppet Mechanism with the Attack tag. When a damaging Puppet Attack through the Primary fully hits, increase that Attack’s Wounding by +5% per active Crossfire, maximum +15%.

title: Angle of Attack — [Assault]
text: Requires: a Weapon Mount or Puppet Mechanism with the Attack tag. If the target of the Primary’s Attack is within that Support’s legal weapon/mechanism Range and the Support has Line of Sight, gain +1 Accuracy per active Angle of Attack, maximum +2.

title: Screen — [Guard]
text: Requires: Ablative Shell, Anchor Spikes, Deployable Cover, or a Reinforced, Juggernaut or Siege Frame. Once per IC when the Primary takes damage, reduce that damage by 5% of its maximum HP per active Screen, maximum 10%, rounded down. Apply this after ordinary percentage reductions.

title: Interception — [Guard]
text: Requires: the Support be able to move and reach the protected target under the normal Take the Hit rules. Once per 10 IC across the entire formation, when the User or Primary is targeted by an Attack, one Support contributing Interception may attempt Take the Hit using the normal Action and timing rules. If successful, that Support becomes the target and resolves any further defense through itself.

title: Mechanic — [Any]
text: Requires: Tool Hands or Field Workshop. Field Refit restores an additional 10% of the target Puppet’s maximum HP per active Mechanic, maximum +20%.

title: Spotter — [Any]
text: Requires: Sensor Mast. If at least one Spotter Support can clearly perceive the Primary’s target, reduce penalties to the Primary’s Attack from Cover, smoke, darkness, weather or distance by 2 per active Spotter, maximum 4.

title: Puppet Mastery
text: Type: Ability Base Cost: 5 Scale: 2 Limit: 3 + total XP/500, maximum 10 The first 3 ranks granted by Karashi count as purchased when determining the cost of later ranks. Rank 1 — Workshop Craft Thread Limit 1. Unlock Small and Medium Frames, Workshop Weapon Mounts and Workshop Attachments. Each Puppet knows one Support Routine. Rank 2 — Specialist Frames Thread Limit 2. Unlock Recon and Reinforced Frames. Rank 3 — Three-Body Method Thread Limit 3. Unlock Assault Formation, Guard Formation, Conce

title: Collection Limit
text: Your Collection Limit is always twice your current Thread Limit.

title: Split Threading
text: Requires: Puppet Mastery 5 While the number of Active Puppets you control is no more than half your Thread Limit, rounded up, maintaining Kugutsu no Jutsu occupies only one hand instead of both.

title: Field Refit
text: Requires: Puppet Mastery 5 \Speed 8 + X, Chakra 10 + 3X, Utility, Puppet\ X is the number of previous times you have used Field Refit this scene. Target one Active Puppet within Frame Range. Choose one: • restore 25% of its maximum HP, rounded down; • clear its Malfunction; or • reset one spent Workshop or Refined Attachment. Each individual Attachment can be reset by Field Refit only once per scene.

title: Thread Weaving
text: Requires: Puppet Mastery 7 Hot Swap — After resolving a Puppet Action through the Primary, you may promote one Support to Primary in its current position. The previous Primary becomes a Support in its current position. Thread Snap — When the Primary becomes Disabled, Inactive or unable to act because it is at Immobilization 6+, immediately promote one legal Support to Primary in its current position. This happens after the triggering effect resolves.

title: Perfect Synchronization
text: Requires: Puppet Mastery 8 When declaring a Puppet Action that the Primary could legally perform, choose one Support that could also legally perform it from its current position. Increase the Action’s Final Speed by 2 and Chakra cost by 5. That Support performs the Action instead of the Primary, using its own Frame, position, Mounts, Attachments and installed equipment. It remains a Support after the Action resolves.

title: Lead Support
text: Requires: Puppet Mastery 9 At the start of your IC, designate one Support as Lead Support. It may contribute two different Support Routines it knows until the start of your next IC. It must meet both Routines’ requirements. Shared maximums still apply. If Concentrated Control is active, at the start of your IC you may Strain 1 Heavy Thread to have the Primary contribute one Support Routine it knows until the start of your next IC. For this exception, treat that Routine’s \Assault\ or \Guard\ For

title: Master of Strings
text: Requires: Puppet Mastery 9 After determining the Final Speed of a Defensive Interrupt made through an Active Puppet, you may spend AP equal to half that Final Speed, rounded up. If you do, that Defensive Interrupt does not advance your IC. Only one Defensive Interrupt against the same incoming Attack can benefit from Master of Strings.

title: Kugutsu no Jutsu — Puppet Technique
text: Type: Ninjutsu, Rank D Chakra: 8 Upkeep: X Speed: 5 Tags: Utility, Puppet, Self Effects This technique requires no handseals. X is the number of Active Puppets you control, minimum 1. Choose up to your Thread Limit of deployed Puppets within 5 yards and connect them with Chakra Strings. They become Active. Choose one as Primary; the others become Supports. If you control exactly one Active Puppet and have Puppet Mastery 3+, you may enter Concentrated Control. Otherwise choose Assault or Guard Fo

title: Kugutsu Kuchiyose no Jutsu — Puppet Summoning Technique
text: Type: Sealing Ninjutsu, Rank D Chakra: 5 + X Speed: 4 + X Seal Speed: 4 Tags: Utility, Puppet, Sealing, Link Requires: Puppet Scrolls Effects Store or release up to X Puppets from Puppet Scrolls you carry. Each Puppet requires one Scroll. Released Puppets appear in legal spaces within 3 yards of you. When used as a Link to Kugutsu no Jutsu, add Chakra +5 + X, Speed +X and Seal Speed +4 instead of using this technique’s standalone Speed. The released Puppets may immediately be selected as Active

title: Kugutsu Henge no Jutsu — Puppet Transformation Technique
text: Type: Ninjutsu, Rank C Chakra: 14 Upkeep: 1 Speed: 8 Tags: Utility, Puppet Requires: Henge no Jutsu, Kugutsu no Jutsu active Effects Transform the Primary to appear as the User. Immediately resolve the normal Hide Among Clones action using the transformed Primary as one Clone, without paying Hide Among Clones’ additional Speed. Make the normal Stealth contest, and thereafter use the normal Observe and random-target rules for being hidden among Clones. The transformation ends if the Puppet become

title: Puppet Substitution
text: Type: Ninjutsu, Rank B Chakra: 20 Speed: 6 Tags: Utility, Puppet, Interrupt Requires: Kugutsu no Jutsu active Effects When the User is targeted by a single-target Attack, swap positions with the Primary. Both positions must be legal and the Primary must be within Frame Range before the swap. Like Take the Hit, Puppet Substitution is legal if its Final Speed is no greater than the triggering Attack’s Final Speed. The Primary becomes the target of the triggering Attack and may declare one legal De

title: Hundred-Hand Performance
text: Type: Ninjutsu, Rank A Chakra: +20 Speed: +2 Special: Once per Scene Tags: Attack, Puppet Requires: Puppet Mastery 10, Kugutsu no Jutsu active Effects Every string in the formation tightens at once. Choose a single-target damaging Basic Weapon Attack, Bukijutsu or Puppet Mechanism Attack available through the Primary that normally makes one Attack against one target. Multi-Throw, Dual Wielding, Area Attacks and Actions that already make multiple Attacks cannot be chosen. Choose one mode: Swarm —

title: Building and Rebuilding Puppets
text: Between scenes, you may construct, retire, rebuild and reconfigure Puppets up to your Collection Limit without spending a Downtime Slot or paying Ryo for the wooden/metal Frame itself. Anything installed that is normally purchased, crafted or consumed still follows its normal rules. Weapons, Ballistic Weapons, ammunition, poisons, Exploding Tags, special materials and consumables all come from your inventory. When you build a Puppet: 1. Choose a Frame. 2. Determine its maximum HP and Frame Range

title: Upgrade
text: An Attachment marked Upgrade modifies one compatible Mount, Attachment or Frame feature named by its text. Unless stated otherwise, a Mount or Attachment can have only one Upgrade.

title: Cosmetic Oddities
text: Each Puppet may have up to three harmless Cosmetic Oddities at 0 Slots: bells, faceplates, tea sets, masks, mascots, voice boxes, tiny shrines and similar flourishes. Cosmetic Oddities provide no numerical benefit.

title: Slot Progression
text: The listed Slots are Base Slots. Every Puppet gains +1 Slot at Puppet Mastery 4 and another +1 Slot at Puppet Mastery 8. Only these Puppet Mastery ranks increase Base Slots. Concentrated Slots are temporary Slots granted by Heavy Threads. Equipment assigned to them is chosen when the Puppet is built or reconfigured between scenes and is active only during Concentrated Control. Real weapons installed in Concentrated Slots remain committed to that Puppet while those Slots are inactive.

title: Base Frame Values
text: Base Puppet HP \= 50 + maximum Vitality/3, rounded down. Base Frame Range \= 10 + CHA/2 yards, rounded down.

title: Small Frame
text: Size: Small Base Slots: 5 HP: 75% Base Puppet HP, rounded down Frame Range: Base +5 yards Special: +2 Dodge, +2 Stealth A compact assassin, courier or skirmisher frame.

title: Medium Frame
text: Size: Medium Base Slots: 6 HP: 100% Base Puppet HP Frame Range: Base Special: +1 Accuracy with Puppet Attacks A balanced general-purpose frame with enough room to specialize.

title: Recon Frame
text: Size: Small Base Slots: 5 HP: 75% Base Puppet HP, rounded down Frame Range: Base +20 yards Special: +5 Stealth; Sensor Mast costs 0 Slots on this Frame A delicate long-range scout and observation platform.

title: Reinforced Frame
text: Size: Medium Base Slots: 5 HP: 150% Base Puppet HP, rounded down Frame Range: Base -5 yards, minimum 5 Special: Damage Reduction equal to CHA/10 + Puppet Mastery, rounded down; +2 to Take the Hit rolls A bodyguard frame built to occupy dangerous space and remain there.

title: Juggernaut Frame
text: Requires: Puppet Mastery 5 Size: Large Base Slots: 6 HP: 175% Base Puppet HP, rounded down Frame Range: Base -10 yards, minimum 5 Movement: -20% Special: Damage Reduction equal to CHA/10 + Puppet Mastery, rounded down A single-body war machine built for Puppeteers who would rather perfect one monster than command six smaller bodies. Heavy Chassis — While this Puppet is your Primary under Concentrated Control, each Heavy Thread increases its maximum HP by an additional 5% of its Frame-adjusted ma

title: Siege Frame
text: Requires: Puppet Mastery 10 Size: Large Base Slots: 8 HP: 200% Base Puppet HP, rounded down Remote Frame Range: 5 yards Special: Damage Reduction equal to CHA/8 + Puppet Mastery, rounded down; -2 Dodge; -2 Parry A walking room, iron beast or piloted siege body. Piloted Core — A Siege Puppet can carry one willing Small or Medium creature. Entering or leaving is a Speed 5 Action while adjacent. While the User pilots their own Siege Primary, they share its position and ignore its Remote Frame Range

title: General Mount Rules
text: A mounted weapon is an ordinary or crafted weapon the User owns. Installing it makes it unavailable to the User’s body until removed between scenes. Mounted weapons retain all normal V6 weapon rules and may be used with compatible Taijutsu and Bukijutsu known by the User. Weapon Mounts count as the limbs/mechanisms needed to wield their installed weapon. A Puppet begins with two functional arms and two functional legs for technique requirements, regardless of cosmetic shape. Additional limbs are

title: Integrated Weapon Mount
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Workshop Install one Small or Medium Melee weapon or one Small Ranged weapon you own.

title: Projectile Hive
text: Slots: 2 Grade: Workshop Choose one type of Small thrown weapon. Load actual weapons from your inventory. The Puppet may use Multi-Throw with that weapon if the User can normally use Multi-Throw with it.

title: Heavy Weapon Mount
text: Slots: 3 Grade: Refined Install one weapon that does not qualify for Integrated Weapon Mount, including Large, Extreme, Two-Handed, Exotic or Ballistic weapons. The Frame must be at least Medium. Extreme weapons require Reinforced, Juggernaut or Siege Frame.

title: Hundred-Arm Array
text: Slots: 3 Grade: Masterwork Upgrade Choose an Integrated Weapon Mount carrying a Small or Medium Melee weapon. It may instead carry up to three qualifying one-handed weapons. The Puppet may use Dual Wielding with them if the User possesses Dual Wielding, following all normal Dual Wielding rules.

title: Mechanism Rule
text: An Attachment with its own Attack profile is a Puppet Mechanism Attack. Puppet Mechanism Attacks: • count as Taijutsu for broad-discipline effects; • use the User’s normal Taijutsu Accuracy unless stated otherwise; • use CHA/18 as their Damage Bonus unless fixed damage says otherwise; • originate from the Puppet using them; • are not Weapon Attacks unless the Attachment explicitly says so; • cannot use Bukijutsu unless explicitly stated. A condition printed directly in a Puppet Mechanism’s Full

title: Adhesive Shot
text: Slots: 2 Grade: Refined Speed: 7 Chakra: 12 Damage: 4d6 Range: 15 Uses: 1 Tags: Attack, Projectile, Blunt Effects On a Full Hit, apply Immobilization 2, or Immobilization 3 at Puppet Mastery 8+. This Immobilization lasts 10 IC.

title: Flame Jet
text: Slots: 2 Grade: Refined Speed: 11 Chakra: 15 Damage: 10d6 Area: Line 2, 15 Uses: 1 Tags: Attack, AoE, Energy Effects Make one Attack against each creature crossed by the Line. On a Full Hit, inflict Ignite equal to 1 + Puppet Mastery/5, rounded down.

title: Chakra Cannon
text: Slots: 3 Grade: Masterwork Requires: Siege Frame Speed: 15 Delay: 5 Chakra: 22 Damage: 8d12 Range: 60 Tags: Attack, Projectile, Energy Effects A long-range siege beam. It deals double Final Damage to mundane terrain, walls, structures and unattended objects.

title: Ablative Shell
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Workshop When this Puppet would take damage, reduce that damage by 15% of its maximum HP, rounded down. Ablative Shell is then spent.

title: Anchor Spikes
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Workshop As a Speed 0 Interrupt when this Puppet would suffer Knockback, anchor it. Reduce that Knockback to 0. While anchored, the Puppet cannot voluntarily move or be moved. Retracting the spikes is a Speed 5 Puppet Action.

title: Aquatic Propulsion
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Workshop The Puppet moves and operates underwater without mundane penalties caused solely by swimming or being submerged.

title: Disguised Shell
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Workshop Choose an ordinary object or animal of similar Size when the Puppet is built. When the Puppet is behaving consistently with the disguise, use the User’s Espionage against observers’ Awareness to identify it as a Puppet. Obvious combat Actions end the deception.

title: Gyroscopic Core
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Workshop The Puppet may stand from Prone as part of its next non-Interrupt Action without increasing that Action’s Speed. It also automatically rights itself after an ordinary uncontrolled fall if physically possible.

title: Poison Reservoir
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Workshop Repeatable Store one prepared dose of a compatible Contact or Injury Poison you own. When declaring an Attack with a compatible mounted weapon, you may apply one stored dose as part of that Attack. The poison is consumed normally.

title: Quick-Release Housing
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Workshop Choose one carried item or weapon. The Puppet can draw, stow, drop or hand that item to an adjacent creature as part of another Action it takes.

title: Recording Lens
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Workshop Record and replay mundane images and audio perceived through the Puppet.

title: Sample Locker
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Workshop Safely store ordinary monster parts, biological samples and similarly hazardous material up to a reasonable amount for the Puppet’s Size.

title: Sensor Mast
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Workshop The User may see and hear from this Puppet’s position while it is Active and make relevant sensory Skill checks from there. Sensory penalties at the Puppet’s location apply normally.

title: Tool Hands
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Workshop The Puppet can manipulate ordinary tools and perform Skill checks that require fine hands when the User can perceive and direct the task. It qualifies for the Mechanic Support Routine.

title: Tool Launcher
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Workshop Choose a compatible consumable when loading the Puppet. The Puppet may deploy that consumable from its position using the consumable’s normal Action, costs and targeting rules.

title: Reinforced Plating
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Workshop Repeatable, maximum 2 Increase this Puppet’s maximum HP by 10% of its Frame-adjusted maximum per copy, calculated additively.

title: Binding Cable Launcher
text: Slots: 2 Grade: Refined The Puppet may use Grab or other compatible Grapple Taijutsu known by the User against a creature within 5 yards as though in Melee Range. The cable is part of the Grapple and can be targeted or broken when the Grapple rules would allow an escape or severing effect.

title: Booster Reel
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Refined Once per 10 IC, when this Puppet would end movement just outside Frame Range, pay 5 Chakra to extend its Frame Range by 15 yards until the end of that movement. If it is still outside normal Frame Range afterwards, it becomes Inactive.

title: Burrowing Drill
text: Slots: 2 Grade: Refined The Puppet may move through mundane earth, sand and similarly soft ground. It cannot pass through reinforced structures or Chakra-enhanced material and cannot end its movement completely enclosed.

title: Chakra Conduit
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Refined Upgrade Choose one mounted Melee weapon. It may benefit from the User’s Chakra Flow, weapon-channeling and similar effects when all other requirements are met.

title: Deployable Cover
text: Slots: 2 Grade: Refined As a Speed 4 Puppet Action, deploy or retract a shield assembly. While deployed, the Puppet counts as solid Cover appropriate to its Size for adjacent creatures and gains +10% Block reduction, but suffers -25% movement.

title: Explosive Failsafe
text: Slots: 2 Grade: Refined Load one Exploding Tag you own. When the Puppet becomes Disabled, you may detonate the loaded Tag from the Puppet’s position as Speed 0 after the triggering Attack resolves. The Tag is consumed. The Puppet is affected by the explosion normally if relevant.

title: Glider Wings
text: Slots: 2 Grade: Refined Requires: Small or Recon Frame The Puppet may move through open air rather than requiring ground contact, but must still use ordinary movement and cannot exceed Frame Range. While at least 1 yard above the ground, it is not affected by Ground-Based effects that require physical contact with the ground. At Immobilization 6+, it descends to the nearest legal surface and cannot take off.

title: Harpoon Reel
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Refined Upgrade Choose one compatible ranged or thrown Weapon Mount. On a Full Hit, instead of any ordinary Knockback from that Attack, you may pull the target up to 5 yards toward the Puppet. A target too large or anchored to be moved instead pulls the Puppet the same distance toward it. This is forced movement.

title: Hidden Weapon Housing
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Refined Upgrade Choose one mounted Small or Medium weapon. The weapon begins each scene concealed. On its first Attack against a creature that has not discovered it, make the User’s Espionage opposed by that creature’s Awareness. On success, apply -2 to that creature’s first Defensive Roll against the Attack.

title: Hollow Body
text: Slots: 2 Grade: Refined Not Small or Recon The Puppet can enclose one willing, helpless or Grappled creature of a Size it could reasonably contain. Entering or removing a willing creature is Speed 6. An enclosed creature has solid Cover and cannot Attack, form handseals, control Puppets or interact outside without leaving.

title: Rotary Drive
text: Slots: 2 Grade: Refined Upgrade Choose one mounted Melee weapon. Its Attacks gain +10% Wounding. A Weapon or Armor used to Block those Attacks takes double normal Durability damage from them.

title: Weapon Carousel
text: Slots: 2 Grade: Refined Upgrade Choose one Weapon Mount that normally carries one weapon. It may contain up to three different weapons that qualify for that Mount. At the start of the User’s IC, choose which one is active. Only the active weapon can be used.

title: Field Workshop
text: Slots: 2 Grade: Masterwork The Puppet qualifies for the Mechanic Support Routine. Once per scene, when Field Refit targets this Puppet or another Active Puppet within 3 yards of it, reduce Field Refit’s Final Speed by 2, minimum 3.

title: Phased Thread Reel
text: Slots: 2 Grade: Masterwork Once per scene when this Puppet would become Inactive solely because it left Frame Range, keep it Active until the end of the User’s next Action. If Concentrated Control already grants this grace period, Phased Thread Reel instead keeps it Active until the end of the User’s following Action. If it has not returned to legal Frame Range by then, it becomes Inactive.

title: Sealed Compartment
text: Slots: 1 Grade: Masterwork Upgrade Choose Hollow Body or Piloted Core. Mundane weather, smoke, dust, contaminated air and ordinary inhaled poisons cannot enter the compartment while sealed. Effects that explicitly penetrate solid Cover or do not need air can still affect the occupant.

title: Wire Guillotine
text: Slots: 2 Grade: Masterwork Upgrade Choose one mounted thrown weapon used with Ninja Wire. Once per 10 IC after an Attack with that weapon misses or is fully Dodged, redirect it toward a second legal target within 10 yards of the first. Make a new Attack at -3 Accuracy and 50% Final Damage. The redirected Attack cannot Wound and cannot trigger Wire Guillotine again.

title: Shakuton
text: RARE KEKKEI GENKAI Scorch Release appears only rarely among Haven Ember families, combining Fire and Wind into murderous dry heat. Ember Corps doctrine treats Shakuton as a bloodline rather than a surname: a specialist inheritance built around penetration, dehydration, and controlling how long an enemy can keep spending resources in the heat.

title: Dehydration
text: You are suffering from extreme Dehydration, with the moisture literally stripped out of your cells, causing skin and bone to become brittle and sapping them of vigor. For every 3 stacks of Dehydrate, your Wounding thresholds are reduced by 5% and the amount of AP you gain every 20 ICs reduced by 1. Every 10 IC you reduce your Dehydration by 1 and when you advance a fatigue level, you halve your Dehydration Status (Rounding up). Additionally, as Speed (X \ 2\) Action, you can drink X gallons of w

title: Dehydration Pressure
text: A creature at Dehydration 4 or higher cannot benefit from regeneration. At Dehydration 6 or higher, all healing it receives is halved. These effects end immediately when Dehydration falls below those thresholds.

title: Scorch Is Lethal
text: Against a target at Dehydration 3 or higher, damaging Shakuton counts as 10% higher for Wounding. Shakuton retains its normal strengths, weaknesses, and counterplay.

title: Scorch Orbs
text: At the start of combat, or as a Speed 8, Chakra 15 action, create three Scorch Orbs, maximum 3+(XP/800). They orbit you until spent or the scene ends. You can spend one Orb for one of the following: Pursuit: +2 Accuracy to one Shakuton Attack. Heat Shield: when targeted by an Attack, gain DR 15 against that attack. Desiccate: after you hit with Shakuton, increase Dehydration inflicted by 1, maximum normal limits. Creating new Orbs while any remain restores the total to three rather than adding m

Any Katon or Fuuton Technique may be converted to Shakuton, with the following effects: +5 Chakra cost Ignores half of the target's DR, and ignores Armor. Where an Aburame host carries the hive within, Kamizuru operators cultivate territory around the squad and make the battlefield itself feel occupied.

In the Ember Corps they are prized as reconnaissance specialists: not because the eye knows everything, but because it can turn a bad angle, a distant silhouette, or a night horizon into actionable information.

title: Bonefield Mastery
text: While inside your Seedling Fern you can move to any point in the area as a Speed 2 Action. As Speed +4 on a non-Interrupt melee Kaguya attack, emerge from another bone and make that attack a Surprise Attack. If a visible creature attempts to leave the area, you can spend 4 AP to move adjacent to it and make one Speed 8 Basic Bone Weapon or Unarmed Attack. On hit, cancel the remaining movement and knock it RES/10 yards toward the centre.

title: Dance Mastery
text: Whenever a Kaguya technique expends 3 or more Skeletal Modifications at once, after it resolves regain one Modification of a different type from those expended. Whenever it expends 6 or more, regain two instead. This cannot return the same Modifications paid into Corpse Bone Chain.

title: Dead Bone Renewal
text: At 3,000 total XP, whenever Skeletal Realignment removes a Major or Severe Wound, recover Vitality equal to RES times the Wound's former severity. Once per Full Rest, you can spend 3 Modifications from one category to downgrade a Critical Blunt, Piercing, or Slashing Wound to Severe before using Realignment normally. This cannot restore death, a destroyed brain, or an effect explicitly stated to be beyond regeneration.

title: Indestructible Skeleton
text: Gain DR equal to RES/5 against Blunt, Piercing, and Slashing damage. When one of those damage types would inflict a Wound, you can expend two Ossification Modifications to reduce the Wound by one severity, potentially negating a Minor Wound. This occurs after all other Wound modifiers.

title: Hōzuki
text: CANON CLAN Hōzuki Hydrification makes its inheritors natural infiltration, escape, and water-combat specialists within the Ember Corps. Flesh becomes water, restraint becomes negotiable, and ordinary physical assumptions stop being reliable - right up until electricity, dehydration, or a badly chosen container reminds them that the technique has rules. Starting Features Hōzuki begin with Elemental Aptitude and Elemental Affinity for Suiton.

title: Partial Hydrification

title: True Hydrification

A Pinning Strike voluntarily reduces that Attack's final damage by 20% and prevents the movement below. If it does not, after damage resolves you can spend 1 internal gallon to flow up to 3 yards through an unoccupied path without increasing your IC. title: Water Reserve
text: Your internal reserve is 20 gallons. You recover all missing internal gallons after a Full Rest with access to drinking water, meaning usually at the end of a scene that includes rest, or after your character is able to spend at least 10 minutes fully submerged in water..

title: Yuki
text: CANON CLAN - RARE Yuki families in Haven Ember preserve Hyōton as a rare Water-and-Wind inheritance. Ember Corps users are taught to think in geometry: mirrors, frozen surfaces, projectiles, and temporary structures that alter sightlines and movement until the enemy is fighting the shape of the ice instead of the person who made it. Starting Features Yuki begin with Elemental Aptitude for Suiton and Fuuton, and Elemental Affinity: Hyōton, which includes Suiton and Fuuton.

title: Hoshigaki
text: CANON CLAN - EXPANDED GAMEPLAY Hoshigaki descendants are unmistakably suited to the maritime work Haven Ember cannot avoid: pursuit, boarding, underwater recovery, and ugly fights where water keeps accumulating. Their shark-like physiology and predatory style are old Water Country inheritances; their loyalty, like every other heritage in this book, belongs to the Ember Corps.

title: Karatachi Family
text: CANON FAMILY The Karatachi name carries the memory of old Mist leadership, but no office follows the bloodline in Haven Ember. What remains is a family tradition of public service, discipline, and competence under pressure - deliberately modest beside the stranger bloodlines around it, and useful for exactly that reason.

title: Stand Your Ground
text: After you finish an Action without voluntarily moving during that Action, you become Braced until the start of your next Action. While Braced: • Gain +2 to Block and Parry. • Gain +3 to rolls made to avoid Aborting an Action because of damage. • Reduce hostile Knockback, pulls, or other forced movement by 2 yards, minimum 0. • Gain +2 on any roll specifically made to remain standing or resist being moved. Braced ends immediately if you voluntarily move. Being moved by an enemy does not end Brace

title: Mist-Born Discipline
text: Type: Ability Base Cost: 8 Scale: 6 Limit: 3 Effects Gain +1 per rank to Stamina Exhaustion rolls and to Resistance rolls against fear-based Immobilization effects. While Braced, also gain +1 per rank to rolls made to resist Stun, Immobilization, Knockback, forced movement, or an effect that would make you Prone, when that effect allows a roll. Once per combat, after rolling one of the above rolls or a roll to avoid Aborting an Action, you may add +2 per rank before the result is resolved.

title: Funato
text: CANON ANIME CLAN - RARE Funato descendants brought an old maritime inheritance into Haven Ember: gill-like markings, comfort in open water, and chakra that answers the sea more readily than a conjured puddle. The Ember Corps uses that gift for patrol, pursuit, recovery, and battles where the horizon matters as much as the ground.

title: Sea Legs
text: Funato are comfortable on moving decks, in surf, and under water long before they learn to weaponise the sea. Gain +2 Athletics and +2 Survival on checks primarily involving swimming, diving, currents, navigation, boats, or remaining stable on a moving vessel. Mundane water, waves, rain, and the motion of a vessel do not impose an Awareness penalty on you by themselves. This does not remove supernatural terrain or environmental effects.

title: Partbreaker
text: Type: Ability Cost: 10 Limit: 1 Effects When a Melee Weapon Attack with your Vanguard Arm damages Armor Durability, a physical Barrier, an object, or a destructible monster part, deal +50% damage to that object's Durability. This bonus applies after the Attack's normal damage is determined.

title: Adaptive Arsenal
text: Type: Ability Cost: 10 Limit: 1 Effects Choose a second Vanguard Discipline for which you own a qualifying weapon. At the beginning of a scene, choose either of your prepared Disciplines as your current Discipline without spending a Downtime Slot. Once per scene, while wielding a qualifying weapon for your other prepared Discipline, you may change to it with a \Speed 5, Utility\ action. All resources from the previous Discipline are lost. title: Veteran Hunter
text: Type: Ability Cost: 15 Limit: 1 Requires: 2,500 total XP, Partbreaker Effects When you consume Hunter's Opening, you may take both benefits instead of choosing one: the Attack gains Final Speed -1 and +1 Damage Die. This does not create a second Opening.

title: Hunter's Step
text: Type: Bukijutsu, Rank D Stamina: 10 Speed: +2 Tags: Link, Weapon, Movement Effects Link to a Melee Weapon Attack with your Vanguard Arm. After the Attack fully resolves, move up to 2 yards without AP. This movement cannot pass through creatures or solid barriers. If the linked Attack consumed Hunter's Opening, increase this movement to 3 yards.

title: Breaker Strike
text: Type: Bukijutsu, Rank C Stamina: 16 Damage: As Weapon Speed: As Weapon +3 Tags: Attack, Melee, Weapon Effects Make a Melee Weapon Attack with your Vanguard Arm. It deals +50% damage to Armor Durability, physical Barriers, objects and destructible monster parts. If Partbreaker also applies, these bonuses are additive rather than multiplicative.

title: Punishing Draw
text: Type: Bukijutsu, Rank B Stamina: 22 Damage: As Weapon +2 Damage Dice Speed: As Weapon +3 Tags: Attack, Melee, Weapon Requires: Hunter's Opening against the target Effects Consume Hunter's Opening and make a Melee Weapon Attack against that creature. In addition to Punishing Draw's listed bonus Damage Dice, choose one normal Hunter's Opening benefit and apply it to this Attack. Veteran Hunter does not allow Punishing Draw to receive both Opening benefits.

title: Vanguard Execution
text: Type: Bukijutsu, Rank A Stamina: 30 Damage: As Weapon +4 Damage Dice Accuracy: +1 Speed: As Weapon +5 Tags: Attack, Melee, Weapon Effects Make a Melee Weapon Attack with your Vanguard Arm. If the target currently has a Major Wound, destroyed Armor, or a destroyed monster part, the Attack gains +100% Wounding. After Vanguard Execution resolves, all stored resources from your current Vanguard Discipline are lost. This includes Charge, Spirit, Demon, Impact Charge, Notes, Shells, Switch and Phials.

title: Ballistic Corps
text: WEAPON TRADITION - SETTING ORIGINAL Heritage Cost: 2 UP The Ballistic Corps are Haven Ember's gunners, ammunition specialists and hunter-engineers: the people trusted with weapons that turn sealed powder, chakra coils and monster-bone machinery into portable thunder. The tradition began in the Ashen Anvil's Ballistics Annex, where recovered firearms and industrial launchers were rebuilt for shinobi combat. Their weapons are not mass-produced guns. Every chamber is fitted, every recoil system tun

title: Ballistics Certification
text: Only characters with the Ballistic Corps Heritage may wield a weapon with the Firearm or Ballistic tag unless a rule explicitly states otherwise. This is a hard Heritage restriction. Characters without this Heritage cannot make Ballistic Attacks, Reload or Brace a firearm, benefit from Ballistic Attachments, use specialist Ballistic ammunition, or use Ballistic Modifications. They may carry, sell, transport or study the equipment, but possessing it never grants access to its combat rules. Genera

title: The Hunter Arm
text: You begin with one custom Hunter Arm at no Ryo cost and three Standard Loads. Choose one Frame and spend 4 Modification Points on Ballistic Modifications. Your Hunter Arm is always considered a Ballistic Weapon and a Firearm. Modification Points are not Artisan Points. They do not count toward normal Weapon Crafting prerequisites or tier requirements. The modifications below may only be installed on your Hunter Arm unless another rule explicitly allows otherwise. You may redesign any number of y

title: Loaded for the Hunt
text: Ballistic Corps hunters are trained to treat ammunition choice and firing position as part of the attack rather than bookkeeping between attacks. Immediately after one of your Ballistic Attacks fully resolves, choose one: - Cycle - Exchange the currently loaded magazine for another compatible Load you are carrying. Preserve the remaining ammunition in both magazines. - Set - Become Braced if you have not voluntarily moved since the beginning of the triggering Attack. - Reposition - Move up to 2

title: Corps Refit
text: At Trailhand or 2,500 total XP, whichever comes first, the Ballistics Annex rebuilds your Hunter Arm around the hunter you have become. Gain 4 additional Modification Points. These points may be redesigned normally with the rest of your weapon.

title: Report
text: Unless a weapon or Modification says otherwise, firing a Ballistic Weapon immediately ends ordinary Stealth and creates an obvious report. Spent cases, darts, sabots, scorch marks and seal residue may be tracked or studied normally.

title: Magazine (X)
text: The weapon may make X normal attacks before it is empty. A normal Attack consumes 1 ammunition. Burst and specialist effects may consume more.

title: Reload (X)
text: Reloading is a Speed X Utility action with no additional Stamina cost. You must have a compatible Load available. A Load refills the weapon to its full Magazine value. Removing a partially used magazine does not destroy the remaining ammunition. Track it separately until used again.

title: Brace
text: Brace is a Speed 5 Utility action. You remain Braced until you voluntarily move or are forcibly moved. Dodging also breaks your brace. Effects may alter how easily you lose Braced.

title: Burst
text: When declaring a Ballistic Attack with a Burst weapon, you may consume 3 ammunition. The Attack gains +2 Damage Dice, +2 Stamina and +1 Base Speed. Burst remains one Attack and may only modify an Attack once.

title: Full Auto
text: When a Ballistic Weapon with the Burst property gains it again, the weapon instead gains access to this special Variable Speed Action — Full Auto: \Variable Speed, Variable Stamina, Attack, Ballistic. When you declare it, choose a value of X between 2 and the number of complete 3-Round Bursts remaining in the Weapon’s Magazine, to a maximum of 5. Consume 3 × X Ammunition. The Action’s Speed becomes the Weapon’s Base Speed + X. The Action’s Stamina becomes the Weapon’s normal Stamina + (2 × X). D

title: Heavy
text: Firing a Heavy weapon while not Braced gives the Attack -1 Accuracy and +2 Stamina.

title: Siege
text: A Siege weapon must be Braced before it can declare an Attack. If its wielder is moved after declaring the Attack but before it resolves, the Attack is cancelled.

title: Scoped
text: A Scoped weapon gains the Aim action: \Speed 5, Utility. Your next Ballistic Attack with that weapon before you move gains +1 Accuracy, then consumes the Aim bonus.

title: Scatter Frame
text: The weapon can safely chamber Scatter Loads.

title: Chakra-Driven
text: When declaring an Attack, you may increase that attack’s cost by +5 Chakra to use the higher of DEX / 24 or CHA / 24 as BDB. The Attack counts as chakra-enhanced wherever that distinction matters. Chakra-Driven weapons can safely chamber Elemental Loads.

title: Sidearm Frame
text: Type: Small, One-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing Speed: 8 Stamina: 9 Damage: 3d6 Accuracy: +1 Parry: +0 Range: 12 yards Delay: 4 Durability: 30 Magazine: 6 Reload: 5 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Tranq, Tracking Dye Frame Trait: Quickdraw - Drawing the Sidearm as part of a Ballistic Attack does not increase that Attack's Speed.

title: Light Bowgun Frame
text: Type: Medium, Two-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing Speed: 9 Stamina: 11 Damage: 4d8 Accuracy: +1 Parry: +0 Range: 20 yards Delay: 5 Durability: 40 Magazine: 6 Reload: 5 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Slicing, Tranq, Tracking Dye Frame Trait: Mobile Frame - After a Ballistic Attack with this weapon resolves, you may move 1 yard without Speed or AP. This cannot be combined with Reposition from Loaded for the Hunt.

title: Heavy Bowgun Frame
text: Type: Large, Two-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing, Heavy Speed: 13 Stamina: 15 Damage: 6d10 Accuracy: +0 Parry: -1 Range: 30 yards Delay: 8 Durability: 50 Magazine: 5 Reload: 7 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Scatter, Sticky, Tranq Frame Trait: Set the Stock - While Braced, Ballistic Attacks with this weapon gain +1 Damage Die.

title: Machine Pistol Frame
text: Type: Small, One-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing Speed: 8 Stamina: 10 Damage: 3d6 Accuracy: +0 Parry: -1 Range: 10 yards Delay: 4 Durability: 28 Magazine: 9 Reload: 6 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Tranq, Tracking Dye Frame Trait: Compact Burst - When you use Burst with this weapon, ignore Burst's +1 Base Speed. Its ammunition and Stamina costs are unchanged.

title: Carbine Frame
text: Type: Medium, Two-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing Speed: 8 Stamina: 11 Damage: 4d8 Accuracy: +1 Parry: +0 Range: 24 yards Delay: 4 Durability: 38 Magazine: 9 Reload: 5 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Slicing, Tranq, Tracking Dye Frame Trait: Short-Stroke Action - After you Reload this weapon, your next normal Ballistic Attack before you move gains Final Speed -1. Burst and Full Auto cannot benefit.

title: Scattergun Frame
text: Type: Medium, Two-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing, Scatter Frame Speed: 10 Stamina: 12 Damage: 5d8 Accuracy: +0 Parry: +0 Range: 12 yards Delay: 6 Durability: 42 Magazine: 4 Reload: 6 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Scatter, Sticky, Tranq Frame Trait: Breach Pattern - When you fire Scatter ammunition at half Range or closer, add 1 additional Damage Die.

title: Marksman Frame
text: Type: Large, Two-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing, Scoped Speed: 12 Stamina: 13 Damage: 5d10 Accuracy: +1 Parry: -1 Range: 45 yards Delay: 7 Durability: 42 Magazine: 5 Reload: 7 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Slicing, Tracking Dye Frame Trait: Cold Bore - A Ballistic Attack that consumes your Aim bonus gains +1 Damage Die.

title: Hand Cannon Frame
text: Type: Medium, One-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing Speed: 12 Stamina: 14 Damage: 5d10 Accuracy: -1 Parry: -1 Range: 15 yards Delay: 7 Durability: 40 Magazine: 3 Reload: 7 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Sticky Frame Trait: Kickback - After an Attack with this weapon resolves while you are not Braced, move 1 yard directly away from the target. You may take +2 Stamina on the Attack instead. This movement cannot trigger another movement effect.

title: Rotary Repeater Frame
text: Type: Large, Two-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing, Heavy Speed: 12 Stamina: 14 Damage: 3d10 Accuracy: +0 Parry: -1 Range: 22 yards Delay: 5 Durability: 55 Magazine: 18 Reload: 9 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Tranq, Tracking Dye Frame Trait: Rotary Feed - Burst consumes 2 ammunition instead of 3 when fired from this Frame. Full Auto still consumes 3 × X ammunition normally.

title: Extended Magazine
text: Increase Magazine by 2. May be taken twice.

title: Long Barrel
text: Increase Range by 5 yards, or by 10 yards on a Heavy Bowgun. Limit 1.

title: Quick Feed
text: Reduce Reload by 1. May be taken twice, to a minimum of half the Frame's original Reload.

title: Reinforced Receiver
text: Increase Durability by 20%. Limit 1.

title: Hunter Scope
text: Gain the Scoped property. Limit 1.

title: Balanced Stock
text: Improve the weapon's Parry modifier by +1. Limit 1.

title: Specialist Feed
text: Gain compatibility with one of Pierce, Slicing, Sticky, Tranq or Tracking Dye Loads. May be taken multiple times, choosing a different Load each time. This cannot grant Scatter, Elemental or Wyvern compatibility.

title: Quick Ejector
text: When the weapon is empty, reduce its Reload by 1 after all other modifiers, to a minimum of 3. Limit 1.

title: Recoil Pad
text: If the weapon has Heavy, its unbraced Stamina surcharge is +1 instead of +2. If it does not have Heavy, reduce forced movement caused by firing your own Ballistic Arts by 1 yard. Limit 1.

title: Low-Profile Optics
text: Requires Scoped. Moving up to 1 yard after you Aim does not remove that Aim bonus. Moving farther still removes it normally. Limit 1.

title: Sealed Magazine
text: Choose one compatible ammunition type when installed. Limit 1.

title: Snap Sling
text: Drawing this weapon as part of a Ballistic Attack does not increase that Attack's Speed. Heavy and Siege weapons cannot benefit. Limit 1.

title: Blast Shroud
text: Firing still ends ordinary Stealth and creates a report, but creatures more than 20 yards away cannot determine your exact firing position from sound alone. Scatter Loads and Wyvern Shells cannot benefit. Limit 1.

title: Scatter Chamber
text: Gain the Scatter Frame property and compatibility with Scatter Loads. Limit 1.

title: Chakra Coil
text: Gain the Chakra-Driven property and compatibility with Elemental Loads. Limit 1.

title: Burst Mechanism
text: Gain the Burst property. Limit 2.

title: Recoil Brake
text: If the weapon has Heavy, remove the -1 Accuracy penalty for firing while unbraced. The additional +2 Stamina remains. If the weapon does not have Heavy, reduce forced movement caused by firing your own Ballistic Arts by 2 yards. Limit 1.

title: Tracking Assembly
text: Tracking Dye Loads fired from this weapon deal 2 Damage Dice instead of 1 and may add BDB normally. Limit 1.

title: Precision Barrel
text: Requires Scoped. A Ballistic Attack that consumes your Aim bonus gains +1 Damage Die. Limit 1.

title: Short Barrel
text: Reduce the weapon's listed Range by 25%, rounded normally, and reduce its Base Speed by 1. Cannot be combined with Long Barrel. Limit 1.

title: Overpressure Chamber
text: Increase the weapon's Damage by +1 Damage Die. All Ballistic Attacks with it gain +2 Stamina and +1 Delay. Limit 1.

title: Choke Assembly
text: Requires Scatter Frame. Scatter Loads gain their close-range bonus at two-thirds of the weapon's listed Range or closer instead of half Range. Limit 1.

title: Gyro Stabilizer
text: While Braced, forced movement of 2 yards or less does not remove Braced from you. A Siege Attack is still cancelled if you are moved before it resolves. Limit 1.

title: Capacitor Seal
text: Requires Chakra-Driven. When you pay Chakra to use Chakra-Driven or an Elemental Load, reduce the total Chakra paid for that Attack by 2, to a minimum of 1. Limit 1.

title: Quick Brace Assembly
text: Reduce the Speed of Brace by 1, to a minimum of 3. Limit 1.

title: Braced Loader
text: While you are Braced, reduce this weapon's Reload by 1, to a minimum of 3. Limit 1.

title: Lightened Chassis
text: Reduce Base Speed by 1. Increase the Stamina of all Ballistic Attacks with this weapon by 2 and reduce its Durability by 10%. Cannot be combined with Counterweighted Chassis. Limit 1.

title: Counterweighted Chassis
text: Reduce the Stamina of all Ballistic Attacks with this weapon by 2. Increase Base Speed by 1 and increase its Durability by 10%. Cannot be combined with Lightened Chassis. Limit 1.

title: Dual Feed
text: The weapon can hold two compatible Loads at once. Each feed has its own remaining ammunition, up to the weapon's normal Magazine value. Choose which feed is used whenever you Attack. Reloading one feed does not reload the other. Limit 1.

title: Guard Plate
text: Requires Heavy Bowgun Frame. The weapon may use the normal Weapon Block action. While Braced, improve the weapon's Block reduction by 10%. Limit 1.

title: Wyvern Chamber
text: Requires Heavy Bowgun Frame. Gain compatibility with Wyvern Shells. Limit 1.

title: Rotary Action
text: Requires Burst. Burst consumes 2 ammunition instead of 3. Increase the weapon's Reload by 1. Limit 1.

title: Heavy Receiver
text: Requires a weapon without Heavy. Gain the Heavy property, +1 Damage Die and +10 Durability. Increase Base Speed by 1 and Stamina by 2. Limit 1.

title: Universal Chamber
text: Gain compatibility with Pierce, Slicing, Sticky, Tranq and Tracking Dye Loads. This does not grant Scatter, Elemental or Wyvern compatibility. Limit 1.

title: Buckler Housing
text: The weapon may use the normal Weapon Block action. This grants no additional Block reduction by itself. Limit 1.

title: Accelerator Coil
text: Requires Chakra-Driven. Whenever you activate Chakra-Driven, you may pay 2 additional Chakra. If you do, that Attack gains +1 Damage Die and +5 yards Range. Limit 1.

title: Burst Regulator
text: Requires Burst. When you use Burst, it adds +3 Damage Dice instead of +2, but its additional Stamina becomes +4 and its additional Base Speed becomes +2. Limit 1.

title: High-Capacity Drum
text: Increase Magazine by 50%, rounded up. Increase Reload by 2. Limit 1.

title: Dampened Action
text: Reduce the weapon's Delay by 1, to a minimum of 2. All Ballistic Attacks with it gain +2 Stamina. Limit 1.

title: Tripod Mount
text: Requires Heavy or Siege. Brace has Speed 3 with this weapon. While Braced, increase its listed Range by 5 yards. Limit 1.

title: 4 Modifications
text: These modifications require 2,500 total XP.

title: Siege Conversion
text: Requires Heavy Bowgun Frame. Gain the Siege property. Increase Damage by +2 Damage Dice and Range by 10 yards. Increase Base Speed by 2. Magazine becomes 1 and Reload increases by 3. Limit 1.

title: Monster Bore
text: When a Ballistic Attack from this weapon damages Armor Durability, a physical Barrier, or a destructible monster part, deal an additional 25% damage to that object's Durability. Limit 1.

title: Belt Feed
text: Requires Burst. Double the weapon's Magazine and increase Reload by 3. The weapon gains Heavy if it does not already have it. Limit 1.

title: Full-Auto Compensator
text: Requires Full Auto. Full Auto adds X Stamina instead of 2 × X Stamina. Its ammunition cost, Accuracy penalty, Speed and damage are unchanged. Limit 1.

title: Servo Brace
text: Requires Heavy or Siege. While Braced, Ballistic Attacks with this weapon gain Final Speed -1 and -2 Stamina. Limit 1.

title: Auto-Sealing Ejector
text: When an Attack leaves this weapon empty, your next Reload with it before the end of your next Action gains Final Speed -2. Limit 1.

title: Anti-Materiel Rifling
text: Pierce Loads fired from this weapon no longer reduce the Attack by 1 Damage Die. All of their other effects remain unchanged. Limit 1.

title: Elemental Resonator
text: Requires Chakra-Driven. An Elemental Load fired from this weapon gains +1 Damage Die without increasing its Chakra cost. Limit 1.

title: Self-Leveling Mount
text: Requires Heavy or Siege. Dodging does not remove Braced from you. Any movement caused by that Dodge still removes Braced normally if it moves you. Limit 1.

title: 5 Point Modifications
text: These modifications require 4,000 total XP.

title: Full-Auto Governor
text: Requires Full Auto and 4,000 total XP. Increase Full Auto's maximum X from 5 to 6. You must still possess enough ammunition to pay 3 × X. Limit 1.

title: Autoloader Core
text: Requires 4,000 total XP. When an Attack empties this weapon, you may consume one compatible Load after the Attack resolves to refill the weapon to half its Magazine, rounded up. This counts as a Reload but has no Speed. It cannot trigger from a Wyvern Shell or Wyvern Execution. Limit 1.

title: Anti-Materiel Conversion
text: Requires 4,000 total XP and a non-Small Frame. Gain Heavy and +2 Damage Dice. Increase Base Speed by 2, Stamina by 3 and Reload by 2. Reduce Magazine by 50%, rounded up. Limit 1.

title: Elemental Reactor
text: Requires 4,000 total XP and Chakra-Driven. When firing an Elemental Load, you may increase the CE cost by 3 additional Chakra to add +2 Damage Dice to the Attack. Limit 1.

title: Fortress Housing
text: Requires 4,000 total XP and Buckler Housing or Guard Plate. While Braced, improve this weapon's Block reduction by 15%. This replaces, rather than stacks with, the bonus from Guard Plate. Limit 1.

title: 6 Point Modifications
text: These modifications require 5,000 total XP.

title: Rail Conversion
text: Requires 5,000 total XP, Chakra-Driven and Scoped. When a Ballistic Attack consumes your Aim bonus, you may add +8 Chakra Cost. That Attack gains +2 Damage Dice and +10 yards Range, but also +1 Base Speed. Limit 1.

title: Cyclone Feed
text: Requires 5,000 total XP and Full Auto. For Full Auto only, each point of X consumes 2 ammunition instead of 3, and the maximum available X is determined from complete 2-round segments. Increase this weapon's Reload by 2. Limit 1.

title: Siege Stabilizer
text: Requires 5,000 total XP and Siege. If you are forcibly moved 2 yards or less after declaring a Siege Attack, the Attack is not cancelled. You lose Braced after it resolves. Voluntary movement still cancels the Attack. Limit 1.

title: Titan Receiver
text: Requires 5,000 total XP and Heavy. Increase Damage by +2 Damage Dice and Durability by 20. Increase Base Speed by 2, Stamina by 3 and Reload by 1. Limit 1. ---

title: Ballistic Ammunition
text: A weapon may only load ammunition listed in its Compatible Ammo line or granted by one of its Modifications. A Load fills one magazine regardless of the weapon's exact Magazine value; this is an abstraction for play.

title: Standard Load
text: Cost: 800 Ryo per Load Reliable jacketed shot, hardened darts, ceramic slugs or whatever the weapon was built to throw. No special modifier.

title: Pierce Load
text: Cost: 1,200 Ryo per Load Reduce the Attack by 1 Damage Die. Gain +5% Wounding and deal +50% damage to Armor Durability, physical Barriers and objects.

title: Scatter Load
text: Cost: 1,000 Ryo per Load Requires Scatter Frame. At half the weapon's listed Range or closer, add +2 Damage Dice. Beyond half Range, instead suffer -1 Accuracy. Scatter does not change the number of creatures hit.

title: Slicing Load
text: Cost: 1,500 Ryo per Load Reduce the Attack by 1 Damage Die, change its damage type to Slashing, and gain +5% Wounding.

title: Sticky Load
text: Cost: 1,800 Ryo per Load On a hit, deal no immediate weapon damage. Five IC later the lodged charge detonates for half the weapon's normal Damage Dice, rounded up, using the same die size. Sticky damage gains no BDB and cannot Wound by itself, but deals double damage to Armor Durability, objects and physical Barriers. You may have only one Sticky charge lodged in the same target at a time.

title: Elemental Load
text: Cost: 2,000 Ryo per Load Requires Chakra-Driven. Add +5 CE to the cost of your attack. Choose the elemental nature the Load was prepared for. The Attack changes to that damage type and may use CHA / 24 instead of DEX / 24 for BDB. This does not automatically apply an elemental condition.

title: Tranq Load
text: Cost: 1,000 Ryo per Load Reduce the Attack by 2 Damage Dice and make it Non-Lethal. Against a Hunt target with an explicit capture or tranquilizer condition, a successful hit counts as one valid tranquilizer application. The monster profile determines the remaining requirements.

title: Tracking Dye Load
text: Cost: 600 Ryo per Load The Attack deals only 1 Damage Die and gains no BDB. On hit, mark the target with bright alchemical dye and chakra-reactive scent for the rest of the scene. Track or Survival rolls made specifically to follow that creature gain +2 while the mark remains.

title: Wyvern Shell
text: Cost: 3,000 Ryo per Shell Requires Heavy or Siege and explicit Wyvern compatibility. The Attack gains +4 Damage Dice, +5 Base Speed, +5 Stamina and +10% Wounding. Firing a Wyvern Shell empties the current magazine regardless of remaining ammunition. The weapon cannot begin Reloading until 5 IC after the Attack resolves. ---

title: Talent: *Personal Pattern*
text: The oldest Ballistic Corps hunters say that every great gun eventually stops being a model and becomes a name. Parts are replaced until nothing remains of the original weapon except the decisions that shaped it. The Personal Pattern talent path represents that relationship: not a mystical soul-bond, but years of field notes, custom tolerances, monster parts, favourite ammunition and tiny adjustments that make a weapon function properly for exactly one hunter.

title: Named Pattern
text: Type: Talent Requires: Ballistic Corps, 1,000 total XP, and at least 1 IC month using the same Hunter Arm Effects Choose one of your Hunter Arms. It becomes your Named Arm. Your Named Arm gains 2 additional Modification Points. These points follow all normal Modification rules. Only you can benefit from Modification Points or Signature Mechanisms granted by this Talent Path. In another character's hands, the weapon functions as though those Talent features were absent. You may move your Named Pa

title: Signature Pattern
text: Type: Talent Requires: Named Pattern, 2,000 total XP Effects Choose one Signature Mechanism for your Named Arm. You gain its Tier I effect. If a Signature has a property or Frame requirement, your Named Arm must meet it to select or benefit from that Signature. Changing your Signature Mechanism requires 2 Downtime Slots during a Week's Rest.

title: Quickdraw Mechanism
text: Tier I — The first Ballistic Attack you make after drawing or Reloading your Named Arm gains Final Speed -1. Tier II — The same Attack gains Final Speed -2 instead.

title: Predator Glass
text: Requires: Scoped. Tier I — An Attack that consumes your Aim bonus also gains +5% Wounding. Tier II — You may Aim twice before firing. The second Aim grants a second +1 Accuracy. Moving removes both bonuses.

title: Three-Round Seal
text: Requires: Burst. Tier I — Burst adds +3 Damage Dice instead of +2. Tier II — If your previous Ballistic Attack was a Burst against the same target, the new Burst Attack also gains +1 Accuracy. Moving, Reloading, or changing targets breaks the pattern.

title: Fangburst Chamber
text: Requires: Scatter Frame. Tier I — At half Range or closer, Scatter ammunition adds +3 Damage Dice instead of +2, but the Attack gains +1 Delay. Tier II — Ignore that +1 Delay.

title: Breach Teeth
text: Tier I — Ballistic Attacks with the Named Arm deal +50% damage to Armor Durability, physical Barriers and objects. Tier II — Increase this bonus to +100%.

title: Anchored Spine
text: Requires: Heavy or Siege. Tier I — If you have remained Braced and have not moved for at least 10 IC, Standard and Pierce Attacks gain +1 Damage Die. Tier II — They gain +2 Damage Dice instead.

title: Stormrail Coil
text: Requires: Chakra-Driven. Tier I — Elemental Loads fired from the Named Arm cost only 3 Chakra to activate. Tier II — Choose one elemental nature you possess an Affinity for. Elemental Loads prepared for that nature may use CHA / 20 instead of CHA / 24 for BDB.

title: Master Pattern
text: Type: Talent Requires: Signature Pattern, 3,000 total XP Effects Your Named Arm gains 2 additional Modification Points. Your chosen Signature Mechanism improves to Tier II. Additionally, when your Named Arm is destroyed or permanently lost, you retain its Pattern. Rebuilding it costs the normal replacement chassis cost and one Downtime Slot, but all Talent-granted Modification Points and Signature features return with the rebuilt weapon.

title: Twin Pattern
text: Type: Talent Requires: Master Pattern, 4,000 total XP Effects You have learned to maintain two personal weapons to the same impossible tolerances. You may designate a second Hunter Arm as a Named Arm. It gains all benefits of Named Pattern and Master Pattern, including their 4 total bonus Modification Points. Choose a Signature Mechanism for the second weapon separately. It begins at Tier II and must meet its own requirements. Any once-per-scene effect granted by this Talent Path is shared betwe

text: Type: Ability Cost: 10 Limit: 1 Effects Choose one Doctrine. You may change Doctrine with one Downtime Slot during a Week's Rest. Skirmisher - After you use Reposition, your next Ballistic Attack before the end of your next Action gains Final Speed -1. You cannot benefit from this while Braced. Forced movement of less than 3 yards does not remove Br

title: Ammunition Savant
text: Type: Ability Cost: 10 Limit: 1 Effects When you fire a non-Standard Load, choose one benefit: ● Ignore 1 Damage Die reduction imposed by that ammunition. ● Reduce additional Stamina imposed by that ammunition by 2. ● Reduce additional Base Speed imposed by that ammunition by 1. Ammunition Savant cannot remove a restriction, compatibility requirement, ammunition cost, delayed effect or post-shot lockout.

title: Field Loader
text: Type: Ability Cost: 12 Limit: 1 Requires: Ammunition Savant Effects Whenever an Attack leaves your Ballistic Weapon empty, your next Reload with that weapon before the end of your next Action gains Final Speed -2. Additionally, Cycle from Loaded for the Hunt may exchange to a partially used magazine or a fresh Load without requiring you to declare which one until Cycle resolves.

title: Master Gunsmith
text: Type: Ability Cost: 15 Limit: 1 Requires: 2,500 total XP, Gunner's Doctrine Effects Gain 3 additional Modification Points for your Hunter Arm. Once per Week's Rest, you may redesign your Hunter Arm's Modifications without spending a Downtime Slot if you have access to the Ballistics Annex or an equivalent workshop. Changing Frame still follows its normal cost.

title: Recoil Step
text: Type: Bukijutsu, Rank D Stamina: 10 Speed: +2 Tags: Link, Weapon, Movement, Ballistic Effects Link to a Ballistic Attack. After the Attack resolves, move up to AGI / 20 yards directly away from the target, maximum 5 yards. If the weapon has Heavy, halve this movement unless you were Braced when the triggering Attack was declared. This movement cannot pass through creatures or solid barriers.

title: Quick Chamber
text: Type: Bukijutsu, Rank D Stamina: 8 Speed: 3 Tags: Utility, Weapon, Ballistic Effects Exchange your currently loaded ammunition for another compatible Load you are carrying. If the weapon was empty when Quick Chamber began, the new Load enters with ammunition equal to half the weapon's Magazine, rounded up. Otherwise, preserve both magazines' remaining ammunition normally. Quick Chamber is a Reload for effects that modify or trigger from Reloading.

title: Breaker Shot
text: Type: Bukijutsu, Rank C Stamina: 16 Damage: As Weapon Speed: As Weapon +3 Tags: Attack, Weapon, Ballistic Effects Make a Ballistic Attack. It deals +50% damage to Armor Durability, physical Barriers, objects and destructible monster parts. If fired with Pierce ammunition, the Attack also gains +5% Wounding.

title: Covering Fire
text: Type: Bukijutsu, Rank C Stamina: 18 Damage: As Weapon Speed: As Weapon +4 Tags: Attack, Weapon, Ballistic Requires: At least 3 ammunition remaining Effects Consume 3 ammunition and make one Ballistic Attack against one creature. Hit or miss, until the beginning of your next Action that creature suffers -2 on Attacks against creatures other than you while it remains within your weapon's Range. Covering Fire is one Attack. Burst cannot also modify it.

title: Snap Shot
text: Type: Bukijutsu, Rank C Stamina: 14 Damage: As Weapon Accuracy: -2 Speed: As Weapon -2 Tags: Attack, Weapon, Ballistic Requires: Sidearm or Light Bowgun Frame Effects Make a hurried Ballistic Attack. It cannot benefit from Aim, Predator's Zero or an effect that requires you to be Braced. After it resolves, increase the weapon's Delay by 2 for this Attack only.

title: Predator's Zero
text: Type: Bukijutsu, Rank B Stamina: 20 Speed: 5 Tags: Utility, Weapon, Ballistic Effects Choose one creature you can see within your Ballistic Weapon's Range. Until you voluntarily move, Reload, change weapons, choose a different target for a Ballistic Attack, or the chosen creature leaves your Range, your next Ballistic Attack against that creature gains +10% Wounding. If your weapon is Scoped, you may Aim as part of Predator's Zero without additional Speed. Predator's Zero ends after one Attack.

title: Hunter's Magazine
text: Type: Bukijutsu, Rank B Stamina: 18 Speed: 6 Tags: Utility, Weapon, Ballistic Effects Reload the weapon completely. Choose two compatible ammunition types for which you possess at least one Load. Until this magazine becomes empty or is removed, choose which of those two ammunition types is fired with each Attack. The Attack gains +10% Wounding. If you fire a Wyvern Shell with this technique, apply the Shell's normal Speed, Stamina and Wounding modifiers, but do not add its +4 Damage Dice a second time.
