title: Stone-Bellied Patience — Signature Trait
text: Whenever Gather Natural Chakra resolves while you are in Sage Mode, choose Steady or Springing. Steady — Until the beginning of your next non-Interrupt Action, gain Sage Power to Resistance rolls and reduce Knockback you suffer by 2 × Sage Power yards, minimum 0. Springing — Your next Taijutsu Attack gains Sage Power Accuracy. On a full hit, it also deals 2 × Sage Power Knockback. This benefit ends when that Attack resolves or when you begin a different non-Interrupt Action.

title: Pond-Leap — Sage Art
text: \Speed 3, Utility, Movement, Self\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Leap up to 5 × Sage Power yards to a legal location you can perceive. You may pass over creatures, gaps, low obstacles and difficult ground without reducing this distance. You must end the movement somewhere that can support you.

title: Ripple Strike — Sage Art
text: \Speed +1, Modifier, Taijutsu\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Add Ripple Strike to a damaging Melee Taijutsu Attack when it is declared. On a full hit, that Attack deals 2 × Sage Power Knockback. If the target is moved at least 3 yards by this Knockback, make an Athletics Status Roll against their Resistance. On a failure, they are knocked Prone.

title: Still-Water Listening — Sage Art
text: While in Sage Mode and in contact with the ground or a continuous body of water, increase Sage Sense by 5 for Awareness rolls made to detect, Search for or track moving creatures within 10 × Sage Rank yards that are touching the same continuous surface. This does not grant line of sight or automatically defeat Stealth; hidden creatures still contest your Search normally.

title: Broad-Backed Guard — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 3. After you successfully use Take The Hit, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra. Reduce the Final Damage you receive from the intercepted Attack by 10% + (5% × Sage Power). Apply this reduction before Blocking.

title: Heaven-Shaking Landing — Sage Kata
text: \Speed 6, Attack, Taijutsu, Movement\ Requires: Sage Rank 4. Cost: 2 Sage Chakra. Leap up to 5 × Sage Power yards, then make either a Basic Attack: Unarmed or a Basic Attack: Weapon using a melee weapon you are wielding against a legal target. Use the chosen Basic Attack under the Sage Kata rules. On a full hit, add Sage Power Damage Dice and deal 3 × Sage Power Knockback. After the Knockback resolves, make an Athletics Status Roll against the target's Resistance. On a failure, they are knocked

title: SERPENT SAGE
text: Serpent teachings treat safety as a habit to be broken. Distance can be crossed. Restraints can be slipped. Skin can be shed. A patient enemy can wait longer than you can. Their Sages learn to let Natural Chakra travel through the body in long, continuous lines rather than explosive bursts. Their training favours control over spectacle. A Serpent Sage wants the opponent committed, poisoned, bound or standing exactly where the next strike expects them to be. Sage Mode Appearance — Pupils narrow,

title: Coiled Reach — Signature Trait
text: While in Sage Mode, your Melee Taijutsu Attacks may originate up to Sage Power yards beyond their normal reach. This does not increase your Threatened Area. This increased origin distance stacks with other effects which explicitly extend where an Attack may originate.

title: Shed the Binding — Sage Art
text: \Speed 1, Utility, Interrupt, Self\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Use this as a Speed 1 Utility Action while suffering physical Immobilization, or as a Speed 1 Interrupt immediately after you gain physical Immobilization from restraints, bindings, grappling effects or terrain. Reduce that Immobilization by 2 + Sage Power. Shed the Binding cannot reduce Paralysis, mental effects or Immobilization caused by a Wound.

title: Venomous Communion — Sage Art
text: When a damaging Taijutsu or Ninjutsu Attack fully hits and deals at least 1 damage after mitigation, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra and make a Chakra Control Status Roll against the target's Resistance. On a failure, the target suffers Poison equal to 1 + Sage Power for 5 + (5 × Sage Power) IC. Reapplying this Poison refreshes its duration; it does not stack with itself.

title: Constricting Coil — Sage Art
text: \Speed +1, Modifier, Taijutsu\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Add Constricting Coil to a Melee Taijutsu Attack when it is declared. On a full hit, make an Athletics Status Roll against the target's Resistance. On a failure, they suffer Immobilization equal to 2 + Sage Power.

title: Patient Predator — Sage Art
text: Using Gather Natural Chakra while in Sage Mode does not reduce your current Stealth TN merely for being an Action. All other Stealth rules still apply, including any rule that would reduce your Stealth level.

title: Perfect Shedding — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4. Once per Sage Mode, as a Speed 3 Utility Action, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra to reduce one Bleed, Burn, Immobilization, Paralysis or Poison affecting you by 2 + Sage Power. Perfect Shedding cannot remove Wounds or penalties caused directly by a Wound.

title: ROC SAGE
text: Roc teachings begin by rejecting the idea that the battlefield is flat. Cliffs are roads. Rooftops are footholds. Falling is movement with a deadline. Their students learn to read open air the way other hunters read tracks. Roc Sages favour sudden relocation, rescue and attacks from angles ordinary footwork cannot create. Their greatest weakness is the same thing they prize: once enclosed, grounded or denied room to move, much of their advantage disappears. Sage Mode Appearance — Hair, cloth and

title: Sky-Borne Balance — Signature Trait
text: While in Sage Mode, up to Sage Power yards of the distance you move during each Move Action may cross a gap or travel vertically through unsupported air, provided you reach a legal surface at the end of that portion. Whenever a Sage Art moves you, that movement may travel vertically and across unsupported air for its full distance. You must still end the movement in a legal location unless the Art says otherwise. If you end unsupported, you begin Falling normally.

title: Updraft Step — Sage Art
text: \Speed 3, Utility, Movement, Self\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Move up to 5 + (5 × Sage Power) yards. Sky-Borne Balance applies to this movement, and you may change direction once during it.

title: Talon Dive — Sage Kata
text: \Speed +1, Modifier, Taijutsu\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Add Talon Dive to a damaging Melee Taijutsu Attack if you moved at least 5 yards downward immediately before declaring it. On a full hit, add Sage Power Damage Dice and increase Final Damage by 5% × Sage Power. The Attack counts as Senjutsu.

title: Wing Guard — Sage Art
text: \Interrupt, Defensive, Self\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Declare after becoming the target of a Ranged Attack or Area Attack but before rolling Dodge. Gain 2 + Sage Power to that Dodge roll. If the defence succeeds, move up to Sage Power yards after the Attack resolves without spending AP. This uses the normal Speed of the Dodge and does not create a separate defence.

title: Carry on the Wind — Sage Art
text: \Speed 4, Utility, Movement\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Choose one willing creature in Melee. Move yourself and that creature up to 3 + (3 × Sage Power) yards. Sky-Borne Balance applies. Both creatures must end in legal locations and within Melee of one another.

title: Hang Upon the Sky — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4. You may use Gather Natural Chakra while unsupported in the air. While Gathering this way you remain suspended instead of Falling. Your Movement Speed is 0 unless another Sage Art specifically allows you to move while Gathering. When Gather resolves or is aborted, if you are still unsupported you immediately begin Falling.

title: TORTOISE SAGE
text: Tortoise teachings are old, slow and deeply unimpressed by urgency. Their answer to danger is not always to avoid it. Sometimes the correct response is to become the place where the attack stops. Students are taught that endurance is not passive. Holding a doorway, sheltering another hunter or refusing to be moved can shape a battle as decisively as any strike. A Tortoise Sage spends Natural Chakra like masonry: layer by layer, exactly where the pressure will land. Sage Mode Appearance — The sil

title: Ancient Carapace — Signature Trait
text: While in Sage Mode, increase Block's percentage damage reduction by 5% × Sage Power, to the normal maximum of 75%. You also gain Sage Power to Resistance rolls made against an Attack you Block.

title: Still Shell — Sage Art
text: While Gathering Natural Chakra, you are considered to be Preparing Blocking and may use Block. Block is still an Interrupt and therefore normally aborts Gather after the Block resolves.

title: Stoneback — Sage Art
text: \Speed 3, Utility, Self\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Gain DR equal to 5 + (5 × Sage Power) until the beginning of your next non-Interrupt Action. Your Movement Speed is reduced by 50% while this effect lasts.

title: Root the World — Sage Art
text: Before making a Resistance roll against Knockback, Prone, Immobilization or another effect that would physically move or displace you, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra to gain 5 + Sage Power to that roll. This does not create a Resistance roll where none would normally be made.

title: Sheltering Carapace — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 3. After you successfully use Take The Hit, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra to Block the intercepted Attack even if you were not Preparing Blocking. This Block applies only to that Attack.

title: Unbroken Shell — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4. Once per battle, using Block while Gathering Natural Chakra does not abort Gather. The Block still uses its normal Interrupt Speed and all other effects of the Attack resolve normally.

title: MOTH SAGE
text: Moth teachings treat perception as something physical. Air carries scent, dust, heat and vibration. Light reveals, but it also blinds. A battlefield is full of information before anyone makes a Search roll; most people are simply too loud inside their own heads to notice it. Moth Sages specialise in controlling that information. They obscure lines of sight, mark prey with almost invisible powder and move through confusion without surrendering their own awareness. Sage Mode Appearance — The eyes

title: Powder-Sense — Signature Trait
text: While in Sage Mode, reduce the final Visibility Penalty applied to your Awareness and Defensive rolls by Sage Power, minimum 0. Powder-Sense does not reduce Visibility Penalty on your Attacks.

title: Dust Veil — Sage Art
text: \Speed 4, Utility, Area\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Fill a radius of 2 + Sage Power yards centred on you with drifting scales. The area imposes a Visibility Penalty equal to 2 + Sage Power under the normal rules for area-based Visibility. The veil lasts until the beginning of your next non-Interrupt Action. Powder-Sense applies normally.

title: Powder Mark — Sage Art
text: \Speed 3, Utility, Search\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Choose one creature you can currently detect. Until Sage Mode ends or you mark a new creature, reduce that creature's Stealth TN against your Searches by 2 + Sage Power. Powder Mark does not prevent Stealth and does not reveal the target automatically.

title: Moonwing Drift — Sage Art
text: \Speed 3, Utility, Movement, Self\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Move up to 3 + (3 × Sage Power) yards. If you began this movement in Stealth, the movement does not reduce your Stealth level. Declaring the Action still reduces your Stealth TN by 5 normally.

title: Blinding Scales — Sage Art
text: When a damaging Taijutsu or Ninjutsu Attack fully hits and deals at least 1 damage after mitigation, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra and make a Chakra Control Status Roll against the target's Resistance. On a failure, they suffer a Visibility Penalty equal to 2 + Sage Power for 10 IC. If they are already suffering a greater Visibility Penalty, use the greater value rather than adding them together.

title: Cocooned Stillness — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4. You may use Gather Natural Chakra at Stealth Level 3 without reducing your Stealth level or Stealth TN for declaring Gather. All other Actions and all other causes of losing Stealth function normally.

title: CARRION SAGE
text: Carrion traditions are taught by scavengers, corpse-crows, bone-pickers and predators clever enough to understand that the cleanest kill is often the one somebody else already started. They are not necessarily cruel. They are simply honest about injury. A Carrion Sage reads blood loss, limping footwork, ragged breathing and the tiny mistakes made by a creature trying to pretend it is not hurt. Their Senjutsu is strongest once the battlefield has become messy. Sage Mode Appearance — Features shar

title: Blood on the Wind — Signature Trait
text: While in Sage Mode, increase Sage Sense by 5 for Awareness and Survival rolls made specifically to detect, Search for or track a creature suffering a Wound or Bleed. Against those creatures, also reduce your final Visibility Penalty by Sage Power, minimum 0. A successful detection tells you that the creature is injured, not the exact Wound or its statistics.

title: Red Trail — Sage Art
text: Requires: Nature Pulse. Nature Pulse has double its normal range when used to Search for creatures suffering a Wound or Bleed. Against those creatures, reduce the final Visibility Penalty of the Search by an additional Sage Power, minimum 0.

title: Scavenger's Claim — Sage Art
text: \Speed +1, Modifier\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Add Scavenger's Claim to a damaging Taijutsu or Ninjutsu Attack against a creature suffering a Wound or Bleed. That Attack gains 10% + (5% × Sage Power) Wounding. Scavenger's Claim does not increase the Attack's Final Damage.

title: Circle the Wounded — Sage Art
text: \Speed 3, Utility, Self\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Choose one detected creature suffering a Wound or Bleed. Until Sage Mode ends or you choose a new target with Circle the Wounded, gain Sage Power to Defensive rolls against that creature and increase the distance of Move Actions and Actions with the Movement tag made directly toward it by 25%.

title: Scavenger's Communion — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 3. Once per battle, when a hostile creature you can detect suffers a Major, Severe or Critical Wound, gain 1 Sage Chakra after that Wound resolves, up to your maximum.

title: Last Descent — Sage Kata
text: \Speed +2, Modifier, Taijutsu\ Requires: Sage Rank 4. Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Add Last Descent to a damaging Taijutsu Attack against a creature at 0 Vitality or suffering a Severe or Critical Wound. On a full hit, add 1 + Sage Power Damage Dice. The Attack counts as Senjutsu.

title: FUNGAL SAGE
text: Fungal traditions begin with a lesson most humans dislike: the mushroom is not the organism. The visible body is temporary. The real creature is the network beneath it, spread through soil, root and rot, touching a hundred places at once. Fungal Sages are taught to think the same way. Position matters more than posture. Ground can carry information. A small patch of prepared terrain can become an extension of the Sage's senses or a trap that keeps an enemy exactly where the network wants them. S

title: Rooted Communion — Signature Trait
text: While in Sage Mode and in contact with natural earth, living vegetation or an area created by your Mycelial Ground, gain Sage Power to Resistance rolls and Sage Power to Chakra Control rolls made to prevent Gather Natural Chakra from being aborted by damage.

title: Mycelial Ground — Sage Art
text: \Speed 4, Utility, Area\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Choose a point on solid ground within 10 yards. A radius of 2 + Sage Power yards around that point becomes Rocky Terrain with severity equal to Sage Power as mycelial growth spreads across the surface. You ignore Immobilization caused by your own Mycelial Ground. The area lasts until Sage Mode ends or you create a new Mycelial Ground.

title: Spore Veil — Sage Art
text: \Speed 4, Utility, Area\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Choose a point within 10 yards. A radius of 2 + Sage Power yards fills with spores and imposes a Visibility Penalty equal to 2 + Sage Power under the normal rules for area-based Visibility. The veil lasts until the beginning of your next non-Interrupt Action. Reduce the Visibility Penalty you personally suffer from this Art by Sage Power before applying other reductions.

title: Hyphal Snare — Sage Art
text: \Speed 5, Attack, Ninjutsu\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Range: 10 + (5 × Sage Power) yards. Make a Ninjutsu Attack against one creature standing on natural ground or within your Mycelial Ground. On a full hit, this Attack deals no damage; instead make a Chakra Control Status Roll against the target's Resistance. On a failure, they suffer Immobilization equal to 2 + Sage Power. Hyphal Snare counts as Senjutsu.

title: Deep Roots — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 3. While touching natural earth, living vegetation or your Mycelial Ground, reduce the base Speed of Gather Natural Chakra by 1. Its minimum Speed is unchanged.

title: The Network Listens — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4 and Nature Pulse. While touching natural earth, living vegetation or your Mycelial Ground, double the range of Nature Pulse. You also increase Sage Sense by 5 for Survival rolls made to read disturbances, tracks or recent movement through that terrain.

title: SALAMANDER SAGE
text: Salamander teachings are about surviving the part where survival stops looking heroic. Heat, poison, exhaustion, torn muscle and choking air are treated as temporary problems to be managed long enough to reach safety or finish the fight. Their Sages are not immortal and do not regrow lost limbs or erase Wounds by wishing hard enough. What they learn is how to keep a damaged body useful: shed what can be shed, slow what can be slowed and spend Natural Chakra where the body is failing fastest. Sag

title: Regenerative Balance — Signature Trait
text: Whenever a Rest successfully reduces your current Stamina Penalty while you are in Sage Mode, also reduce one Burn, Bleed or Poison affecting you by 1 + Sage Power, minimum 0. A Status reduced to 0 this way ends. Regenerative Balance cannot heal Wounds.

title: Shed Pain — Sage Art
text: \Speed 3, Utility, Self\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Reduce one Immobilization or Paralysis effect affecting you by 2 + Sage Power, or stand from Prone. Shed Pain cannot reduce a Status or penalty caused directly by a Wound. If you use Shed Pain to stand, you may also move up to Sage Power yards.

title: Hardy Blood — Sage Art
text: While in Sage Mode, gain Sage Power to Resistance rolls made to resist Burn, Poison, Suffocation and environmental conditions caused by extreme heat, extreme cold, fumes or contaminated terrain. Hardy Blood does not create a Resistance roll where none would normally be allowed.

title: Regrowth — Sage Art
text: \Speed 5, Utility, Self\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Restore Vitality equal to 5% × Sage Power of your maximum Vitality, up to your normal maximum. Regrowth does not restore HP, heal Wounds or remove the effects of a Wound.

title: Molt Away — Sage Art
text: \Speed 5, Utility, Self\ Requires: Sage Rank 3. Cost: 2 Sage Chakra. Choose one non-Wound Bleed, Burn, Immobilization, Paralysis or Poison affecting you with severity no greater than 5 + Sage Power. End that Status. Molt Away cannot remove an effect which explicitly cannot be reduced or removed.

title: Refuse the Ash — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4. Once per battle, when a Stamina or Chakra Exhaustion roll would advance you beyond maximum Fatigue and Incapacitate you, you may spend 2 Sage Chakra after the roll. The triggering Action resolves and you remain at maximum Fatigue instead, even if the normal Fatigue rules would cause that Action or technique to fail to activate. Refuse the Ash does not prevent Incapacitation caused by HP, Wounds or another effect, and you must have at least 2 Sage Chakra to use it.

title: SAGE ARTS
text: Unless an Art says otherwise, you must be in Sage Mode to use it. If an Art scales using Sage Power, use your current Sage Power when the effect is declared.

title: DEEP RESERVOIR
text: \Stackable, Maximum 2\ Increase your maximum Sage Chakra by 2.

title: SWIFT COMMUNION
text: Reduce the base Speed of Gather Natural Chakra by 2. Its minimum Speed remains 5.

title: STABLE BALANCE
text: Reduce Sage Mode's Upkeep by 1, minimum 0.

title: NATURE'S EYES
text: Increase Sage Sense by 5. When you Search for a living creature or active chakra source, reduce your final Visibility Penalty by Sage Power, minimum 0. This never reveals a creature which still successfully contests your Search.

title: NATURE'S UNDERSTANDING
text: Gain +5 on Chakra Control and Survival rolls made specifically to identify, understand, manipulate or endure Natural Chakra, Senjutsu, Sage creatures or environments saturated with Natural Chakra. At Sage Rank 4+, this bonus becomes +10.

title: SAGE'S CORRECTION
text: After making an Accuracy Roll, Defensive roll, Chakra Control roll, Resistance roll or other Skill roll but before its result is resolved, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra to add 2 + Sage Power to the roll. Sage's Correction does not modify static Accuracy and may be used only once per roll.

title: SAGE'S BREATH
text: When you make a Chakra Exhaustion or Stamina roll caused by an Action you are taking, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra before rolling to gain +5 + Sage Power to that roll. This is a bonus, not a reroll.

title: NATURAL KATA
text: While in Sage Mode, your Melee Taijutsu Attacks may originate up to 1 + Sage Power yards beyond their normal reach as Natural Chakra follows through the strike. This does not increase your Threatened Area. When a Melee Taijutsu Attack made through this extended reach fully hits, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra to add Sage Damage again to that Attack's Final Damage. This additional Sage Damage does not stack with itself.

title: SENJUTSU INFUSION
text: When declaring a damaging Ninjutsu Attack, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra. Choose one: • Gain 1 + Sage Power Accuracy for that Attack; or • Increase its Final Damage by 10% + (5% × Sage Power). Choose before making the Attack roll. The technique counts as Senjutsu.

title: NATURE GUARD
text: \Interrupt, Defensive, Self\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Declare after you become the target of an Attack but before your defence is rolled. Gain 2 + Sage Power to one Dodge or Parry roll against that Attack. Nature Guard uses the normal Speed of the Defensive Interrupt you choose; it does not create a separate defence.

title: PREDATOR'S STEP
text: When you declare a Move Action or another Action with the Movement tag, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra to increase the distance you can move by 25% × Sage Power. This changes distance, not Speed.

title: NATURE PULSE
text: \Speed 4, Utility, Search\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Make an Awareness Search for living creatures and active chakra sources within 10 × Sage Rank yards. You may Search even without line of sight, although walls, dense terrain, distance and overwhelming ambient chakra may still apply Visibility Penalty. Hidden creatures contest the Search normally with Stealth. On success, learn direction and rough distance. Nature Pulse does not reveal statistics, Jutsu, identity or other information that could not

title: SAGE'S RECOVERY
text: When you complete a Rest while in Sage Mode, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra. Improve the Rest's reduction to your current Stamina Penalty by Sage Power.

title: STILLNESS IN MOTION
text: Requires: Sage Rank 3. When you declare Gather Natural Chakra, you may choose to remain mobile. If you do, Gather's normal Movement Speed 0 restriction is replaced: during its Delay, you may move each IC as though you were taking a Move Action, but at 25% of your normal movement rate. This movement is part of Gather, does not count as declaring another Action, and does not abort Gather. You still cannot declare another non-Interrupt Action until Gather resolves, and all other interruption rules

title: FLOWING COMMUNION
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4. When Gather Natural Chakra resolves while you are in Sage Mode, you may immediately spend 1 AP. If you do, gain 1 additional Sage Chakra. You cannot gain more than 2 Sage Chakra from the same Gather Action.

title: SAGE RESERVOIR
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4 and Deep Reservoir. Once per battle, when an effect would spend your final Sage Chakra, reduce that Sage Chakra cost by 1, minimum 0. If this prevents you from reaching 0 Sage Chakra, Sage Mode continues.

title: NATURE WITHOUT THOUGHT
text: Requires: Sage Rank 5. Once per battle, the first Sage Art or Sage Kata you use after entering Sage Mode costs 1 less Sage Chakra, minimum 0. This cannot reduce a cost which is already 0.

title: SAGE KATA
text: Sage Kata are active combat techniques fuelled by Sage Chakra. For learning and selection, every Sage Kata is a Sage Art. They are not Jutsu unless their text says otherwise and require no Handseals by default. Each Kata follows the normal rules for its listed Action and Attack type. When a Sage Kata tells you to make a Basic Attack, keep that Basic Attack's normal Accuracy modifiers, Damage Dice, Damage Type, Reach, Stamina cost and applicable weapon or unarmed properties, but use the Kata's li

title: SAGE STRIKE
text: \Speed 4, Attack, Taijutsu\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Range: Melee. Make either a Basic Attack: Unarmed or a Basic Attack: Weapon using a melee weapon you are wielding. Use the chosen Basic Attack under the Sage Kata rules above. On a full hit, add 1 + Sage Power Damage Dice and increase Final Damage by 5% × Sage Power. This Attack counts as Senjutsu.

title: SAGE REVERSAL
text: Trigger: Successful Parry of a Melee Attack. Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. After the triggering Attack resolves, move up to Sage Power yards without spending AP. Sage Reversal is part of the successful Parry; it does not create a second Interrupt or change that Parry's Speed. This movement must follow a legal path and cannot move you through occupied spaces or terrain you could not normally cross.

title: EARTHEN ROOT
text: \Speed 4, Utility, Self\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Until the beginning of your next non-Interrupt Action, gain 3 + Sage Power to Resistance rolls against forced movement, being knocked Prone, or effects which would physically displace you. Your Movement Speed is 0 while this effect lasts.

title: HUNTER'S SENSE
text: \Speed 3, Utility, Search\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Choose one creature you can currently detect. Until Sage Mode ends or you choose a new target with Hunter's Sense, gain Sage Power Accuracy against that creature and add Sage Sense to Awareness rolls made to keep track of it. You gain no benefit while you cannot detect the target by any sense.

title: NATURAL SHOCK
text: \Speed 5, Attack, Ninjutsu\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Range: 10 + (5 × Sage Power) yards. Make a Ninjutsu Attack against one creature. On a full hit, deal 2 + Sage Power Damage Dice + NDB. Natural Shock counts as Senjutsu and has no Element unless your Tradition gives it one.

title: SAGE BREAK
text: \Speed +2, Modifier\ Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Add Sage Break to a damaging Taijutsu or Ninjutsu Attack when it is declared. The Attack gains Sage Power Penetration and ignores 5% × Sage Power of Final Damage reduction applied by defensive effects, to a minimum of 0% reduction.

title: MASTERY — PERFECT COMMUNION
text: After taking three Natural Chakra Developments, your body no longer has to fight every step of the balancing process. Reduce the base Speed of Gather Natural Chakra by 1 and its minimum Speed by 1. Reduce Sage Mode's Upkeep by 1, minimum 0. The first time you enter Sage Mode in each battle, gain 1 Sage Chakra after Sage Mode resolves. This cannot take you above your maximum. Perfect Communion does not remove the need to Gather. A mastered Sage is faster at finding balance, not permanently full o

title: NATURAL IMBALANCE
text: You normally cannot Gather beyond your maximum Sage Chakra. If an effect forces more Natural Chakra into you than you can safely hold, you become Imbalanced until your Sage Chakra is at or below its maximum. While Imbalanced, you cannot Gather Natural Chakra, suffer -2 to Chakra Control rolls, and your Movement Speed is reduced by 50%. At the end of each of your non-Interrupt Actions, lose 1 Sage Chakra until you are no longer above your maximum. If an individual Tradition, monster or technique

title: RULES CLARIFICATIONS
text: Chakra Exhaustion — Sage Chakra does not replace a Jutsu's Chakra Cost. A Jutsu modified by a Sage Art still makes its normal Chakra Exhaustion roll. AP — AP may reduce Gather Natural Chakra and Sage Mode normally unless an effect says otherwise. Their minimum Speeds still apply. Clones — A Clone has no Sage Chakra unless its own rules explicitly say it can hold that resource. Sage Chakra held by a Clone is separate from its creator and cannot normally be transferred. Summons — A Summon does not

title: Using the Split Reference Edition
text: This volume is designed to stand beside the other Ember Corps reference books. Rules have been divided by what players actually need to look up at the table. The Core Rules remain the shared engine; specialized volumes contain the options that sit on top of it. | Volume | Book | Primary Use | | I | Core Rules | Character creation, attributes, skills, advancement, abilities, combat, wounds and downtime. | | II | Uniques | Character-defining traits, upgrade chains and expanded playstyle options. |

title: Introduction
text: Talents are things which differentiate your character from the rank-and-file ninja. Jutsu, skills, and abilities are all things which are fairly common. True, most ninja won't know A ranked Suiton jutsu--but knowing them is less a sign that one is "special", and more an indication that you're an advanced ninja. Talents are somewhere between uniques and abilities. They're not fundamental aspects of your character--they're things you've learned or developed over time that are genuinely hard to com

title: Acquiring Talents
text: You get talent points automatically as your character gains experience. You get talents at the following XP milestones: 1000 2500 4000 5000 6500 And every 1500 XP afterwards (8000, 9500, etc.) Thus, a 3000 XP character would have two talents! You don't have to choose talents as soon as they're accessible. If you get to 1000 XP and aren't sure what you want, it's perfectly alright to hold off until later. There are no penalties for waiting until later to pick talents. You can take "Enhancement" t

title: Learning and Deepening Talents
text: Whenever you gain a Talent Point, choose one of the following: Learn a Talent — Gain the Core Talent of a Talent you do not already possess. Deepen a Talent — Choose one Development from a Talent you already possess. Unless stated otherwise, a Development may only be selected once. When you possess three Developments from the same Talent, you automatically gain that Talent's Mastery. Mastery does not cost an additional Talent Point. A Talent should normally provide at least two of the following:

title: Enhancements and Capabilities
text: Enhancements represent exceptional aptitude, conditioning, instinct, or personal development. They do not require a mentor or external source. Capabilities represent rare bodies of knowledge. To learn the Core Talent of a Capability, you must have a suitable Source. A Source might be a mentor, recovered manual, old training record, breeder, trained specimen, faction, ruin, captured technique, or another discovery made during play. Once you have a valid Source, the Talent itself should not requir

title: Celerity
text: You are not merely fast on your feet. Your entire combat rhythm happens a fraction of a second ahead of everyone else's.

title: Core Talent
text: All of your Actions and Interrupts have their final Speed reduced by 1. This cannot reduce the Speed of an Interrupt below 3. You may choose not to apply this reduction, or only partially apply it, to a given Action.

title: Developments
text: Quick Hands — Actions primarily involving drawing, stowing, reloading, manipulating equipment, or performing handseals have their final Speed reduced by an additional 1, minimum 1. Quick Feet — After resolving a non-Movement Action, you may move up to 2 yards without AP or additional Speed. This is still movement and must follow a legal path. Quick Reflexes — Defensive Interrupts have their final Speed reduced by an additional 1, but cannot be reduced below 3 by this Development. Flow State — If

title: Mastery
text: Too Fast to Follow — The Core Talent reduction from Celerity becomes 2 instead of 1. The normal minimums still apply.

title: Generalist
text: You have never been satisfied doing only one job. Somewhere along the way you picked up a worrying number of other people's tricks.

title: Core Talent
text: Gain any two non-Automatic Rank Benefits you currently or previously qualified for.

title: Developments
text: Cross-Training — Gain one additional non-Automatic Rank Benefit you currently or previously qualify for. You may select this Development only once. Broad Curriculum — Gain an additional XP/300 Skill Points. This scales as your total XP increases. Improvised Expertise — Once per scene, after making a Skill Check with a Skill in which you do not possess Specialization, add +5 before the result is resolved. Reassignment — During a Week's Rest, you may replace one Rank Benefit granted by Generalist

title: Mastery
text: Master of None — Gain one additional non-Automatic Rank Benefit you currently or previously qualify for. During each Week's Rest, you may now replace any number of Rank Benefits granted by Generalist rather than only one.

title: Prodigy
text: Some Hunters need years before a lesson becomes instinct. You have the irritating habit of arriving there first.

title: Core Talent
text: Gain one non-Automatic Rank Benefit from any Rank, including a Rank you have never held.

title: Developments
text: Precocious — Gain one additional non-Automatic Rank Benefit from one Rank above your current Rank or lower. Fast Study — Reduce the required training time for learning Jutsu and Capability Talents by 25%, minimum one training action or the shortest unit the relevant rule normally permits. Seen It Once — Once per Mission or Hunt, after you witness another character successfully perform a non-Heritage Jutsu, Skill use, or combat technique, gain +3 to your next attempt at the same broad type of act

title: Mastery
text: Ahead of the Curve — Gain one additional non-Automatic Rank Benefit from any Rank. Prodigy still never grants Automatic Rank Benefits.

title: Skill Specialist
text: You did not merely learn a skill. You kept going until everyone else started sending the difficult cases to you.

title: Core Talent
text: Gain an additional XP/200 Skill Points. This scales as your total XP increases.

title: Developments
text: Deep Study — Choose one Skill. Increase your maximum ranks in that Skill by 2. Specialized Practice — Choose one Skill in which you possess Specialization. When your Specialization directly applies, gain an additional +2. Reliable — Choose one Skill. Once per scene, when the natural d20 result for that Skill is lower than 7, treat the die as though it rolled a 7. Applied Expertise — Once per scene, after succeeding on a Skill Check, you may grant yourself or an ally who can act on your work +3 t

title: Mastery
text: Recognized Expert — Choose one Skill when you gain this Mastery. Once per scene, after rolling that Skill but before the result is resolved, you may treat the natural d20 result as a 15.

title: Eight Gates
text: The Eight Gates are physical limiters built into the body to prevent a shinobi from destroying themselves with their own strength. Learning to open them is less about gaining power than learning exactly how much damage you can survive in exchange for it.

title: Core Talent
text: Gain access to the first three Gates under the normal Eight Gates rules.

title: Developments
text: Controlled Opening — Reduce the final Speed of Actions used specifically to open, close, or change your active Gates by 2, minimum 1. Explosive Entry — The first Taijutsu Attack you make after opening a higher Gate gains +2 Accuracy. Iron Conditioning — Gain +3 on rolls made specifically to resist, survive, or remain conscious through the self-inflicted consequences of the Eight Gates. This does not prevent unavoidable consequences. Second Opening — Gain access to Gates 4 through 6. Use the impr

title: Mastery
text: Perfected Release — Once per battle, when opening or maintaining Gate 6 or lower would inflict a self-inflicted Wound, Fatigue increase, or similar consequence that can vary in severity, reduce that consequence by one step. This cannot negate the fixed consequences of Gate 7 or Gate 8.

title: Kage Bunshin
text: Shadow Clones are not merely extra bodies. Their real danger is that a shinobi who learns to think through several versions of themselves can attack, scout, study, and deceive in ways an ordinary clone user cannot.

title: Core Talent
text: Learn Kage Bunshin no Jutsu and gain access to the Shadow Clone rules, ignoring any normal requirement that would prevent you from learning the technique solely because of its rarity.

title: Developments
text: Coordinated Assault — If one of your Kage Bunshin has successfully attacked a target since the end of your previous Action, your next Attack against that target gains +2 Accuracy. Shadow Screen — After you successfully Dodge an Attack, you may exchange positions with one of your Kage Bunshin within 3 yards. Both positions must be legal for the respective characters. Memory Relay — When a Kage Bunshin is dismissed, you may deliberately review what it learned. Once per Hunt or Mission, a clone tha

title: Mastery
text: Many as One — When one of your Kage Bunshin fully hits a creature, your next Attack against that creature before the end of your next Action has its final Speed reduced by 2, minimum 1. This may stack with Coordinated Assault.

title: Monster Taming
text: Monster Taming is the practice of acquiring, training and fielding dangerous creatures. Your monster might be captured during a Hunt, raised from an egg or young, bred for work, rescued, purchased, inherited, or obtained through another appropriate method. However you found it, the result is one named Tamed Monster that grows alongside you. Your Tamed Monster is a separate creature with its own position, Initiative, Vitality and IC track. Its Independent Actions do not spend your AP; Monster Tec

title: At a Glance
text: • At 1,000 Total XP, your Tamed Monster has Growth Rank 1 and one Monster Trait. • At 1,500 Total XP it gains a second Trait; at 2,000 it gains a third; it gains another Growth Rank and Trait every 500 Total XP thereafter. • Every Species has Toughness, Aggression, Defence and Agility ratings. The four ratings total 12. • Every monster Action has its own printed Speed. Agility never changes an Action's Speed. • Agility affects Movement, Initiative and the Command AP you pay for Monster Technique

title: Talent Progression
text: Monster Taming is a Capability Talent. Your Source must plausibly give you access to a suitable creature, egg or young, breeder, handler, captured specimen, or another way to acquire and train the monster. Beast Seal: Release is the field-sealing technique used to safely transport and deploy it.

title: Core Talent
text: Choose one Standard Monster Species and create one named Tamed Monster using its profile. Decide how you acquired it: capture, breeding, rescue, purchase, inheritance, reward, or another appropriate method. The method does not change its statistics. Your monster immediately gains that Species' Core Instinct. You may purchase Beast Seal: Release without meeting its normal rank requirement. While your monster is deployed, its prepared Beast Seal lets you sense its rough direction and whether it is

title: Developments
text: Each time you take a Monster Taming Development, choose one Tamer Development below, learn one Monster Technique from your monster's Species, and unlock its next Species Feature. You may take each Tamer Development and learn each Monster Technique only once unless stated otherwise. A Standard Species has four Monster Techniques and four Development-locked Species Features. You may normally take at most four Monster Taming Developments.

title: Quick Release
text: Effects: When using Beast Seal: Release to deploy your Tamed Monster, its Chakra cost becomes 20, its final Speed becomes 12, and its final Seal Speed becomes 12. If released after Initiative has begun, its first normal Action occurs 7 IC after appearing instead of 10 IC.

title: Efficient Command
text: Effects: Reduce the Command AP cost of your Tamed Monster's Monster Techniques by 1 after applying Agility, minimum 2.

title: Coordinated Assault
text: Effects: When your Tamed Monster fully hits a creature with an Attack, your next Attack against that creature before the end of your next Non-Interrupt Action gains +2 Accuracy. This benefit cannot stack with itself.

title: Handler's Read
text: Effects: Gain +3 Awareness and Survival when your Tamed Monster can meaningfully assist through its senses, tracking ability or position. You may act on information your monster communicates from things it can perceive but you cannot. This does not remove Visibility, Cover or other penalties from your own Attacks.

title: Protective Training
text: Effects: While you are within 3 yards of your Tamed Monster, both of you gain +1 to Defensive Rolls. This bonus ends while either creature is unconscious, helpless or otherwise unable to protect the other.

title: Emergency Release
text: Limit: Once per battle Effects: When using Beast Seal: Release to deploy your Tamed Monster, reduce its final Speed and final Seal Speed by 5, minimum 1. This stacks with Quick Release.

title: Homeward Seal
text: Effects: During a Week's Rest, establish a return formula at a permanent safe location where your Tamed Monster is normally kept, such as a kennel, stable, den, breeder's compound or laboratory. With enough uninterrupted time to perform the ritual, you may transport yourself there along with a number of willing creatures touching you up to 1 + your Monster Taming Developments. Homeward Seal is travel, not a combat teleport, and cannot normally be performed during Initiative.

title: Mastery — Master Handler
text: After taking three Monster Taming Developments, gain Master Handler. Once per battle, when your Tamed Monster declares a Monster Technique, you may ignore its Command AP cost. Its Speed and all other requirements are unchanged. When you do, choose one: gain +2 Accuracy on your next Attack before the end of your next Action; gain +2 to Defensive Rolls until the end of your next Action; or move up to 2 yards after the Technique resolves without spending AP or changing Initiative. Monster Taming do

title: Beast Seal: Release
text: Chakra: 25 Speed: 15 Seal Speed: 15 Range: 2 yards Tags: Utility, Sealing Effects: Release your Tamed Monster from its prepared Beast Seal into an unoccupied space within Range. The Beast Seal is a trained transport and safety tool; it does not control the monster's mind or force obedience. A Tamed Monster remains deployed until recalled, reduced to 0 Vitality, or the scene ends. You may recall it as a Speed 5 Action; the monster may voluntarily return to its Beast Seal as a Speed 5 Action. Reca

title: Entering Initiative
text: If your Tamed Monster is already present when Initiative is rolled, roll its Initiative normally. If it is released after Initiative begins, its first normal Action occurs 10 IC after it appears. It may use valid defensive Interrupts before then; those Interrupts advance its next Action normally.

title: Defeat and Recovery
text: A Tamed Monster reduced to 0 Vitality is immediately pulled back into its Beast Seal by the seal's safety tether. You cannot deploy it again until you complete a Week's Rest, at which point it returns at full Vitality. Reaching 0 Vitality means the monster is too injured to continue fighting; it does not automatically die. Permanent death requires an explicit story event rather than ordinary combat damage.

title: Growth
text: Your Tamed Monster uses your Total XP. Growth Rank begins at 1 when you reach 1,000 Total XP and increases by 1 for every additional 500 Total XP. Growth Rank: 1 + floor((Total XP - 1,000) / 500), minimum 1 Growth Rank is also the number of Monster Traits your monster has earned. If you learn Monster Taming after 1,000 Total XP, immediately select every Trait your monster currently qualifies for. | Total XP | Growth Rank | Monster Traits | | 1,000 | 1 | 1 | | 1,500 | 2 | 2 | | 2,000 | 3 | 3 | |

title: The Four Species Ratings
text: Every Standard Species has four ratings from 1 to 5, totaling 12: Toughness, Aggression, Defence and Agility. These ratings define the Species' base profile; Traits customize the individual partner.

title: Derived Profile
text: Base Vitality: 650 + 125 × (Growth Rank - 1), then apply Toughness Base Accuracy: 21 + (2 × Growth Rank) + 1 for every 2 Growth Ranks, to a maximum of +6; then apply Aggression. Base Defence: 14 + (2 × Growth Rank) + 1 for every 2 Growth Ranks after the first, to a maximum of +4; then apply Defence. Movement: Agility base + 0.1 yard per IC for each Growth Rank after the first Initiative: 1d20 + Agility contribution + floor(Growth Rank / 3) Monster Skill Bonus: 8 + (2 × Growth Rank) Monster Save

title: Independent Actions
text: A Tamed Monster has its own IC track and no AP pool of its own. It may use Move, Dodge, Parry, Search, Point Out, Hide when legal, stand up, ordinary object interactions, and its printed Basic Attack without spending your AP. These Actions use their normal or printed Speed and advance the monster on its IC track normally. A Tamed Monster can Parry with its natural weapons as though they were appropriate unarmed weapons. It cannot use player equipment, Jutsu, Talents, Uniques or Clan abilities un

title: Command AP
text: Monster Techniques are coordinated trained Monster Actions. When your monster declares one, you pay its listed Base Command AP from your AP pool, modified by the Species' Agility. Paying Command AP does not take an Action and does not change your Initiative. Command AP is a cost, not AP spent to reduce Speed. Neither you nor your monster may spend AP to reduce a monster Action's Speed or Surge a monster roll unless a rule explicitly says otherwise. Command AP still counts as AP you spent for eff

title: Monster Damage
text: Tamed Monsters use the normal Ember Corps damage structure: Damage Dice + (Damage Bonus × Attack Speed). Their Damage Dice and Monster Damage Bonus come from Growth Rank rather than Attributes. Monster Damage Dice: (4 + ceiling(Growth Rank / 2))d8 Monster Damage Bonus (MDB): 3 + (Growth Rank / 2) When an Attack deals 100% Monster Damage, roll the Monster Damage Dice and add MDB × that Attack's Speed. If an effect deals 70%, 120%, or another percentage of Monster Damage, calculate 100% Monster Da

title: Monster Rules
text: • A Tamed Monster is a living creature and can be targeted by effects that target creatures or allies. It does not inherit your Attributes, Accuracy, Defence, Damage Bonuses, equipment, Talents, Uniques, Clan effects or temporary modifiers unless a rule explicitly says so. • A Tamed Monster uses Vitality instead of HP or Wounds. At 0 Vitality its safety seal recalls it. It does not suffer Wounds, and effects that require the target to suffer a Wound do not trigger against it. • Bleed, Burns, Poi

title: Species Features
text: Every Standard Species has five innate Species Features. You gain the Core Instinct with the Monster Taming Core Talent. Monster Taming Developments 1–4 then unlock the Lesser, Greater, Elite and Elder Features in order. Species Features are part of your monster's profile, not learned Monster Techniques. They cost no Command AP unless stated otherwise. Actions and Interrupts granted by Species Features are Independent Actions and remain available even if you cannot issue commands.

title: Monster Traits
text: Every Growth Rank grants one Trait from the monster's Species. Traits are chosen when earned and are permanent unless a rebuild or rules update allows them to change.

title: Stackable Trait
text: May be selected any number of times. Each selection adds one rank, and all ranks stack exactly as written.

title: Utility Trait
text: May normally be selected once. If a Utility Trait asks you to choose from several options, you may select it again only to take a different option unless it explicitly says otherwise.

title: One-Time Trait
text: May be selected once. "One-Time" limits how often you may select the Trait, not how often its effect may be used. Any use limit is stated in the Trait itself.

title: Temperament and Rebellion
text: A Tamed Monster is a living creature, not equipment or a mind-controlled tool. Ordinary danger, injury, defeat, retreat, or an imperfect command does not cause Rebellion. A trained monster can be expected to take real risks beside its handler. Rebellion occurs if you deliberately attack your own Tamed Monster, knowingly use it as a disposable suicide piece when a reasonable alternative exists, or knowingly violate its Temperament. Accidental friendly fire does not automatically cause Rebellion;

title: Jackal Species
text: Role: Pursuit / Tracking Jackals are relentless pursuit hunters. They excel at tracking, repositioning around wounded prey, and turning a retreat into a bad decision.

title: Profile
text: | Toughness | Aggression | Defence | Agility | | 2 | 4 | 2 | 4 | Basic Attack: Speed 8 | Melee | 100% Monster Damage | Piercing Command AP Modifier: -1 Movement: Ground

title: Blood-Scented Pursuit
text: Unlock: Core Talent Effects: The Jackal can establish and follow a physical scent trail from blood, fur, clothing, carcasses, campsites and similar evidence where one plausibly remains. Its Basic Attack gains +1 Accuracy against Bleeding creatures or creatures that have suffered a Wound this scene.

title: Cut the Line
text: Unlock: Development 1 — Lesser Feature Effects: When an enemy voluntarily moves farther away from the Jackal, it may move up to 2 yards after that Action resolves without changing Initiative. This can occur once between the Jackal's Actions.

title: Hamstring Bite
text: Unlock: Development 2 — Greater Feature Effects: When the Jackal's Basic Attack fully hits a creature that moved at least 5 yards since its last Action, reduce all movement that creature makes before its next Action by 2 yards, minimum 0.

title: Relentless Chase
text: Unlock: Development 3 — Elite Feature Effects: Increase the Jackal's Movement by 50% while it moves toward a Wounded or Bleeding creature. It ignores mundane Difficult Terrain during that movement.

title: Pack Execution
text: Unlock: Development 4 — Elder Feature Effects: The Jackal's Basic Attacks against Wounded or Bleeding creatures gain +2 Accuracy and deal +25% Final Damage.

title: Longroad Legs
text: Type: Stackable Increase the monster's Movement by 0.1 yard per IC.

title: Harrier
text: Type: Stackable Each rank increases the Basic Attack's Final Damage by 4% against a target that has suffered a Wound or moved at least 5 yards since its last Action.

title: Carrion Nose
text: Type: Utility Blood-Scented Pursuit becomes exceptionally precise. When the Jackal meaningfully helps a Track or investigation using scent, grant +5 to the relevant Survival or Research roll, and on success the Jackal can distinguish the freshest plausible trail from older overlapping trails.

title: Scavenger's Eye
text: Type: Utility Outside Initiative, the monster can quickly identify whether mundane meat, hides, tracks, remains, discarded equipment or disturbed ground are fresh, spoiled, recently moved or deliberately tampered with. It never creates additional salvage.

title: Cut Them Off
text: Type: One-Time Cut the Line may move up to 3 yards instead of 2, and the Jackal gains +2 Defence against movement-based reactions during that movement.

title: Blood in the Air
text: Type: One-Time Increase Blood-Scented Pursuit's Accuracy bonus against Bleeding or Wounded creatures by +1. Pack Execution therefore grants a total of +4 Accuracy against those targets.

title: Carrion Nose
text: Speed: 10 Base Command AP: 4 Effects: Choose a creature, trail, body or disturbed site the monster can physically examine. It makes a focused scent search; gain +5 to one immediately related Survival, Awareness or Research roll and, on success, learn the freshest plausible direction of travel.

title: Harrier's Cut
text: Speed: 8 Base Command AP: 6 Effects: Make a Basic Attack. If the target moved at least 5 yards since its last Action, increase Final Damage by 20% and reduce any movement it makes before its next Action by 2 yards, minimum 0.

title: Last-Mile Pack
text: Speed: 11 Base Command AP: 9 Range: 15 yards Effects: The Jackal darts around one target, snapping from changing angles. Make one Attack using the monster's Accuracy for 80% Monster Damage. On a hit, end the target's current voluntary movement and knock it Prone if it moved at least 5 yards during that Action.

title: Run to Ground
text: Speed: 12 Base Command AP: 12 Effects: The monster moves up to twice its normal Movement for this Action and makes an Attack for 130% Monster Damage. Against a Wounded or Bleeding target, gain +2 Accuracy and inflict Knockback 3 on a full hit.

title: Temperament
text: Jackals are driven by pursuit, scent and useful scavenging. They respond well to clear quarry and active work, but become difficult when repeatedly forced to remain idle as disposable guards or made to destroy food, salvage or a trail without purpose.

title: Lynx Species
text: Role: Reaction / Counterattack Lynxes are reactive hunters built around speed, awareness and sudden retaliation. They are at their best when an enemy commits first.

title: Profile
text: | Toughness | Aggression | Defence | Agility | | 2 | 3 | 2 | 5 | Basic Attack: Speed 7 | Melee | 100% Monster Damage | Slashing Command AP Modifier: -2 Movement: Ground; climbs ordinary surfaces at half Movement

title: Pre-Impact Read
text: Unlock: Core Talent Effects: The Lynx gains +1 Defence against the first Attack declared against it after each of its Actions.

title: Counterstep
text: Unlock: Development 1 — Lesser Feature Effects: After successfully Dodging or Parrying an Attack, the Lynx may move 1 yard without changing Initiative. This can occur once between its Actions.

title: Capacitor Coat
text: Unlock: Development 2 — Greater Feature Effects: After successfully Dodging or Parrying a Melee Attack, the Lynx becomes Charged. Its next Basic Attack before the end of its next Action deals +15% Final Damage, then Charged ends.

title: Static Grounding
text: Unlock: Development 3 — Elite Feature Effects: The Lynx gains +2 Defence against Lightning and electrical Energy Attacks and reduces Paralysis inflicted by those effects by 1, minimum 0.

title: Perfect Counter
text: Unlock: Development 4 — Elder Feature Speed: 4 Interrupt Trigger: The Lynx successfully Dodges or Parries an Attack from a creature within its melee reach. Effects: Make an immediate Attack against that creature for 80% Monster Damage.

title: Static Claws
text: Type: Stackable Each rank increases the Basic Attack's Final Damage by 4% against a target that used a Lightning or Energy effect since its previous Action.

title: Needle Ears
text: Type: Stackable Gain +1 on Awareness checks made through sound, vibration or electrical disturbance.

title: Storm Listener
text: Type: Utility Rain, fog and darkness do not penalize the monster's Awareness when the thing being detected could reasonably be heard. It can distinguish natural thunder from nearby chakra-driven electrical discharge.

title: High Perch
text: Type: Utility The monster can climb ordinary vertical surfaces at its normal Movement and can safely leap gaps up to twice its normal Movement without a check when a plausible landing exists.

title: Capacitor Fur
text: Type: One-Time Capacitor Coat's Charged bonus becomes +30% Final Damage instead of +15%.

title: Pre-Impact Read
text: Type: One-Time Pre-Impact Read grants +2 Defence against the first Attack declared against the Lynx after each of its Actions instead of +1.

title: Thunder-Ear
text: Speed: 7 Base Command AP: 4 Range: 20 yards Effects: The monster listens for movement, breathing, speech, impact or electrical disturbance. Make an Awareness check with +5; on success it may immediately Point Out one Hidden creature it could plausibly hear.

title: Forked Pounce
text: Speed: 8 Base Command AP: 7 Effects: Move up to 5 yards, then Attack for 100% Monster Damage. On a hit, arc static to a different creature within 5 yards and make a second Attack at -2 Accuracy for 60% Monster Damage.

title: Grounding Guard
text: Speed: 4 Interrupt Base Command AP: 6 Range: 2 yards Effects: Trigger: the monster or an ally is hit by an electrical Energy effect. Reduce that effect's Final Damage by 20% and reduce Paralysis inflicted by 1, minimum 0.

title: Thunderclaw
text: Speed: 10 Base Command AP: 11 Effects: Make an Attack for 125% Monster Damage. On a full hit, inflict Paralysis 3 for 10 IC. If the monster is Charged, increase the damage to 150% and Paralysis to 4, then Charged ends.

title: Temperament
text: Lynxes are watchful, reactive hunters. They respond best to patient handling and room to choose their moment. Repeatedly using one as deliberate bait, or ignoring clear warning behaviour and forcing it back into obvious danger, can trigger Rebellion.

title: Boar Species
text: Role: Breach / Frontline Boars are creatures of commitment: heavy, direct and practical. They break formations, clear roads and turn their bodies into moving obstacles.

title: Profile
text: | Toughness | Aggression | Defence | Agility | | 4 | 4 | 2 | 2 | Basic Attack: Speed 10 | Melee | 100% Monster Damage | Blunt Command AP Modifier: +1 Movement: Ground

title: Driving Mass
text: Unlock: Core Talent Effects: Reduce Knockback suffered by the Boar by 2, minimum 0. It gains +2 against effects that would forcibly reposition it.

title: Headlong Charge
text: Unlock: Development 1 — Lesser Feature Effects: If the Boar moved at least 3 yards in a straight line immediately before its Basic Attack, that Attack deals +15% Final Damage. On a full hit, also inflict Knockback 2.

title: Trample Through
text: Unlock: Development 2 — Greater Feature Effects: Once per Move Action, the Boar may attempt to pass through the space of one human-sized hostile creature. Contest the Boar's Accuracy against that creature's Defence. On success, move the creature 1 yard to a legal space and continue moving. On failure, the Boar's movement ends before entering that space.

title: Living Wallback
text: Unlock: Development 3 — Elite Feature Effects: Adjacent allies may treat the Boar as Cover 1. The Boar may Take the Hit for an ally within 2 yards at Speed 5 when it can physically interpose itself.

title: Battering Ram
text: Unlock: Development 4 — Elder Feature Effects: The Boar counts as one Size larger for carrying and forced movement. Its Attacks deal +50% Final Damage against unattended objects, Cover and mundane structures. A full hit after Headlong Charge inflicts Knockback 4 and Prone instead of Knockback 2.

title: Ironhide
text: Type: Stackable Each rank increases maximum Vitality by 4% of the monster's unmodified maximum Vitality.

title: Driving Mass
text: Type: Stackable For every 2 ranks, increase Knockback or forced movement caused by Boar Monster Techniques by 1 yard.

title: Root Work
text: Type: Utility Outside Initiative, halve the time needed to clear brambles, loose rubble, shallow earth, mud or similar mundane obstructions when the monster can simply dig or shove through them.

title: Hauler
text: Type: Utility The monster can carry or drag one additional human-sized willing or unconscious creature, or an equivalent mundane load, without slowing ordinary overland travel.

title: Broad Back
text: Type: One-Time Living Wallback provides Cover 2 instead of Cover 1.

title: Planted Feet
text: Type: One-Time Driving Mass reduces Knockback by 3 instead of 2, and its bonus against forced repositioning becomes +3.

title: Boar Road
text: Speed: 12 Base Command AP: 7 Line: 8 yards Effects: The monster charges along the Line and makes an Attack against each creature in it for 80% Monster Damage. On a hit, inflict Knockback 3.

title: Furrow the Earth
text: Speed: 14 Base Command AP: 6 Effects: Create a 3-yard-wide path up to 12 yards long through loose earth, rubble or brush. The path becomes Rocky Terrain 3 for 20 IC; shallow traps, wires or caches may be exposed with an appropriate check.

title: Wallback
text: Speed: 4 Interrupt Base Command AP: 7 Range: 2 yards Effects: Trigger: an ally is hit by an Attack the monster could physically intercept. Move up to 2 yards, become the target, and defend normally. If it cannot interpose itself, this cannot be used.

title: Breakthrough Charge
text: Speed: 15 Base Command AP: 12 Line: 12 yards Effects: Move along the Line and Attack each creature for 120% Monster Damage. On a hit inflict Knockback 6; on a full hit also inflict Stun 4. Unattended mundane obstacles take +50% Final Damage.

title: Temperament
text: Boars are stubborn working beasts that respond well to direct routes, obvious obstacles and committed movement. Pointless destruction or repeatedly driving one into the same obviously suicidal charge can trigger Rebellion.

title: Mantis Species
text: Role: Precision / Counter Mantises are precision predators. They favor stillness, reach, clean counters and attacks that punish exposed limbs or careless approaches.

title: Profile
text: | Toughness | Aggression | Defence | Agility | | 2 | 4 | 3 | 3 | Basic Attack: Speed 9 | Melee | 100% Monster Damage | Slashing Command AP Modifier: +0 Movement: Ground; climbs rough natural surfaces at half Movement

title: Predator's Reach
text: Unlock: Core Talent Effects: Increase the reach of the Mantis's Basic Attack by 1 yard.

title: Hooking Guard
text: Unlock: Development 1 — Lesser Feature Effects: The Mantis gains +1 Parry against Melee Attacks. After successfully Parrying a Melee Attack, it may move the attacker 1 yard to a legal adjacent space.

title: Patient Killer
text: Unlock: Development 2 — Greater Feature Effects: If the Mantis has not voluntarily moved since its previous Action, its next Basic Attack deals +15% Final Damage.

title: Scything Reflex
text: Unlock: Development 3 — Elite Feature Speed: 4 Interrupt Trigger: The Mantis successfully Parries a Melee Attack. Effects: Make an immediate Attack against that attacker for 60% Monster Damage.

title: Killing Zone
text: Unlock: Development 4 — Elder Feature Speed: 4 Interrupt Trigger: A hostile creature voluntarily enters or leaves the Mantis's melee reach. Effects: Make an Attack against that creature for 80% Monster Damage. This can occur once between the Mantis's Actions and is an Independent Action.

title: Razor Forelimbs
text: Type: Stackable For every 2 ranks, gain +1 Accuracy with the Basic Attack against a creature that attacked the monster since its previous Action.

title: Patient Killer
text: Type: Stackable Each rank increases the next Basic Attack's Final Damage by 4% if the monster has not voluntarily moved since its previous Action.

title: Still as Grass
text: Type: Utility When the monster remains motionless and has suitable cover or vegetation, grant +3 to an allied Stealth or ambush preparation check involving it.

title: Fine Manipulators
text: Type: Utility Despite its anatomy, the monster can carefully cut rope, webbing, cloth, vines and similar non-reinforced material without damaging a restrained creature or nearby object.

title: Hooking Guard
text: Type: One-Time Hooking Guard grants +2 Parry against Melee Attacks instead of +1. The attacker may still be shifted 1 yard after a successful Parry.

title: Long Reach
text: Type: One-Time Increase the reach of the Basic Attack and Mantis Monster Techniques by 1 additional yard. This stacks with Predator's Reach.

title: Scything Counter
text: Speed: 4 Interrupt Base Command AP: 6 Effects: Trigger: the monster successfully Parries a Melee Attack. Make an immediate Attack against that attacker for 70% Monster Damage.

title: Prayer-Still
text: Speed: 10 Base Command AP: 4 Effects: The monster becomes braced until its next Action. It gains +3 Defence, but loses the bonus immediately if it voluntarily moves.

title: Severing Arc
text: Speed: 11 Base Command AP: 8 Effects: Make an Attack for 115% Monster Damage. On a full hit, choose: inflict Bleed 3, or reduce the target's Movement by 20% for 20 IC.

title: Thousand-Cut Step
text: Speed: 13 Base Command AP: 12 Effects: Move up to 4 yards without provoking movement-based reactions, then make two Attacks against the same target at -2 Accuracy, each for 70% Monster Damage.

title: Temperament
text: Mantises are still, precise predators. They tolerate lethal work, but react poorly to frantic handling, needless torment and commands that repeatedly force them to abandon a clean position for spectacle.

title: Salamander Species
text: Role: Control / Survival Salamanders are durable utility monsters, comfortable in hostile environments and difficult to keep injured or displaced.

title: Profile
text: | Toughness | Aggression | Defence | Agility | | 3 | 3 | 4 | 2 | Basic Attack: Speed 10 | Melee | 100% Monster Damage | Piercing Command AP Modifier: +1 Movement: Ground; swims at normal Movement

title: Regenerative Flesh
text: Unlock: Core Talent Effects: At the start of each of the Salamander's Actions, it restores 2% of its maximum Vitality.

title: Wall Clinger
text: Unlock: Development 1 — Lesser Feature Effects: The Salamander may move across walls and ceilings at half Movement without a check when the surface can physically support it.

title: Mucous Balance
text: Unlock: Development 2 — Greater Feature Effects: The Salamander gains +2 Resistance against Poison, Burns and corrosive environmental effects and reduces forced movement suffered by 2 yards, minimum 0.

title: Tail Shedding
text: Unlock: Development 3 — Elite Feature Limit: Once per battle Effects: After the Salamander would become Grappled, Prone or Immobilized, it may immediately end one of those conditions after the triggering effect resolves.

title: Elder Regeneration
text: Unlock: Development 4 — Elder Feature Effects: Regenerative Flesh restores 5% of maximum Vitality instead of 2%. Once per battle, at the start of an Action, the Salamander may also remove up to 2 total levels of Bleed, Burns or Paralysis from itself.

title: Regenerative Flesh
text: Type: Stackable Each rank increases the percentage of maximum Vitality restored by Regenerative Flesh and Elder Regeneration by 1 percentage point.

title: Clinging Toes
text: Type: Stackable Gain +1 Defence against forced movement, Knockback and effects that would knock the monster Prone.

title: Wall Clinger
text: Type: Utility Wall Clinger allows movement across walls and ceilings at normal Movement instead of half Movement.

title: Hazard Skin
text: Type: Utility Choose heat, cold, acid, or ordinary environmental toxins when this Trait is selected. The monster ignores mundane exposure from that hazard. This Utility Trait may be selected again for a different hazard.

title: Tail Shedding
text: Type: One-Time Tail Shedding may be used twice per battle, and may also end Paralysis when triggered.

title: Mucous Coat
text: Type: One-Time Mucous Balance's Resistance bonus becomes +4 instead of +2.

title: Adhesive Lunge
text: Speed: 10 Base Command AP: 6 Effects: Make an Attack for 90% Monster Damage. On a full hit, inflict Immobilization 3 for 10 IC as adhesive mucus or gripping limbs hold the target.

title: Shed and Slip
text: Speed: 3 Interrupt Base Command AP: 5 Effects: Trigger: the monster fails a defence against a Grapple or Immobilization effect. Reroll that defence and use the higher result; if it still fails, reduce the resulting Immobilization by 2.

title: Caustic Spit
text: Speed: 12 Base Command AP: 8 Range: 10 yards Effects: Make a ranged Attack for 100% Monster Damage as Energy damage. On a full hit, the target suffers -2 to Parry until its next Action.

title: Regenerative Molt
text: Speed: 15 Base Command AP: 12 Effects: The monster sheds damaged tissue and restores 25% of its maximum Vitality. Remove up to 3 total levels of Bleed, Burns or Paralysis from it. Once per battle.

title: Temperament
text: Salamanders are hardy and unusually tolerant of hostile environments. They can be trained for hazardous work, but repeatedly exposing one to toxins, fire, corrosion or attrition purely to test what it can survive can trigger Rebellion.

title: Bear Species
text: Role: Guardian / Grapple Bears are slow, brutally durable protectors. They excel at bodyguarding, grappling and forcing enemies to deal with them first.

title: Profile
text: | Toughness | Aggression | Defence | Agility | | 5 | 3 | 3 | 1 | Basic Attack: Speed 11 | Melee | 100% Monster Damage | Blunt Command AP Modifier: +2 Movement: Ground

title: Guardian's Bulk
text: Unlock: Core Talent Effects: Adjacent allies may treat the Bear as Cover 1 against Attacks originating from the opposite side. The Bear gains +2 on checks to initiate or maintain Grapples.

title: Mauling Hold
text: Unlock: Development 1 — Lesser Feature Effects: When the Bear's Basic Attack hits by 5 or more, it may immediately attempt a Grapple. This costs no Command AP and adds no Speed.

title: Get Behind Me
text: Unlock: Development 2 — Greater Feature Speed: 5 Interrupt Trigger: An ally within 3 yards is targeted by an Attack the Bear could physically intercept. Effects: Move the Bear up to 2 yards. If it can interpose itself, it becomes the target and defends normally.

title: Unmoving Guardian
text: Unlock: Development 3 — Elite Feature Effects: While Grappling a hostile creature or adjacent to an ally, the Bear gains 15 DR and reduces forced movement suffered by 2 yards, minimum 0.

title: Mountain With Teeth
text: Unlock: Development 4 — Elder Feature Effects: The Bear counts as one Size larger for Grapples, carrying and forced movement. When it successfully initiates a Grapple, knock that target Prone. Its Basic Attacks against creatures it is Grappling deal +25% Final Damage.

title: Thick Fur
text: Type: Stackable Each rank increases maximum Vitality by 4% of the monster's unmodified maximum Vitality.

title: Heavy Paws
text: Type: Stackable Each rank increases the Basic Attack's Final Damage by 4% against Prone or Grappled targets.

title: Powerful Frame
text: Type: Utility Gain +3 on physical checks to lift, drag, break or brace mundane objects.

title: Trail Shelter
text: Type: Utility Outside Initiative, the bear can rapidly dig, clear or reinforce a rough campsite or emergency shelter, granting +3 to one relevant Survival check.

title: Bodyguard
text: Type: One-Time Get Behind Me becomes Speed 4 instead of Speed 5. When used to protect the tamer, the Bear may move up to 3 yards instead of 2.

title: Mauler
text: Type: One-Time Mauling Hold triggers on any full hit rather than requiring the Basic Attack to hit by 5 or more.

title: Mauling Grip
text: Speed: 12 Base Command AP: 7 Effects: Make an Attack for 100% Monster Damage. On a hit by 5 or more, Grapple the target; while maintained, the target suffers -2 Defence against the bear.

title: Roaring Challenge
text: Speed: 13 Base Command AP: 5 Area: 8 yards Effects: Enemies that can hear the bear must make Resistance against Monster Save TN. On failure, they suffer -2 Accuracy against creatures other than the bear until the bear's next Action. This is a fear-based effect.

title: Guardian Rush
text: Speed: 14 Base Command AP: 8 Effects: Move up to 6 yards toward an ally, then either make a Basic Attack or become Cover 3 for that ally until the bear's next Action.

title: Avalanche Maul
text: Speed: 16 Base Command AP: 12 Effects: Make an Attack for 140% Monster Damage. On a full hit, knock the target Prone and inflict Stun 4. Against a Grappled target, damage becomes 160% instead.

title: Temperament
text: Bears form strong protective routines around familiar people. They readily hold a line or cover a retreat, but forcing one to abandon a helpless creature it has been trained to guard can trigger Rebellion.

title: Crocodile Species
text: Role: Ambush / Grapple Crocodiles are ambush grapplers. They are difficult to dislodge, frightening in water and built to turn one clean bite into control.

title: Profile
text: | Toughness | Aggression | Defence | Agility | | 4 | 4 | 3 | 1 | Basic Attack: Speed 11 | Melee | 100% Monster Damage | Piercing Command AP Modifier: +2 Movement: Ground; swims at normal Movement

title: River Predator
text: Unlock: Core Talent Effects: The Crocodile swims at twice its normal Movement and may remain submerged for an entire scene without Suffocation checks. It gains +1 on Stealth checks while substantially submerged.

title: Lockjaw
text: Unlock: Development 1 — Lesser Feature Effects: When the Crocodile's Basic Attack hits by 5 or more, it may immediately attempt a Grapple. This costs no Command AP and adds no Speed.

title: Low Profile
text: Unlock: Development 2 — Greater Feature Effects: While Prone or substantially submerged, ranged Attacks originating more than 5 yards away suffer -1 Accuracy against the Crocodile.

title: Crushing Hold
text: Unlock: Development 3 — Elite Feature Effects: A creature Grappled by the Crocodile suffers -1 Defence against it. The Crocodile's Basic Attacks against that creature deal +15% Final Damage.

title: Drag Below
text: Unlock: Development 4 — Elder Feature Effects: While in water and Grappling a creature, the Crocodile may carry that creature at full Movement. A submerged target that cannot breathe immediately begins the normal Suffocation rules. The Crocodile counts as one Size larger for Grapples.

title: Armoured Scutes
text: Type: Stackable Each rank increases maximum Vitality by 4% of the monster's unmodified maximum Vitality.

title: Crushing Jaws
text: Type: Stackable Each rank increases the Basic Attack's Final Damage by 4% against Grappled targets.

title: River Hunter
text: Type: Utility River Predator's swimming Movement becomes 2.5 times normal Movement. The Crocodile also gains +3 Awareness on checks made to detect creatures moving through the same body of water.

title: Waterline Ambush
text: Type: Utility When substantially submerged or concealed in marsh, grant +3 to an allied Stealth or ambush preparation check involving the monster.

title: Lockjaw
text: Type: One-Time The monster gains +3 on checks to maintain a Grapple it initiated.

title: Low Profile
text: Type: One-Time Low Profile imposes -2 Accuracy instead of -1 against ranged Attacks from more than 5 yards away.

title: Jaw Lock
text: Speed: 12 Base Command AP: 7 Effects: Make an Attack for 100% Monster Damage. If it hits by 5 or more, immediately Grapple the target.

title: Death Roll
text: Speed: 14 Base Command AP: 8 Requires: a Grappled target Effects: Make an Attack for 120% Monster Damage; on a hit, knock the target Prone and move both creatures up to 2 yards.

title: Drag Under
text: Speed: 13 Base Command AP: 7 Requires: the monster to be in water and Grappling a target Effects: Move up to the monster's full Movement, carrying the target. The target immediately begins normal Suffocation rules if submerged and unable to breathe.

title: Blackwater Ambush
text: Speed: 15 Base Command AP: 12 Effects: The monster may move up to 8 yards from concealment, water or Cover and Attack for 150% Monster Damage. If the target had not detected the monster, this Attack gains +3 Accuracy.

title: Temperament
text: Crocodiles are patient ambush predators. They respond well to stillness, water and decisive attacks, but become difficult when repeatedly forced into noisy pursuit, dragged away from secure territory without purpose, or made to kill purely for sport.

title: Roc Species
text: Role: Mobility / Rescue Rocs are aerial control monsters. They trade raw durability for flight, transport, diving attacks and the ability to reposition allies or enemies.

title: Profile
text: | Toughness | Aggression | Defence | Agility | | 2 | 3 | 3 | 4 | Basic Attack: Speed 8 | Melee | 100% Monster Damage | Piercing Command AP Modifier: -1 Movement: Flight

title: Sky Carrier
text: Unlock: Core Talent Effects: The Roc has true flight and may carry one willing human-sized creature while flying at half Movement.

title: Dive Hunter
text: Unlock: Development 1 — Lesser Feature Effects: If the Roc moved at least 5 yards immediately before making a Basic Attack, that Attack deals +15% Final Damage.

title: Wingover
text: Unlock: Development 2 — Greater Feature Effects: After moving at least 4 yards while airborne, the Roc gains +1 Defence against ranged Attacks until its next Action.

title: Airlift
text: Unlock: Development 3 — Elite Feature Effects: The Roc may carry one willing human-sized creature at full Movement. Carrying that creature no longer reduces its Movement from Sky Carrier.

title: Sky Tyrant
text: Unlock: Development 4 — Elder Feature Effects: If the Roc begins at least 5 yards above or away from a target and moves at least 5 yards before its Basic Attack, that Attack deals an additional +25% Final Damage. On a full hit, also inflict Knockback 3 and Prone.

title: Broad Wings
text: Type: Stackable Each rank increases flying Movement by 0.1 yard per IC.

title: Dive Hunter
text: Type: Stackable Each rank increases the Basic Attack's Final Damage by 4% if the monster moved at least 5 yards immediately before attacking.

title: Sky Carrier
text: Type: Utility The Roc may carry one additional human-sized willing creature. When carrying more than one creature, fly at half Movement unless Airlift or another rule says otherwise. This Utility Trait may be selected again for another passenger.

title: Far Sight
text: Type: Utility Gain +3 on Awareness checks based on long-distance vision, weather observation or locating large landmarks from the air.

title: Wing Buffer
text: Type: One-Time The monster and adjacent allies reduce forced movement caused by wind by 3 yards, minimum 0.

title: Wingover
text: Type: One-Time Wingover grants +2 Defence against ranged Attacks instead of +1.

title: Talon Snatch
text: Speed: 9 Base Command AP: 7 Effects: Move up to 5 yards, then Attack for 90% Monster Damage. On a hit by 5 or more, the monster may carry a human-sized target 2 yards in any direction; unwilling targets may oppose with Grapple Defence.

title: Gale Wing
text: Speed: 10 Base Command AP: 7 Cone: 6 yards Effects: Creatures in the cone make a Defence against the monster's Accuracy. On failure, suffer Knockback 4; unattended smoke, dust and similar light obscurants are dispersed.

title: Rescue Lift
text: Speed: 4 Interrupt Base Command AP: 6 Range: 4 yards Effects: Trigger: a willing ally would be hit by an Area effect the Roc could physically lift them out of. Move that ally up to 4 yards to a legal space; if this leaves the Area, the Attack no longer targets them.

title: Heavenfall Dive
text: Speed: 13 Base Command AP: 12 Effects: The Roc must begin at least 5 yards above or away from the target. Move up to 10 yards and Attack for 150% Monster Damage. On a full hit, inflict Knockback 5 and Prone.

title: Temperament
